Avrin had been listening since the two made their way across the room. It seemed those mana traps didn’t affect them, could it be there was some sort of system to differentiate certain people? In any case he would have to look at it later on. Right now, he dared not miss a word those two spoke, when he heard mythological his interested had peaked.
They continued their conversation with Menzo speaking first “hurry up and tell me what is it for?!” The man chuckled and grinned before replying “it tells the location of a chunk of raw sky metal…”
Avrin didn't know how to react. He remembered the most pricey book was 30,000 and titled Sky Metal The Enigma. It would make sense that it would be important considering the books level was unique he could also tell by how hard Menzo was breathing. The man in the room knew Menzo was about to burst with excitement so decided to show him. He reached into his dark cloak and pulled out a cloth in the shape of a flat square around 5 inches tall and 3 inches wide. Of course avrin did not know this was the case as he only guessed it was revealed by Menzo’s words of excitement.
“I..I can't believe it..this is the real thing..the markings...the material so delicately made...it has nearly no erosion on the carved text...Where did you get this?..” Avrin figured this was a chance to continue doing what he came here to do. He went over from the corner he hid and made his way to the front desk where he reopened the part of the showcase desk where he had previously done so before he resealed it.
avrin had reached into the showcase and took all the expensive books without hesitation, of course there was one more thing he wanted and he had a plan to retrieve it. The book keeper didnt really do anything bad to him but Avrin would let nothing get in his way to achieve the highest peak in this universe.
As he held the books together in a stack with his left arm he looked around before carefully approaching the door. he wanted to try something new with his nebula mist. Of course, he was going on impulse, he had no idea whether the man with Menzo was strong or not. Avrin began to emit a thick nebula mist from his right palm and it began to seep into the room he was in. In the meantime the men continued to talk.
“Heh...You know me, I bought it off some clueless merchant in in the northern continent Ailera. You won't believe how much profit I've been making ever since you taught me how to identify stuff..” Menzo nodded as he held a sort of magnifying glass in the room lit by a magical lamp. he was looking over the mythological tablet but was having trouble reading it “How much did you buy this for?”
The man folded his arms with a nod “10 gold. I think I did fairly well. Why do you ask?..” Menzo grinned and spoke “This tablet by itself is worth a few million gold coins….could you imagine how much that sky metal would be?...In the whole of Seleria, all the accounts of sky metal existing have been nearly non existent. King Leo Zircus supposedly has a chunk, as well as the beast tribe chief Giron. But these are rumors.. Bah, either way, to my knowledge no one on Seleria knows how to smith such a enigmatic metal” Menzo spoke as if lecturing the man to which he replied with a chuckle “Hehe, who could learn when no one has gotten their hands on it…”
Menzo nodded in agreement before speaking. In the meantime a strange purple mist began to seep in through the bottom opening of the door “If we manage to get that chunk we would have enough gold to make our own city. Who could afford to buy something so expensive…?”
the door began to creak slowly as the men spoke, neither noticing it “why don't we sell it in pieces? Maybe we could make more?” As the two deliberated the door burst open revealing a dark purple mist outside of it that began to seep in but the reactions of the two were in horror as their hearts felt as if they were going to burst.
Menzo was the first to speak as he yelled “W..What is this!! “ he backed away with the tablet. the room itself didn't have a proper window, only an opening with iron bars. The man looked around frantically before pulling out a steel short sword from his waist.
Avrin smirked as he was engulfing himself in the mist to hide his appearance. He reached his hand out of the mist that burst into the room engulfing it in nearly a couple of seconds not giving the two a proper amount of time to resist or flee properly.
“I DONT WANT TO DIE!!” Menzo yelled out while the man who was swinging his sword around as if trying to hit something found himself useless. At this point Avrin, being able to see clearly in the mist he created, chuckled to himself before using the mist to cut the room off. A large cement like wall split the room in two. It cut off Menzo from the other man who tried banging and attacking it to no avail.
it seemed he was indeed quite strong as the wall itself crumbled. Avrin thought he was learning quite a bit, but no matter how much the man chipped away at the wall the mist that emitted in the area reformed the broken segments. Avrin knew he would have to be quick as keeping the nebula mist up was quite a drainer with himself not being trained much.
He walked over to Menzo and grabbed the tablet but met resistance as Menzo spoke out “Please, I'll give you anything, just don't take this tablet!!! its a family heirloom!!” At this point Avrin felt like laughing at this man’s blatant lie but heard the wall chipping away faster. Apparently the man heard that the mysterious person was after the tablet and didn't want to lose it.
Avrin’s face twisted slightly as he spoke out. At this point he could of killed them both using the mist but it would cause a bigger commotion and raise suspicion. So he decided to do the next best thing. The nebula mist engulfed Menzo’s right hand and wasted no time devouring it even as Menzo screamed in pain. Avrin’s face showed no emotion, he still considered the man lucky he didn't torture him.
Enjoying this book? Seek out the original to ensure the author gets credit.
Avrin grabbed the tablet before heading outside the entrance he came from while still making sure to avoid the traps. He held books in his right hand and the tablet in his other as he heard Menzo screaming in agony while the other man had managed to break through the wall and was asking Menzo where the tablet was.
Although Avrin considered himself a changed man, he could not deny that he found this situation somewhat amusing. He had intended to steal a few books but ended up taking something he would not have been able to obtain for years. Either way it was something he still wanted. He would have to work on his greed later on.
Avrin dispersed the rest of the nebula mist after he felt he was safe. He had gotten inside the inn using the window. It seemed avrin could jump quite high even though he had no experience in combat, possibly another trait of this body. Either way it had allowed him to jump onto the nearby shop’s sturdy roof before he entered his room.
He could hear whistles from the guards who came at the calls of the men. Avrin would have to be careful with these objects since there was a possibility of the guards searching around.
But at this point, there was no need. Avrin had planned his next course of action. He would first make more gold coins without care to the mana stream around this room, as it seemed to have slowly healed. Then he would absorb the books as well as the tablet, which would allow him to travel without care. Of course he needed to buy resources, he felt he shouldn't skimp out on natural tasting supplies if possible as the synthetic taste of his creations didn't really appeal to him.
At around 3:00am the guards were even more alert as they began knocking and searching houses. Avrin had spent an hour making gold coins and trying to test his ability to reform them into mana but he ended up failing as they turned into dark matter and just polluted the stream some more. He then heard several knocks from below at the ground floor. It seemed the guards had finally gotten inside. But there was no need for him to worry. since 2:30am he had begun to absorb the books including the ones he had purchased. he had taken in the ones he previously bought before reforming them as a test to see if something would happen.
It seemed his prior test of keeping the fishing book absorbed was somewhat useless as he found he could reform a book right after absorbing it. So without hesitation he began absorbing everything, each book taking at least 2 minutes, so he had plenty of time.
Of course the tablet itself was a different issue. He found it was much harder to absorb and had taken him 29 minutes. He pondered why this was the case. Could it be the material it was formed from or the rarity itself? This was a magic universe so it was possible it took more time to absorb something of a rarer quality.
He finished everything at 3:10am, at this point the guards had knocked on the door and Avrin went over to answer with his cloak on. As he opened the door he found a somewhat skinny man next to a sturdy built man. The man who seemed more sturdy appeared to be irritated and cut to the chase without having Avrin answer what they needed. “The book shop was robbed and items valued at several hundred thousands of gold were stolen. We need to check your room sir..”
Avrin nodded and stepped aside, he didn't want to cause a commotion. Thanks to his body he didn't feel an inch of fatigue. Of course sleeping fatigue and muscle fatigue would differentiate his body, at the moment it was only capable of keeping itself stable and healthy when awake without the need to sleep. If Avrin over exerted himself it would be more troublesome.
Both the sturdy and skinny man had turned the room upside down looking for a shred of evidence or anything stolen. The skinny man said “H..Hey this room gives me the creeps...it feels like my insides are burning...and I got a headache…” The built man responded “you to ay?.. feels like my muscles are going to implode…” Avrin raised a curious brow, he wondered if this was a side effect from the dark matter polluting the mana stream.
Of course it had healed itself and was only a little polluted, but to have this effect was interesting. Avrin knew everything in this universe was made up of mana particles, so to speak, so having a foreign object interfere with it was obviously going to have a side effect.
Avrin noticed something interesting. it seemed the skinny man was having problems breathing “H..Hey are we done..? i'm going outside.. “ He stumbled about before heading off outside the room gasping for air. The sturdy man who had obviously trained more than his partner also stood up but seemed to be sweating as he turned to Avrin who seemed to be fine. “H..Hey I can’t find anything here..B..But you shouldn't be practicing magic like this in this inn...i'll give you a warning this time.. but right now… “ The man at that point held his mouth as if he were going to vomit and rushed out and closed the door. avrin heard thumping foot steps down the stairs before he heard a blehh vomiting sound which made him grin with satisfaction. He had secretly thanked the two guards for being unintentional guinea pigs for this unintentional experiment.
Avrin smiled as it seemed he was in the clear. He wanted to look at all the knowledge he had accumulated and began reforming the books, excluding the tablet since it took too long to form. 10 minutes later as it seemed it was a little faster, he managed to form all of them but came across two issues, the first concerning two and the other concerning them all. The Gourmet Cookbook seemed to have jumbled words as if things had been messed around with. The other book, Kings of Seleria, had its first half jumbled up the same as the Gourmet Cookbook. But the rest of the book seemed to be fine.
He pondered on this issue wondering what could of gone wrong. He took a good 20 minutes before deducing a theory. At the time he absorbed the books he took in the Gourmet Cookbook first, followed by Kings of Seleria. He then absorbed everything else at a fair pace. When reforming the books with no specific pattern, both the books he absorbed first encountered the jumbling issue.
He spoke quietly to himself “So it seems if I absorb a lot of books at a quick pace in my current state, I’m guessing, just like the brain, dark matter isn't able to handle the injection of knowledge in one go. I will definitely have to be careful concerning this…”
The second issue was a strange one Avrin would have to think even longer about. Of course he didn't know whether this had more of a negative or a positive impact towards him. The issue concerning the rest of the books, it seemed everything he had reformed, the contents of each had translated to the english language.
When he ate the object that allowed him to read a majority of things as well as understand the language of some races, he found his biggest issue was numbers, he couldn't understand them at all. When he read letters in his mind, as if naturally it translated it into english.
But this wasn't the case. The text and letters were in plain english, as if the dark matter had auto-translated it. Avrin bit his lip as he carefully re-absorbed the books in the same order as the first time, just incase something were to happen. He then spoke quietly to himself.
“If it translates unknown text into english..is it possible the tablet may be translated as well?” He shrugged this thought off as it was not worth the effort. He wasted no more time and decided to train his abilities some more in a sort of meditative, cross legged state. Before he attempted this amateurish meditation, to get his priorities straight, he thought to himself “In 4 hours I'll go buy supplies, then I will leave this town and head west. It’s best if I train myself in the mountains for a bit before i continue..” Avrin smirked to himself as he never knew the cliche mountain training tactic would become something useful in this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 31 Start of A Journey
chapters.content:
Special Release. Full Pr Credits toDraconis Von Bloodtrap Who made this Chapter possible with little to no grammatical errors. i would appreciate it if you guys gave him some rep for his trouble.
i intend to write atleast 2-3 raws tonight that way i can send them to Draconis for pring even though i msged him saying there may be a couple of weeks before i make more. i myself am starting to enjoy my story more and i get excited as i think of how i plan to progress things ^^
Please Rate/Follow/Favourite & Finally enjoy Ch 31. [th_0pride.gif]
-----------
Avrin had been in his cross legged position for a few hours now. He had formed several void bolts and began to split them into tiny spheres as he tried to control each one individually, of course he failed to control a few as they grew too many in number and too small in size for a non augmented eye to see. The ones that dropped onto the ground had vanished without damaging the floor.
Avrin also decided to practice augmenting his hands at a rapid pace to get used to the pain it was quite intense when it was forced but he knew in a life and death situation he couldn't be distracted by the thought of it. Someone may look at Avrin and think this training was useless but he considered every bit worth it. He had nothing else to do since he was waiting for the other books to sync with his body just like the fishing book he absorbed yesterday.
As dawn broke at 7:30am Avrin stood up before stretching, his body felt a little stiff but then the dark matter making up his body worked its healing properties and fixed the issue.
Avrin did not intend to spend another day in the village even though he had paid for several nights. Time was something he wanted to make use of. He intended to try and read the tablet once he got a fair distance away from the village as his curiosity was indeed peaked. Although unlike the 2 men in the bookshop Avrin knew obtaining the sky metal was bound to be a deadly task. He wondered why they were as arrogant as to assume it would be something easy.
As he walked out he noticed that the floor had a sweet scent, possibly washed recently. He grinned as he remembered the guard who vomited. As Avrin made his way downstairs he encountered the lady at the front desk who greeted him “Hello sir you are up quite early” she smiled before motioning around to which Avrin saw no one was up. He replied “Yes it seems I couldn't sleep well “ the lady nodded and sighed “I apologise about the commotion it seems the book store was robbed and the book keeper injured severely” she then whispered “I heard he lost an arm. What sort of a cruel monster would do such a thing?” Avrin couldn't help but roll his eyes under the protection of the cloaks hood. “I suppose. Oh yes, something came up so I must depart from this village..” The lady blinked and pouted sadly “I suppose that means you're after a refund?” Avrin laughed softly “Not at all, I enjoyed the meals here. This inn has earnt it.” At this point the lady gave a quiet cheer before looking behind Avrin and smiling. Avrin then looked to be welcomed by a happy voice “Sir Avrin! you also wake up at this time?.. “ It was none other than Larissa and Serena, the elves who Avrin seemed to find annoying considering that she looked like Syrana.
“This is a one time thing as I have to travel..” Larissa nodded and stretched “Did you also encounter the guards sir Avrin? The book keeper was attacked last night and had several things stolen.” The lady at the front desk replied “Ahh yes, I was just talking to him about that. I wonder who would do it. It must of been something important.” Larissa and the lady began to chat away while Avrin began to quietly walk off. He had no intention of staying more but he caught the elves’ attention as she cautiously gazed at him and whispered enough for him to hear.
“Avrin was it?.. If you have any ill intentions I recommend you do well to keep as far from Larissa and the others as possible...I won't hesitate to protect my comrades..” Avrin was taken aback by her words but only smiled. His lips revealed but his nose and higher hidden by the protection of the hood. “I dont have any intentions of seeing any of you again...do me the favor and keep yourselves from me…” He replied not hesitating to proclaim he didn't want to have anything to do with them.
Of course Serena let out a small grunt as she watched Avrin exit the building to which Larissa turned and called out “W..Wait sir Avr-” Before she could continue a voice was heard coming from upstairs and heading down. “Ahh I’m so hungry!!! those damn guards were so irritating…” It was none other than Jin following Aleyn and Meika. Aleyn sighed and responded. “If I hadn't stopped you, you would have sent one out of the window…” He noticed his sister and Serena and waved at them both.
He spoke out towards his sister “Larissa, are you and Serena heading out to buy supplies?” Larissa smiled and nodded as she had somewhat gotten over Avrin suddenly leaving “Mhm, brother are we also intending on visiting the shrine before we leave?”
Aleyn nodded “It’s only fair we pay our respects to the gods before we leave”
While the two chatted about, Jin and Meika went over to the tables waiting to make their orders. Serena was thinking of their course of actions and Larissa and Aleyn were speaking to the lady at the front desk.
Avrin was currently making his way down the street. It seemed the merchants were setting up their shops or already had them set. He could hear the whispers concerning the bookstore and decided to avoid its direction instead he went down the food market area to the west but not before something caught his eye. He went over to what seemed like an adventurer dealer who was selling an assortment of items. He noticed avrin and smiled.
“Hello sir, care to purchase some healing potions they only take 20 minutes to kick in. They were brewed by a master alchemist. For you, a first time customer, only 10 gold each.” Avrin somewhat scoffed at such a price. He then spoke to the dealer “I need something to carry supplies, food items, the lot..” He spoke with only one thing on his mind.
The man nodded and smiled while rubbing his hand and went over to the back of his makeshift store and pulled out what seemed like a large dark brown sack that had engravings that glowed over it. “This is an enchanted sack crafted by a master tailor using Demon Bear fur. It was also enchanted by a mage with an augmentation to allow it to carry nearly 10x its amount. Although the weight of the items still apply..”
Avrin was curious regarding this and spoke “Show me..” The merchant wasted no time to test it. He began putting in potions and all sort of items before Avrin told him to stop with a pleased look. Avrin went over to pick it up and felt it indeed had the accumulated weight of the items but it still didn't seem heavy for him. he looked inside the sack and saw that the items had all shrunk and emitted a low mana glow. He gazed at the man who seemed to look at Avrin worryingly.
“How much?” Avrin wanted this item as it would save some time and effort as well as fit in. Afterall, who would find a traveler with a magical carry sack with supplies. To them he may aswell be any other adventurer out there. The merchant grinned and spoke.
The tale has been stolen; if detected on Amazon, report the violation.
“Only 53 gold, first time customer price...I would usually sell these at 230 gold each but since this is also an older one that hadn't sold for awhile I figured I’d give it away at that price” Avrin saw no issue with this and reached into his current sack which would indeed cry at itself being replaced, if it could think.
After handing in the gold and watching the greedy merchant put it away he remembered something as he took the sack that was now emptied. “How much are mana potions?..” Avrin wanted to try another experiment but this time on himself. “Hmm... For you, 8 gold each for lesser potions. But they come in normal and greater ones aswell. Unfortunately I don't have anything of higher quality”
Avrin nodded it seemed like potions themselves were either expensive or this merchant just wanted to rip him off. “I’ll buy 5 lesser potions for 25 gold.” The merchant seemed to chuckle at Avrin’s offer but then widened his eyes as he began to see Avrin walk off “ W..Wait, please, how about 35 gold!!. “Avrin knew there were other potion merchants around and he was not at a loss other than time. But at that point he stopped as the merchant conceded as he was 2 meters away “O..Ok 25 gold coins…” He was on the verge of tears.
After a good half an hour Avrin had an enchanted sack with 5 lesser mana potions as well as a half a kilo of preserved meat and half a kilo of assorted fruits. He even had some vegetables. This was all he really needed, if push came to shove he had no issue making his own resources.
Avrin made his way out towards the west exit which seemed to have several guards checking bags. This wasn't the case when he arrived a couple of days ago, but it seemed like the book keeper had pleaded for assistance.
As Avrin approached the gate his bag was checked and he was let through. At that point he looked forward and noticed that the west seemed to have quite a bit of dense forest, but even more so mountainous terrain in the distance. To the sides of the path was farm land and on the path itself were merchant traders going back and forth.
Avrin began to journey towards the west. His intentions were to nurture his ability as well as train his body. In his universe training was essential for a soldier but Avrin had put the hard work aside, mostly due to having to deal with other issues. He had figured this was a sort of balance for the issue.
As he walked on for 20 minutes he could see the village become smaller and smaller as well as the people traversing the path become more distant as the gap was widened. Avrin made his way through. He then suddenly stopped as he looked over to his right side seeing what seemed like an old man wearing a somewhat torn cloak with a strange emblem on it and holding a cane that seemed to be made from some sort of wood.
His back was against a large oak like tree and surrounding him were 5 young individuals brandishing bandit like clothing as well as weapons. With his ears now augmented he over heard them.
“Old man, give up your belongings and you won't get hurt..” One young individual with a bald head spoke as he made a stabbing motion with his shabby dagger as if to threaten the old man.
Another man who had a near bald head spoke out. He looked more so like a perverted individual who would make even the fat lady scream. “And give up that kid behind ya...We can make quite a few gold coin off of it…”
“Kid?..” Avrin blinked before his eyes picked up a small figure half the size of the old man who was covered by a cloak with only his long white beard hanging out and his cane down with his hands on it. “Hmm” before he could think some more a voice rang out from the child “I'm not an it you perverted bastard! I’m a guy! I may look like a girl, but I'm a guy!!”
The bandit that had not been able to tell the child's gender referring to him as an it narrowed his eyes as he clenched his short sword “You little shit...What did you call me?…” The bandits began to get closer to the old man and the child who was hiding behind him backed towards the tree some more with the old man staying quiet. Avrin could be quite cruel sometimes when he wanted to achieve a goal, but seeing useless trash picking on the weak for scraps and with intention to become involved in slavery made even him feel somewhat sick.
He began to approach and called out towards the group of bandits. “Although I have seen many irritating issues as well as encountered problems in my lifetime… You are the lowest life form I have the displeasure of coming across.”
The bandits stopped as a few looked at him. One, who seemed to be burly, folded his arms looked behind his back and spoke to Avrin “Bastard, stay right there we will deal with you soon enough…” As the bandits chuckled and the leader looked back and Avrin sighed quietly.
He formed a void bolt in his right palm as the leader blinked to himself knowing something was wrong. He quickly unsheathed his claymore and slashed it downwards behind himself at the moment Avrin had indeed fired it towards him. the leader smirked as the bolt exploded into tiny spheres but his smile soon faded as avrin had stolen it.
the other bandits stopped to see that their leader was surrounded by several dozen one inch purple spheres that came out of the split void bolt. avrin spoke
“unfortunately for you, because of a certain whore I had developed this just incase something like this would happen in my current state…”
The leader nervously spoke “H..Hey lets talk this over...F..From the look of things you seem to be a skilled mage with some unique magic..W..We were just playing around with these two, we will leave...R..Right guys?..”
The other bandits nodded quietly knowing their leader and friend for years was in danger. The child came out to look from the quiet old mans side and seemed to watch in awe.
Avrin smiled to himself “Indeed you were… But just incase…” The several dozen spheres from that one void bolt began to spin in a circle around the man and then they all shot outwards at a frightening speed hitting the arms and legs of every bandit leaving large holes in the flesh or intensely painful bruises with black scorch marks that seemed to devour a bit and turn the flesh to ash.
as they screamed and fell to the ground in agony the old man didn't cover the child's eyes, infact he moved to the side as if telling him this is the world you will come to grow in. Avrin began to walk off as he had taken care of the issue. He was not seeking a reward, but rather having a personal obligation to help clean trash like this in some circumstances if he could.
At that point the old man and the child began to follow him back onto the path to which the man covered in the cloak spoke out. “Dear traveler, won't you please wait a moment?…”

chapters.title: Chapter 32 Conversation & Secrets
chapters.content:
Authors Note: After going over my current chapters i figured i could afford to spoil you guys again which is 50% of the reason for this. the other 50% is this is to put the final nail in hopes of getting 1k followers ^^ so this is a sort of celebration chapter.
im thankful to all my readers for helping spectral get this far lets also see if we can get 5 ratings to finally hit the 200 vote's mark ^^i hope you enjoy this ch it is my thanks to you guys.
Full Pr Credits to Draconis Von Bloodtrap Who made this Chapter possible with little to no grammatical errors. i would appreciate it if you guys gave him some rep for his trouble. -----------Avrin began walking down the path after having helped the man and the child. He had been thinking to himself prior to the old man telling him to stop. Avrin had managed to injure what could be said as human beings, half the reason for helping the two could be said as a further test for himself to see if he could injure people to a painful like degree. After what he did to the book keeper he wanted to try it again to see if he would get any emotional response. It seems he didn't. He wasn't sure if he simply was devoid of good feelings, not only was his body never urging for sexual interaction but it seemed in his mind he either lacked or did not have many base emotions.
Although Avrin's mindset was that of a human, which could be said as the most emotional creatures, this body was truly impressive and terrifying for it to somehow tamper with Avrin’s emotions. Could it be this body or is it truly the work of God. Avrin, of course, did not want to completely lack emotion, although he had bad memories regarding emotion’s such as sadness and anger he knew it also helped him become stronger such as motivation and happiness.
Afterall, who would want to live their life as a robot made of flesh and bone with no emotional attachments. He would definitely have to socialise more even if he found it somewhat annoying. It was for the purpose of his advancement to Godhood.
Avrin blinked as he snapped out of his pondering trance at the sound of a voice that did not belong to the child. As he turned he noticed the old man was 2 meters behind him. Avrin kept quiet as he wondered what he wanted. Could it be a reward? He thought curiously to himself until the man then spoke.
“Traveller you are indeed strong...I can see you have quite a rich vein of untapped power…” The old man snickered to himself but not in a way that was creepy so to speak, but more so interesting. Avrin replied “You seem to have a keen sense. That or you talk good as to achieve something” Avrin spoke which would somewhat translate to you either have a good eye or you are sucking up to me sort of manner. The man then chuckled quietly before nodding to Avrin even as the child hid behind him while gazing at Avrin with awe. “Dear traveller, would it be of much trouble for you to escort me and my grandson to our home in the western region? It seems like the direction you are heading.” “Indeed it is” Avrin spoke right after the old man finished then continued to speak. “I suppose it wouldn't be impossible for me to do so. Well then, very well. Do you have supplies with you?” The man nodded and pointed to a tree which had a bag laying underneath that seemed very well made from what seemed like expensive materials. It had a blue covering as well as what seemed like an orange furred lining and a black base.
Avrin figured that if they carried something that looked expensive its no wonder the bandits would want to rob them even more so. as the child went over to retrieve the supplies the man smiled at avrin as he walked a half meter behind him “what is your name adventurer?” it seemed like traveller was now adventurer. possibly a meaningless change as they both were the same thing so to speak.
“Avrin.” He spoke as the boy returned and the three of them began to travel down the western pass. It was still quite early in the morning, the thought came across his mind as to where these two are from. “Avrin, quite a unique name. I am Shimaru and this here is my grandson” The child then spoke out with a burst of energy “My name is Amias, heir to the Whi-..” Before he finished the grandfather had given him a light hit on the hit not as to hurt the child but as to tell him to stop talking.
“I do apologise, my grandson can be quite chatty ho ho ho!” He gave a deep somewhat forced laugh as the grandson rubbed his head quietly pouting. Avrin figured the boy was indeed important. It didn't take a genius to hear the words heir and not come to a conclusion of importance.
“Sir Avrin, where are you headed? Where are you from?” Shimaru asked Avrin curiously “I intend to enter the western mountain range to train for a while. As for where I am from.” Avrin tapped into his current knowledge and spoke as he came with an idea “The western continent” Shimaru let out a oooh sort of sound before smiling “Ahh that explains it, you're a demon. No wonder you are so powerful. Indeed your race is quite interesting”
Although Avrin wasn't a demon he wondered why this human didn’t somewhat persecute him. In the village, he didn't see any demons and was curious as to why this man was at ease. Unless the reason was because Avrin saved his life.
“Sir Avrin is indeed strong. Those bandits didn't stand a chance against those black orbs of doom“ The child made a gesture as if fiddling with the air trying to recreate the scene. It was somewhat cute but Avrin shrugged the thought aside.
he had his own questions and decided to speak before Shimaru did. At this point they had been walking for several hours and Avrin was surprised at their stamina “So Shimaru, hat is it you and Amias were doing. Weren’t your intentions to go to the village?”
Shimaru shook his head “Not at all. We often adventure away from our home. I do it more for my grandsons sake, he doesn't often get to go outside due to my son’s strictness” He spoke as he patted Amia's head.
Avrin smiled softly to himself. The bond between family was truly something to behold. He wondered what it would have been like if he had a father figure growing up. “Sir Avrin, you're an adventurer right?” Amias spoke out, as the two men were quiet, he had a chance to ask. “I suppose I am” Avrin spoke before stopping and gazing around. It wasn't to long that they had entered a forest as the path followed inside but something in the air seemed strange.
it seems Shimaru had already acted without Avrin needing to tell him as he grabbed amias who wondered why they had stopped and held tightly as if to defend him.
“Both of you stay near me..” Avrin spoke. He didn't know why he was inclined to protect them both, it wasn't as if he would benefit from it. But he realised it was his humanity coming into play. It seemed on the inside he lacked emotion, but it wasn't true. He still had some left.
From the surrounding bushes and dense forest, everything around them became quiet. Avrin augmented an eye and looked around. “Figures…” Avrin spoke in an annoyed tone. “18 of them, all humans”
Shimaru gazed at Avrin, somewhat surprised. He didn’t expect him to even know how many individuals there were. That was usually a skill only grand master’s and higher were capable of knowing without using a magic to identify them, and even then such magic required casting time. Little did he know Avrin had a way around it.
Avrin, personally, was nervous and excited. It would be his first proper battle with humanoid individuals. The last encounter he considered a test and he didn't bother counting in the mindless animals. This was a battle with thinking individuals.
Unauthorized usage: this tale is on Amazon without the author's consent. Report any sightings.
At that moment they all came rushing out. Avrin removed his eye augmentation and created a void blade out of what seemed like thin air. This caused the men to stop for a moment and readjust there tactic. “H...Hey, did he just create a weapon?...Isn't that something only experts know how to do?.. “ Another spoke out “Shit...It doesn't matter. Get them before they get us!” One called out as if rallying the others and they continued their failed ambush.
“Idiots…” Avrin spoke. “When you ambush someone don't stop half way.” As the first man approached and swung his sword towards Avrin, who purposely let him get close as if to test his reflexes, Avrin sidestepped and twisted his body before slashing towards the man's abdomen with the void blade which cleanly disintegrated the ragged leather clothing as it had the signature black ash eating it away. But what was more devastating was the painful gash that was across his stomach. His innards felt as if they were going to explode as the man cried out in agony. Avrin then slashed down across the mans neck with the void blade as if to end his misery.
As the head came off somewhat cleanly and the body fell limp with blood oozing, Shimaru, who quietly watched, covered his grandsons eyes. This was a different scene than what had occurred earlier.
Avrin on the other hand had forgotten the two. It seems his own life came first and he somewhat drifted from the two who stood still. As another man thrusted a large pike towards Avrin, Avrin grabbed the tip with a quickly augmented hand and snapped it off before throwing the now sharp object towards the man who had his head impaled by the tip of the pike. He fell limp as his corpse twisted a bit before falling down. Avrin was surprised his head didn't explode.
“I feel so bad at this…” Avrin sighed quietly, knowing his own movements lacked any expertise. But it was enough to deal with them. The bandits stopped for a moment and surrounded Avrin and one spoke out “We’ll get him together...This bastard will get him and hang his innards from the trees” One bald man spoke. He looked as if he were a skeleton.
Avrin smirked to himself before the void blade reformed into a sphere that was 5x5 inches in diameter “Your welcome to try..” Avrin also trained some martial arts in his past life and wanted to see how well it would fair in some circumstances. But he knew it wasn't the right time because one wrong move and he would die.
Without warning the bandits looked at each other and rushed in towards Avrin. 3 meters away in all directions was the distance. Avrin looked around before raising the sphere above his head and willed it to implode. Of course Avrin was not as skilled as to turn it into an attack but what came out was a nebula mist that began to spread. Avrin used this chance to augment his leg’s as the bandits gazed at the mist with worry.
“I..Is it a poison cloud?..” One spoke out nervously “Shit...Should we retreat?..” ”Get your bows out you idiots! Get the two over there, we’ll use them as hostages…” One which seemed like the leader spoke.
At that moment as a few began to go towards Shimaru and Amias and a few more began to take their bows out. Avrin dashed out of the mist towards one bandit and plowed his fist into the side of his head. A gruesome crunching sound could be heard before the bandit flew several meters and hit a tree. Avrin was surprised as his hand wasn't even augmented but grinned as he was satisfied with his speed.
Avrin looked at the bandits who stopped for a second before they quickly tried to load their bows. “Oh no you don't..” Avrin, forgetting about the ones heading towards the two individuals who traveled with him, went on to attack the bandits. Using the strength of the body and the speed of the augment to decimate his foes.
The bandits which closed in on Shimaru then grinned “Come here ya bastard….Give us that child would you” Shimaru smirked and raised his cane, pointing it towards the man. “Sir I think your arm is missing…”
“huh?.” The bandit stopped and gazed to see his arms were still intact “What are yo-..” At that moment Shimaru appeared in front of him as he moved the cane up under his arm as it effortlessly sliced through his right arm as if he weren't even trying. The other bandit gazed in horror and tried to attack Shimaru but was met with his own demise.
The back of a bandit’s body had a dagger that resembled a kunai jammed into it. He turned weakly as he tried to reach and take it out. Shimaru gazed at Amias who smiled nervously and spoke “O..Oh he didn't die…” The bandit showed a dangerous expression. “You little shi..” just like his friend before he finished he had lost a body part. although this time it was his head.
“Amias I've told you many times to not interfere in your grandfathers affairs..” Amias pouted quietly “Sorry grandfather” Shimaru then went over and removed the kunai from the mans back before wiping it clean and gazing at Avrin who seemed to be to focused on killing the others instead of paying them attention.
Shimaru thought to himself “-Hmmm... He is indeed interesting. I can't recall ever seeing the magic he has used before, even if he is a demon. His footwork is beyond crap and his attacks seemed to be on instinct without precision. Interesting, I’m sure he would make a fine Shinobi if trained properly-”
Avrin had been attacking the bandits as a few more even came out of the bushes. Although he was fast his movements were still somewhat predictable. A few bandits managed to land some hits on him as well as an arrow jammed in his back, although to Avrin who had a body with the potential to rival gods it was already at work with healing the wounds.
Avrin finished up the final bandits as he panted not from exhaustion but from some pain and irritation. “I..really need to train myself… The sooner I get to the mountains the better. I wonder if there are more bandits around”..
around avrin as well as the area were corpses with blood oozing all over the ground as well as the stench of death and there innards spilling out. Sooner or later wild beasts will want to come feast on this laid out buffet.
Avrin reached over and grabbed the arrow, pulling it out with a slightly painful tug. But he was somewhat surprised when he noticed that the dark matter in his body was eating away at it and converting it to seal his wound. infact when avrin pulled the arrow out like that it had re-opened the wound just as if one would tear open stitches.
avrin blinked as he remembered something. “Are you both ok?!” He quickly turned to see two corpses near the two. Although Avrin couldnt remember killing anyone near them. Avrin gazed to see Shimaru in his calm mannered pose with his cane while Amias was in a sort of cheering pose. Avrin raised a brow as his cloak was covered in blood as well as his face. He was gazing at Shimaru. “He is hiding something from me….”

chapters.title: Chapter 33 The White Dragon Clan
chapters.content:

Avrin was skeptical regarding these two, but decided to forget about it. He was sure they had their reasons for not telling him. But he would keep an eye on them just incase. ”Avrin, I believe it is best to leave. I’m sure many wild beasts have already smelled the blood in the air and there may be more bandits”
Shimaru was right, Avrin thought. He nodded and began to walk off as he ignored the wound on his back as it seemed to heal. His body’s natural durability was also surprising at the very least. The arrow piercing an inch into his back didn't hurt as much as he figured it would. Of course this is coming from a general who had been injured many times in the past. This was little to nothing to him.
And even though Avrin was obviously injured in the eyes of the two he seemed to walk as if it wasn't the case at all. Amias spoke “Wow sir Avrin, you took an arrow and your walking as if its nothing! Do you have special mail under your robe?” Avrin shook his head “None of the sort..” Avrin wiped the blood from his face using a cloth from his carry sack.
Shimaru didn't expect avrin to catch onto him and his grandsons ability and didn't pursue it. But he spoke “Avrin, have you ever considered joining a dojo or an academy of sorts before?” Avrin’s ears perked slightly as the conversation as finally about something interesting to him.
“I've considered it but I would prefer to train myself a bit. I am not confident in my martial arts ability. If it wasn't for my power im sure I would be dead without killing even one of those bandits. “
“-power?-” Shimaru thought to himself curiously and spoke as he had figured as much “Ahh I see. Then Avrin you are indeed one with Enigmatic abilities. “ Avrin nodded as he figured it would sooner or later be exposed as the old man picked up on small details easily. “That I am.” 
“Ho ho ho! To think I would meet one in my lifetime, the Gods are truly smiling upon me with their generosity today” Avrin didn't reply to the old man's self delusions. Avrin knew the Gods here existed, but to him, after speaking to the one who truly was considered God these were nothing but amebas compared to him. That being said, Avrin still wanted to achieve the pinnacle of power which was on their level even if he himself at the moment was less than an ameba compared to God.
Avrin was starting to feel his wound was healing better. Probably because he tried to focus the dark matter inside his body on the wound, a small augmentation over the injury as if to test how it would deal with it. And surprisingly it was effective.
Although Avrin would still need to change clothing later on. It seemed like the black leather/fur outfit underneath was also damaged and didn't have enough durability to withstand the arrow, but Avrin was sure it helped with stopping it going deeper. At this point Avrin stopped for a moment and looked around.
“Lets rest here for awhile…” Shimaru and Amias both joyfully went over, following Avrin to a small clearing on the side.
“I'll be scouting ahead a bit. Stay here.” Amias stood up and spoke “But sir Avrin, please let me hel-.” Shimaru gave Amias a lit hit on the head yet again. Amias pouted and quietly sat down “N..Never mind”.
Avrin gazed at Shimaru and they both nodded towards each other to which Avrin headed off into the forest. After he was 3 minutes in, he could see it was quite lush and abundant with life.
He found a small corner that was hidden from view and removed his cloak as well as outfit and examined it. He wore a white undershirt that was similar to the somewhat skin tight outfits they wore in the military where he came from.
He gazed at the tear as well as the blood and began to emit nebula mist around both the tears in the cloak, he also covered over the blood that was soaking them both. “That man is hiding something, but what is it...I was sure he wasn't capable of defending himself but those two corpses….From a glance they seemed to be dispatched easily..” Avrin began to think as he repaired his equipment. The nebula mist was eating away at the blood, turning it into small particles of matter. And the tear in the cloak as well as the top seemed to repair itself as if the dark matter itself was used as fabric replacement.
The wound on Avrin’s back was all but healed. But he was certain that it wouldnt mean much with his current strength level. If he met an expert, they would most likely be capable of killing him in a few seconds.
As Avrin finished repairing his equipment, he began to head back to where the makeshift rest site was. But not after pulling out a chunk of dried jerky and eating it on the way.
As he arrived he saw Amias doing push ups and Shimaru over a pot which seemed to have an aromatic smell emanating from it.
“Ahh Avrin, welcome back. Hopefully things ahead are good?“ Shimaru spoke to which Avrin nodded. “Doesn't seem like any creatures are in front of us. I’m sure the ones behind are too busy eating away at those remains, so I’m not worried about that.”
“Sir Avrin, can you teach me the magic you use?.” Not only avrin but Shimaru was somewhat stunned at those sudden words. Avrin’s eyes twitched a bit under his hood as he thought to himself “-Not even if my life depended on it.-” Avrin smiled and spoke out to him then “Sorry Amias, this ability isn't capable of being taught, and I don't think I would make a great teacher.”
Avrin’s words might have been considered a lie, but Amias wasn't an idiot and could tell the tone he spoke in was a -no- sort. So he nodded and sighed. “That’s fine. I'm sure I'll learn magic one day” Amias spoke to which Shikamaru replied “I’m sure you will. Maybe we can convince that father of yours to let you become a mage instead” He spoke as he stirred the pot.
Things went smoothly for a half hour and they finished up and things were packed. “Avrin, we are nearing the a forked road. The left path leads to our home while the right leads to the mountains where you would be free to train.”
Avrin nodded and smiled to himself as he was getting closer to breaking out of his weak level. Maybe when he got stronger and was sure in his strength he would join an academy. “Of course sir Avrin, if it is ok with you, I would like you to come with us. I want to reward you as well as offer you something you will find quite useful”
Avrin’s interest yet again was piqued. It would indeed be fair for him to receive a reward. Then again, he was certain that Shimaru was lying to him. What was stopping him from trapping Avrin like the sylphs and finding someone to sell him to as a slave.
As they continued further down the road Avrin had told Shimaru he would think about it. But ever since he spoke that, he had a feeling of worry. As if they were being watched. This was confirmed when he augmented his eye he noticed several humanoids dashing around like mad acrobats across the trees. Their mana seemed small, but Avrin guessed these were experts who tried to hide it.
Avrin wondered if these were a higher tier of bandits after revenge. Shimaru seemed to stop and Avrin stopped to as he turned back “Is something wrong?” Avrin spoke softly.
Amias seemed to be casual and didn't mind as he looked around, but Shimaru then called out “You all need more training, you make as much noise as a dying Leophat” Shimaru called out to which Avrin blinked. It seemed this man was indeed holding out on him. Even Avrin could barely hear them without augmenting his ears. In a swift moment, 5 black blurs dashed across the path. Avrin could barely notice 4 of them with his right eye which was not augmented but the 5th one which came from the left, he didn't notice at all. Even with the augmented eye. 4 individuals clad in black and purple attire quickly rushed in a line and kneeled down in front of Shimaru and spoke in sync “Welcome back Elder and young master” While the 5th one appeared behind Avrin and held a large kunai like blade to his throat
This tale has been unlawfully lifted from ; report any instances of this story if found elsewhere.
“Grandfather….Who is this man?...” A young sweet voice sounded out. It was strong, yet feminine. Avrin would feel reassured if she had a scent but he couldn't even smell that. The only thought that came to his mind was one word “Ninjas?...” He was stunned. In a world such as this, the possibility of ninjas/shinobis would be high, but out of all the times, he had to meet them now.
And even more so the 4 in front of him were kneeling in front of Shimaru with Amias beside him. Avrin dared not move an inch even as the blade gave a slight cut against his throat with his red blood dripping down across its stainless edge.
Shimaru called out “Ayame, lower your weapon…” The female snorted quietly and spoke “This man knows of our existence, he shouldn't be allowed to live…” Shimaru glared as he emitted a baleful aura that engulfed Ayama. But even Avrin felt it. Such a powerful aura from a man that could easily kill him within the blink of an eye. One of a killer’s. Ayame shuddered and backed off as she panted and kneeled down “F..Forgive my insolence grandfather…”
Shimaru relaxed then gazed at Avrin “I suppose I owe you an explanation, but we should head to the estate first first…” The 8 individuals began to walk towards the left path. It didn't seem like Avrin had much of a choice in the matter. Then again it would be interesting to hear things out. The 8 began to travel down the left path before going off it and turning left even more so. After continuing on they reached a large arch entrance made of wood and entered. The 4 ninjas left after Ayame told them to leave.
Ayame also gazed at Avrin as if trying to figure out what was so special about him. She really wanted him gone. Avrin would be happy to oblige as he had no reason to stay.
“Ayama take Amias to his father. I need to speak with my guest” Ayame bowed respectfully “Yes grandfather” She then gazed at Amias and glared to which Amias began to sweat a bit. She went over and grabbed him by the ear and began to pull him off while calling out “You didn't wash the dishes before you left. I knew you would pull some cheap trick like that.” Amias had an almost pitiful expression “ow ow OW! Sorry sorry sorry!!” Even as their voices faded as they left Shimaru smirked and entered a large dojo like building which seemed to be guarded by several people who didn't wear that ninja equipment. But this was a more oriental style of clothing between chinese and japanese.
Before avrin went inside he took another look at the other buildings. One was an incredibly large mansion which had servants tending the front yard, the others seemed like miniature dojo like buildings such as this one.
Avrin entered the building and looked around, still quiet after he nearly had his throat slit by Ayame. “I apologise for everything Avrin.” Shimaru removed his cloak to reveal his appearance. He had a long white beard and wore what seemed like a hakama. He also had a patch of white hair in the form of a ponytail like an old style samurai would. His face seemed to have a few scars and his chest, which was somewhat revealed, had scars as well but also showed the incredible amount of muscle he had for his age.
Shimaru sat down cross legged and gazed at Avrin. To whom went over and sat down 4 meters in front of him. Avrin was more awkward then nervous, if he didn't know better he could have sworn he was on earth in a dojo. “Shimaru, what is the meaning of all this….”
Shimaru chuckled quietly “Ho ho ho!. I’m truly sorry Avrin, I didn't know my granddaughter would cause such a commotion. I had intended to allow things to transition better. But as you have already seen it couldn't be avoided.”
Apart from his cliche Santa like laugh, Avrin was starting to become annoyed with him. He felt as if he was being toyed with. “Then if things are settled I should take my leave…” Right before Avrin was about to stand Shimaru spoke “Avrin, you are indeed unique. The potential you have is incredible. I promised you a reward and a reward I shall give” At this point things were starting to sound a little better and he sat back down. “Very well” Shimaru smiled and spoke again “My people come from the northern continent, the empire-less continent where people are free to do as they please. In the eastern part of that continent, a culture was born where they trained in ways never seen before on Seleria. This culture believed that magic alone could not guarantee survival in the wilds and in battle. One needed to be flexible and strong in heart, mind, and soul. Move like the wind and be as silent as a leaf floating off a tree. To be one with nature while still retaining their deadliness..”
Avrin was starting to think he was being given a history lesson as a reward. Then again, it is not like he needed anything. And information was always good, especially the words empire-less northern continent. From what he already knew, it had no ruler and everything was set by its inhabitants. A candidate for a future empire, but that thought was for another day. Avrin continued to listen.
“This culture had many enemies who would want to steal its secrets. Mages who would be as deadly as assassins, warriors with their already brute strength who could move like the wind and have the agility of rogues. This culture could be capable of allowing such methods. And people wanted it to strengthen their own army...Especially during the first great war.
After the demons invaded and attacked us we could not match up to their magic and they nearly destroyed our culture… With remnants my forefathers spread like nomads throughout the northern continent, but no one would help us, which is when we came here after the sylph offered us assistance. And from then on out Agrianea became our home with only the leaders of the sylph and a few others knowing our existence. This way we were able to practice our martial art. Our clan, the White Dragon Clan, has been able to develope Shadow Kill Techniques, ever since the northern continent of Ailera till now we have honed this technique to protect us and destroy our enemies.
Avrin was skeptical regarding all this. Surely something great wouldn't be all that impressive if demons using magic was able to destroy them.
“Avrin, what I forgot to mention was that, although our culture lost against the demons, our warriors without the help of angels were able to kill many of them in the process...They didn't expect us humans to be strong but we fought back. Even though I know you are a demon, I hope my low grudge doesn't deter you from believing me”.
Avrin remembered he mentioned he was a demon, so he was in a situation at the moment. It seems all this man did was tell him a summary of his culture and its history up until how they got here. “I am thankful for this information you have given me Shimaru. Then if this is my reward, I would like to leave now”
Shimaru shook his head “Avrin, I would have liked you to know this cultures existence before I offered the real reward. Avrin, I would like you to train here under the guidance of the White Dragon Clan. I can promise you one year of training will be worth 5 years of training in the mountains under my personal guidance.”
Quiet is what was heard in the room as Avrin gazed at him from under his hood. He pondered the situation. Although he had lied to him before, Avrin knew he wasn't lying now. It would be more convenient. Then again, he knew nothing about the people in this clan, and that Ayame girl wanted him dead. Was his safety even guaranteed?

When thinking about the situation Avrin was in, it wasn't as bad as one would think. In fact, you could say it was a rare opportunity. He intended to learn a form of martial arts and this just so happen to fit into place. He knew it wasn't God's work by bending fate for him, it wouldn't be fair, as God would say.
Avrin was quiet for a moment and an eager look appeared on Shimaru’s face. This man, in his own right, is more powerful than Avrin and could be said to rival many great masters.
To have him on the level of wanting to take in some stranger he had only met the same day was unheard of, but it was even more proof regarding Avrin’s potential.
Avrin was more so interested in how this man managed to tell that he had enough said potential to make him want to take him in. Were all powerful masters and highers this perceptive? He pondered before gazing at Shimaru.
“If its ok with you, I’d like time to think this through. Although this is a rare chance for an individual like myself, it would be unwise of me to jump the gun on this.”
“Jump the gun?” Shimaru gazed at Avrin confused, before Avrin chuckled quietly “Hmm its an expression I use. It means to rush something without looking and thinking” Here, Shimaru seemed like he was being taught by Avrin so he chuckled at this and smiled.
“Very well Avrin, I am in no rush. I didn't expect you to decide right away so this is good. I assume you will need to stay here to come to a conclusion, so I will arrange a room for you.” Avrin smiled and replied “That would be best, thank you. I myself am somewhat tired after today’s trip. We only had a small break after all”
Shimaru raised his hand and clicked his fingers to which the sliding door outside opened and behind it was a maid wearing a sort of kimono, but it had a unique design as if it was something a female maid would wear. A sort of english design
“Take my guest to the furthest room in the right wing of the mansion. He is not to be disturbed and you are to treat him with respect, as if he were a priority clan member. The servant was somewhat shocked. In all her life, she had rarely, if not ever seen the elder treat someone with such importance other than sylph guest’s of honor.
The servant nodded and stood up as she spoke “Honored guest, please follow me.” Avrin stood up after giving a slight bow towards Shimaru who then spoke “Avrin, a few things. My son, like my granddaughter, is skeptical of outsiders.
I only ask that you behave yourself. Although I am the elder, he is the clan leader now, and my words go only so far. As long as things are kept well nothing bad will befall you.”
“I'll try my best” Avrin spoke with a smile, his hood still covering his face. Shimaru was curious as to why he had covered himself so protectively. Not once has he seen his face and he would curse a lesser man for being disrespectful. But he knew Avrin had his reasons.
“I look forward to our meeting again. I am curious about your enigmatic abilities” Shimaru called out just as Avrin left and the servant bowed before sliding the door closed leaving the man alone cross legged.
“Calias you know how I dislike people eavesdropping..” A shadow formed in the corner of the room. From the shadow, a tall man wearing what seemed like decorated basic shinobi attire walked closer with his hands behind his back. He gave a soft smile before speaking “Father, I couldn't help myself.
You seem to hold this individual in high regard. I haven't seen you this easy going in all my life, even when I was considered a genius to the others and even ended up taking over the clan”
Shimaru stood up and walked over to a miniature shrine of worship that was dedicated to all the gods of seleria and he began to pray in his mind while speaking “There is always something more skilled than you. And this individual, I feel he has a great future ahead of him. Something tells me i should assist him in any way I possibly can…”
Calias, who is the leader of the White Dragon clan after taking over the position from Shimaru, glared quietly as his fists were clenched behind his back “Elder, I should say. Regardless of who he is, if I see he endangers the clan I won't hesitate to kill him.. So I ask you keep your little hobby to yourself..”
Shimaru chuckled quietly before emitting a dangerous killing intent that made Calias unsheathe a hidden weapon. And he seemed to have sweat a little. Shimaru then spoke with a laughing tone “You still fear this old man...So I ask you to know your place…” The aura dissipated before Calias cleared his throat and bowed quietly before leaving without uttering a word. But a look of disdain was upon his face.
Avrin was being led towards the main building which was a large mansion. As he looked around, he came to appreciate how things were built and designed. It gave him memories from when he often went to planets where colonies were happily established. And that managed to terraform planets to become as close to earth as possible.
This was also an extra good thing because he knew he was feeling more emotional responses. He thought they were closed off due to this body but it didn't seem to be the case. He wondered if it was possibly himself as an individual who needed to adapt outside and inside to this planet. He snapped out of his quiet trance and by the time he did he was already walking inside the entrance of the large building.
He blinked, as he gazed in silent awe, the maid continued and he followed with only slight hesitation. The interior of the mansion was astounding, it had many weapons from great swords to katana shaped swords decorating the walls under pictures with what seemed like title plaques. Possibly weapons belonging to special individuals who died in battle or by natural causes.
Avrin spoke towards the servant “You must have quite a lot of people living inside here” To which the female servant replied “Oh no sir Avrin, only the main clan members are allowed in this building. The others are all set in the homes you have seen outside”
Avrin blinked for a bit before thinking to himself “-If those dojo like buildings were homes, then I guess the way of life is simpler here-”
As Avrin admired more of the interior, he was led down the right side of the hall after going up a fairly long flight of stairs in the middle of the building. This clan was mind boggling, they had a mix of several eastern and western influences in themselves and it was definitely shown in the buildings as well as the way of life.
He occasionally came across servants cleaning or fixing things, but then he had his eye sight stopped by an individual who quickly ran up to him and called out “Avrin! Avrin!” The young voice sounded out before smirking and smiling up at Avrin
“I finally finished up my chores. Do you want to come train with me? If you're here it means grandfather let you stay to train right?” This boy was pretty good at guessing, Avrin thought.
“Indeed, but I am still thinking about it” Amias smiled and folded his arms “Aw come on I'm sure you want to learn how amazing our techniques are! We are the strongest assassins out there!”
The female servant cleared her throat and smiled softly “Young Master, please be more appropriate around the honored guest” Amias pouted and sighed “Fine. You may be one of the strongest but still if you can train here it would be awesome! we can spar together to and go hunting!”
This story originates from a different website. Ensure the author gets the support they deserve by reading it there.
This boy seemed to have taken a liking to Avrin for some apparent reason. Avrin wondered if he didn't have any other friends his age or any elder brothers to play with. He seemed irritating but this was how a child his age would usually act “I'll think about it, I still have my own intentions.”
Amias grinned and leaned in and whispered “If you stay I’ll let you grope my sisters brea-- OW!!” Before he could finish his ear was tugged on enough to make it red “Grope whose sister?” It was Ayame in a more casual outfit wearing a somewhat tight kimono with a sash around the upper middle section of her body which made her breasts seem quite larger than they would usually look. It was decorated with what seemed like yellow and blue flowers in a snowfall pattern.
Avrin could easily compare her to larissa and it made him stare for a moment to wonder if this was the same girl that had nearly slit his throat before. “S..Sorry, I’m sorry sis. I didn’t mean it!! “ Amias whimpered as he tried to plead with his sister who just glared evilly at him “I’ll forgive you if you go clean up the main dojo with the others…”
Amias nodded gently as to not make the tug any worse and Ayame let go before Amias rubbed his ear almost tearing up as he bowed to Avrin, feeling embarrassed before heading off.
“And you...I don't know what you're doing here….But whatever grandfather has planned for you I'm against it...Outsiders are no good and are always after our techniques for their own gain”
Avrin was stumped and the female servant began trying to plead with Ayame who seemed to fold her arms under her bust which seemed to fit perfectly. This girl truly hated him, but he found it was somewhat cute to be able to annoy someone such as her without doing anything wrong. Must be a gift of sorts.
“I apologise. Ayame was it? But I haven't made my decision yet. Although I just might take up your grandfathers offer so that I may show you I am not a bad person.” Avrin gave a grin which was visible under his hood and Ayame knew his intention was to annoy her.
“Y..You little...” Before she could do anything, with the servant trying to stop her, a voice spoke out “Ayame that’s enough… Grandfathers business is none of your concern” A more mature feminine voice called out and both Ayame and Avrin turned behind to see a female wearing a dress.
She resembled Ayame slightly but had a more mature look to her. If Ayame was an athletic looking individual with a fair body and a gifted bust with green eyes and long golden blonde hair that was untied with a fair looking complexion.
This female seemed to have the body of a model with a significantly larger bust than Ayame that she didn't seem ashamed to show. Her hair was a more light blonde then Ayame’s and she had a beauty spot on her right cheek beside her lips. Her eyes were an azure blue and she had the gaze a man would face an army to reach.
Of course this was all Avrin could tell as the dress covered the bottom half of her body well, but her upper half didn't seem restricted by a corset and it all seemed natural. The female then spoke as she approached Avrin and smiled. Avrin stood his ground and gazed with a somewhat interested look.
“Besides she grinned as she placed her hand on Avrins chest. this man looks too delicious to let go so soon.” She licked her lips while gazing at Avrin seductively. Avrin only moved his head back as if disgusted by this woman's show of heat.
“Izanami must you be so lustful…” Ayame’s face was somewhat red from this womens show of interest towards Avrin “I don't think he is that special, you don't even know what he looks like and your fawning over him…
Avrin took a step back from the lustful female, he wouldn't have any trouble calling her a succubus, and made his way towards the female servant “Would you please show me the way to my room...I’m quite tired”
As Izanami pouted in a slight whimper as her advances didn't work, Ayame glared quietly at Avrin while the female servant nodded and bowed to the two before taking Avrin away towards his room.
“Sister…” Izanami spoke towards Ayame which confirmed the two were sisters “You should be careful. That man, like grandfather said, definitely has potential.. I have never come across a man who has denied my advances so blatantly.” “Probably because you smell like dozens of other men… “
Ayame huffed and turned away as if disgusted by her. To which Izanami grinned and made her way behind Ayame, her hands slipping over and groping her breasts tightly.
“Awww you’re so cute when you're jealous!” She wiggled her body against her while Ayame tried to get away while squealing. Her face was a deep red.
After 20 minutes had passed, Avrin had finally made it to his room and was sitting on the bed that seemed fairly large. He didn't hesitate to remove his cloak after locking the door prior to sitting on the bed.
“I must say, they are quite a lively bunch. You wouldn't think they were a clan of martial artists with killing techniques.”
Avrin lay on the bed and closed his eyes a bit. He had been awake for quite a long time and was feeling a little fatigued, so he was happy at how strong this body was with little training managed to go.
(PR Note: Not sure what to do with this so I'll just leave it)
He decided to take a nap. He removed his black attire leaving only the tight undershirt and pants he had on already and laid down on the bed letting out a sigh of relaxation.
“This offer is too good to pass up. I'm in no rush. My only worry is they have an incredibly close relationship with the sylph, so knowing my luck that bitch may show up” He spoke notioning to Syrana. He grinned to himself which was quite rare. He remembered the time he escaped and felt himself lucky, but soon he fell asleep as if his body knew it was time which was convenient.
And as fast as he fell asleep his mind awoke in an unfamiliar location. What seemed like a large rectangular shaped tome which was flying through something that seemed like a wormhole. In the middle was a table with a cup of coffee and an individual holding up a newspaper. Of course this individual was unmistakable due to his appearance.
Avrin chuckled to himself before kneeling almost sarcastically “Oh great creator why has thee summoned your humble servant “ He smiled. It was one thing for Avrin to act the way he did due to his personality, but this person in front of him was God. Just being in the presence of this being was enough to make people insane and change in a heartbeat so this could be considered normal.
The other thing was being sarcastic and rude towards God may not be such a smart thing. “Oh Avrin, I thought you may be a little stumped on what to do on Seleria.” God lowered the newspaper and placed his hands on his lap. His skin still had that somewhat transparent featureless cosmic look.
Avrin stood up and made his way to the table as he stood in front of it. “I decided I want to be...a god”
“Oohhhh” God himself raised his hand and clapped since he wasn't using his omnipotent ability to see the future as to make things more interesting. This was something he was glad to hear. “You know on earth when people would worship others apart from me, I would send plagues or deadly events to teach them a lesson“ He said almost with a snicker.
Avrins eye brow worryingly twitched “No doubt.” Avrin spoke and God replied
“But I guess to commemorate you finding your so called path in destiny, I will give you some advice on your race as well as being a so called “god” “ He said while raising his hand using the quote gesture.
