“Avrin, lets start with what you are” In an instant the table vanished and god was in front of a white board with what seemed like a humanoid drawing with half of having its organs and such revealed. God had a pointing stick as he pointed to it.
“You are a Spectral, this refers to a phantom, ghost, shadowy, incorporeal, but I picked it based on two things. One is it also means otherworldly, which I think suited you well, and the other being a secret you will find out on your own.
Being what you are, I made it so your body can stay up at much longer durations than a normal creature on Seleria would be used to, but when you do need to rest it is the minimum 8 hours required. “
Avrin listened intently. The reason was because there was no other being in existence that could tell him what God was telling him now. He would never find or discover this information unless he found out himself. God continued on.
“This body of yours also works hand in hand with dark matter. It doesn't produce mana and uses dark matter instead. In a video game that is black and white, imagine having that one character that is 3d and coloured inside of it. 
That is what you are like in this universe.”
Avrin spoke out, this somewhat confused him. He didn't see this as some important piece of information, more like unusual and random facts. But he figured every bit counted.
“As a Spectral you're capable of racial abilities and traits. I will give you a clue for one of each. One of your racial abilities allows you to do more with your eyes other than augmenting them. And a trait allows your body to be somewhat sentient to a degree”
Avrin was somewhat surprised. His eyes had more than one use other than augmentation. He would surely want to discover what it was and if it was something useful and if it was even suitable for dark matter. And the trait God spoke of was something Avrin longed to know personally.
He was somewhat right. His body seemed to remove any unimportant urges from how he felt if he didn't think of it. For instance, if he didn't want to feel pain then most likely his body would not allow the pain receptors to transmit.
If he didn't want to feel sexual urges then his body wouldn't waste the effort or energy in letting him feel aroused or stimulated unless he wanted to.
If he emotionally was confused or was pondering something then it would have a change in the way he was. No wonder he felt like he lacked emotions. It was because his body was trying to adapt itself to make him a better creature.
This certainly had positives and negatives. He would have to be careful and learn to harness it better.
“Moving on” God spoke as that was all he would tell Avrin. The picture on the whiteboard changed in an instant showing several different looking planets that seemed to be alive and perfectly made on the whiteboard as if they were holographic.
“What individuals call gods here are merely beings who have reached an immense state of personal power.
Creatures who have different body structures that allowed them to be as strong as they are, or they can even be born that way. As I showed you before.But I’ll tell you now they are not gods. A God is an individual who knows all, sees all, is everywhere, can do anything quicker than an instant, and is beyond infinite. Other than me there is nothing like that.
But the benefit of the doubt has been given and they can be called gods in their own respect. You want to become like one but you currently lack what they have.That is power. Obviously you know this and I shouldn't be telling you this.”
Avrin thought to himself carefully “If they are that strong and I'm only a mortal, you surely have a point to this...I’m guessing it is how I am going to reach that point of power. I dont even know when I will die or how long I'll live.”
God’s featureless face formed a mouth that smiled which was somewhat creepy “Very good. I didn't expect you to pick up on that. So I’ll reward you with a final gift Avrin. Your cells are different, they never die for as long as they are inside you. With your body and dark matter you are capable of living for as long as you like. When you discover how to do so on your own.”
Bingo! This was the most valuable piece of information he had so far. Even more so than that mythological tome. Avrin had been on seleria and had occasionally worried about time, but passed it away as something that should be forgotten. He would try to be a god but would do so without rush.
Destiny would take him as far as he went on his own. But this was a game changer. If he discovered how to do so, he would have his first godly quality. And that was immortality.
Avrin smiled and bowed “Thank you…I'm not good with thanks and it isn't like me but when I am in your presence I am never sure how to act. Afterall, you are the creator and I am constantly trembling or having my mind change”
God seemed to chuckle “It isn't like you to thank me Avrin.
I’ll tell you that since you were unsure. I do not need your thanks, I am merely doing this for the sake of satisfying my non omnipotent state”That was quite a straightforward and cruel way of telling him he was just a guinea pig. But Avrin nodded without argument. “Oh yes, how is it...I get back to my body?”
God grinned and stayed quiet for a second “Oooh you're going to like what has happened to you Avrin. And to get back to your body? Just like this” With a click of his finger’s everything vanished into darkness and Avrin was back in his body that seemed to feel a little tight for some reason. Maybe because he felt he was free when around god but now put in something that confines his soul.
Avrin slowly opened his eyes and saw it was nearly pitch black. He noticed numbers on the ceiling in a glowing pattern and noticed it was a mana clock that was conveniently put into the ceiling so one would only need to open their eyes to see the time.
He leaned up and looked out the window to see it was nightfall. He must have slept for a few hours. He looked around and saw it was quiet apart from the occasional chatter outside his room and around the mansion that he heard using his ears.
He made his way to an open space in the room and raised his hands to which he began to create a void bolt. He began to adjust the size at a rapid pace as if to constantly get used to controlling it. He then tried to engulf his hand in the energy that was identical to the void bolt, as if a dark matter glove coating. It was different to how the augmentation worked. If the augmentation was more physical this was an aura.
This book was originally published on . Check it out there for the real experience.
As he channeled it over his hand it began to calm down and sway as if a dark purple fire was resting upon it.
Curious to know what it does, he went towards the desk and reached over to pick up an orb that was sitting there. To his surprise, his hand had rapidly devoured and disintegrated the part of the orb he touched as if it was a high pressure torch that was alive had eaten away at it. As the rest of the orb collapsed over his hand it to was eaten away.
“An aura that devours anything it touches.. A skill I should've learnt awhile ago. I feel as if I'm neglecting this ability. I will have to ask Shimaru to show me an open area to train by myself when I go to accept” He spoke as he confirmed that he was going to accept Shimaru’s offer.
Avrin dissipated the aura and sat down at the desk. He began to tap into the knowledge of the books he had devoured and it seemed like things had turned out well. The knowledge that was jumbled up due to devouring the books at a quick rate and too many at once was still lost but everything else was there as if it were perfectly in his memory.
Avrin began to emit a nebula mist in the form of several books he devoured and it didn't take long due to him being synced with them for quite awhile now. His body having had time to do so.As the books formed with several coloured covers as well as titles he read a few chapters at the beginning the middle and the end to make sure. He then tried to make more copies of the books and it seemed like the knowledge in his mind was there for good.
He was now able to make more copies of whichever book he absorbed. This would be useful later on.
After devouring the books into dark matter without caring for the loss due to the knowledge being already permanent, he grinned to himself and began to form something else.
This object had the shape of a larger solid object. The shape of a tome. It was instead the mythological object. Even though it had sunk into his head he could not decipher what it meant.But the good thing was it took less time to recreate it.
As he did, 10 minutes passed and it was in front of him. Of course, he was frowning while gazing at it. “I guess it was too much to be expected that it didn't translate” Avrin sighed he figured as much. He came to the conclusion that it would only translate it as long as he understood the language of the time to begin with.
At that moment, a knock echoed and Avrin blinked before confirming to himself the knowledge of the tome’s structure was in his mind he willed his dark matter to devour the tome without worry of the knowledge. He then spoke.
“Come in..” As the door opened two servants entered and one spoke “Honored guest, dinner is re..” Avrin turned around while she was speaking and she had only stopped because she gazed at Avrin. Not only her but the other female servant’s jaws somewhat dropped as they had stunned expressions.
They were the first since the sylphs to see Avrin’’s appearance. Several things came into their mind such as handsome, unmatched, godly.
Avrin blinked to himself and noticed where they were looking. He remembered his appearance and blinked before chuckling to himself. It was sooner or later that he would have to reveal it so better now than never. “I hope you both have enjoyed the show“ He winked teasingly towards them as if to try and win favor.
To which both female servants giggled silently and one cleared her throat “Ehm...H..Honored guest” She spoke with a stutter before continuing “The Elder has invited you to dine with the main family in the dining hall. Will you attend?”
Avrin thought it was a good opportunity to speak with Shimaru as well as meet the rest of the main family before something unexpected happened. “I will indeed attend.”
From there one maid exited and reentered the room with folded clothing to which she left on the bed. The other then left most likely to report to Shimaru.The maid/servant that remained smiled “If you were to accept, the Elder tasked me to provide you with a set of social clothing since he considered you wouldn't have a spare change of clothing I hope it will fit.”
Avrin went over and looked over it as he unfolded it and gazed. It didn't seem like anything bad. It was a hakama with a nature like design on it. Somewhat similar to Ayame’s kimono, but more masculine .“It’s fine. I'll get dressed right away and be there soon.” The maid nodded and then left after closing the door silently.
Meanwhile at the dining hall. Ayame, Amias, Shimaru, Izanami, Calias, and an older looking female who seemed identical to Ayame, Amias, and Izanami, most likely there mother, was seated next to Calias.Shimaru spoke to the maid that was recently with Avrin “Ho ho ho! Very good I look forward to seeing the honored guest.“ It seemed he had taken a real liking to Avrin. “Grandfather, Avrin is joining us?!“ Amias happily spoke to which Shimaru smiled and nodded.
“He didn't hesitate to help us when those bandits showed up even though I was going to take care of them by myself. It is the thought that counts. It is rare for people to be heroic when faced with many opponents”Ayame grunted quietly “Pfft any adventurer would have done the same thing with the same results” Amias huffed to himself “Sister you should've seen it. Though he handled them all at once with his enigmatic magi-.”
At that point once again Shimaru tapped his head softly with a cane “Amias that was a secret!” Shimaru said with a somewhat annoyed but funny look to which Calias’ elbows were on the table and his fingers crossed.
“Ahh I see. So this is why grandfather is interested. Our honored guest is an enigmatic level user. Truly interesting, I can't recall I have ever met one. I would like to know what sort of ability he wields” The unknown female spoke with a somewhat funny laugh. “Ha ha ha!.
Dear, it would be rude to ask so blatantly. He is Elder’s honored guest after all. You mustn't be so intrusive.” The female spoke.
Calias then sighed and smiled to her “Misaki you are always ruining my fun moments. You never seem to give me any freedom of my own“ He spoke as if to be playful with her.
Izanami was grinning at Ayame as the two conversed “Sister, would you please pass me the salt..” Ayame glared and bared her teeth “Go jump into the darkest depths of the ocean and have all the salt in the sea you perverted tramp”
Sparks seemed to clash between the two as they were indeed rivals even though Izanami was older by 2 years. Ayame herself was 18 while Izanami was 20.
At that moment while everyone conversed and the meal was being served. A maid came and bowed in front to which they all went silent she then spoke “The honored guest has arrived…”
The large door towards the dining hall was opened from the outside by two guards with an individual clad in a hakama with long silvery hair flowing down his back. His eyes a light blue with a patterned pupil that was a line with a cross near the top similar to a “T” and one at the bottom.
The chest area of the hakama was open slightly revealing a well trained chest area. The beings skin was nearly pale but it was as if it was more flawless than snow. This being also wore a satisfied prideful smile as he began to make his way into the dining hall also wearing what seemed like sandals with specially made socks.

Avrin clearly looked quite unique, there would be many men who would be jealous of how he looked. He currently gazed around the dining room that had gotten quiet and tilted his head. “Is...something wrong?” He looked at himself wondering if there was something on him but he clearly knew it was because of his appearance. He just played a long due to finding the moment funny.
Shimaru cleared his throat before letting out a chuckle and speaking “Ho ho ho! Avrin, I didn’t know it was you! I thought for a moment an angel had decided to turn up for dinner. My oh my, I never knew your appearance would look so unusual.
I have seen many demons but you are the first to have that angelic appearance..Hmm, no, it is more unique than that” While Shimaru was examining him, Avrin was showed to his seat by a blushing maid that had stuttered with her words while leading him to it.
Ayame’s face had turned a shy pink as she looked at Avrin. Clearly his appearance alone was enough to cause her to forget her anger towards the male for a moment, but Amias had noticed this and grinned as he lightly bumped Ayame and whispered.
“Hehe, hey sis, does this mean Avrin is going to be my older bro??” He let out a wide grin while gazing at her. Ayame snapped back into reality as her face turned a deeper shade of red while a vein appeared on her forehead, glaring at Amias as she was about to hit him. Izanami spoke out towards Avrin.
“Oh sir Avrin my you are so handsome. I can't remember in my life that I have ever seen such an interesting looking individual. Grandfather is correct, you are unique.” She spoke in a seductive tone while trying to undress Avrin with her eyes and scooting a bit closer to him.
This made Avrin blink a few times before he gave an uncomfortable look in front of this tigress that clearly saw him as prey to eat. To his thanks, Calias spoke out.
“Izanami our guest is not someone for you to see as fodder for your loins..”
Her mother lightly chuckled and spoke “Oh Calias, she is still young. After all, our guest is indeed handsome.” Her words made Calias shut his eyes for a moment before shaking his head slightly and sighing, then smiling towards Avrin and speaking, ignoring his daughter. Izanami’s gazed towards the individual.
“Avrin was it? I am glad father has found someone he has deemed worthy of personally training.. The white dragon clan is often secretive and we do not like to show outsiders who we are, which is why we act normally when not tending to training or our rituals.
I do hope you will impress me as much as you have impressed my father. After all, considering he hasn't picked his own son who is considered a genius among the clan. I look forward to seeing what is better.”
He gave a somewhat smug look towards Avrin to which Avrin replied with just a faint smile while gazing into his eyes. The man was indeed currently stronger than Avrin, but Avrin was not one to let individuals stronger then him think they mentally got to him.
“Calias you’re still sad about that? Ho ho ho stop moping boy. Besides, Avrin has yet to accept my invitation to personally train him”
Avrin gazed towards Shimaru and spoke “Regarding that. I have decided to accept with the condition that no personal questions are asked…That is all I require.”
Shimaru stood silent for a moment before gazing at Avrin, realising that such a condition may be told for good reason, he was curious to what Avrin himself was hiding, but did not let it get in the way. Calias on the other hand was eating silently, quite annoyed at his father's comments towards him at the end.
Shimaru spoke firmly with a smile “Avrin, I gladly accept on the condition that you do not complain about my training methods.”
Avrin raised a brow. Wasn't this man the one that had asked him to begin with, with no conditions? He shook his head to himself slightly before nodding. After all, the harder the training, the better the results. Besides, he as a general had gone through quite a bit in his previous world. How hard could it be.
“I accept.” Avrin spoke kindly and Amias and Ayame, who were arguing silently with each other, stopped and gazed at Avrin. Amias had a wide smile, as if he wanted to dance in a cheer, while Ayame had her mouth open and brow raised in a “huh” expression. She then spoke
“G..Grandfather, how can you so easily let this outsider join!! And even personally train him. There have been many famous individuals whose names are known that you have not looked at twice...What makes him so special..!”
Ayame spoke out in a sort of rant that made everyone, including Calias, somewhat shocked. Shimaru placed his hands inside his hakama’s sleeves before taking a deep breathe and replying.
“Ayame, you have a lot to learn...Very well, I’ll show you what I mean. Tomorrow, come with Avrin at 8:00AM to the white spring lake and prepare for a duel between you two…”
Ayame nodded then gazed at Avrin she was quite curious to see how strong Avrin was. After all, she had easily gotten behind him and could have killed him to.
Avrin on the other hand let a soft sigh escaped his lips. The first day under his so called teacher’s training regime involved a duel with his psychotic granddaughter who held anger towards him. It seemed females on Seleria either loved or hated him. He cursed his weird luck in his mind.
“Very well” Avrin spoke. This also benefited him. He wanted to get stronger and a duel with someone who is equal, or stronger than him on fair grounds should be interesting.
Other than that, dinner that night went on as one would expect. With Izanami trying to win Avrin’s favor, but he would often lightly turn her down. She went as far as to try and feed him in a way that couples would even though Ayame called her names.
Calias was sighing, almost face palming, at the daughters he had brought up. While his wife tried to ease the feeling as she explained it's how girls their ages worked.
Amias was trying to convince his grandfather to be personally trained, but Shimaru kept turning him down trying to make it sound gruesome. One wouldn’t expect that this family had the blood of shinobi in them.
The white dragon clan had, in the past, tried their best to assimilate into the ways of how people on the central continent would act. This was because if they were ever found here by individuals, those individuals would think nothing special of them other than their fancy taste for homes.
This was also second nature to them, being trained quite hard but also putting on their normal lives as if it were comfortable, was quite amazing.
Later that night, when dinner had ended and the servants were cleaning. Amias had been sent to bed with 2 servants leading him. Ayame decided to go train in a dojo to prepare for the match tomorrow, regardless of how Avrin was, she didn't want to underestimate her opponent. 
The narrative has been stolen; if detected on Amazon, report the infringement.
Izanami, feeling tonight she wouldn't win Avrin’s favor, decided to get some rest and try again another time. While Calias and his wife would go rest up.
Avrin was standing outside, gazing at the dense forest and looking up at the stars. He hadn't felt this out of danger in quite a while. Even though he had a duel tomorrow, he felt Shimaru didn't seem like the type to betray him so easily after getting to know him a bit better.
Avrin, as a general, found it hard to trust officers who tried to get his support to rise in the ranks. they had no care towards him, only to please themselves. Even his own crew turned on him in the end.
Shimaru wasn't like that. Avrin pondered this, he was older and wiser and also much stronger. He had nothing to gain by training. Considering the clan’s circumstances, it wasn't as if they were going to send him to war. It was most likely the feeling of wanting to train someone with potential.
Avrin rubbed the back of his head and sighed before thinking “-I suppose trusting this man wouldn't hurt. After all it would be incredibly hard to live in this world without having a few close individuals-”
As Avrin thought about this, Shimaru came and gave him a large pat on the back that seemed to cause him to take a step forward. Avrin coughed a bit.
“Ho ho ho Avrin, tomorrow I shall see how you fare in a real battle against an expert! I must warn you, Ayame can be quite sadistic to those she hates. Ahh I remember when she was only 8 and she defeated a 14 year old who had been training for years longer than her.
After she had beaten him in the sparring match, she even went as far as hitting him with her bare hands. But I suppose it can't be helped. He did call her a useless runt afterall. Ho ho ho, even now that boy, who is now an established shinobi of our clan, bows to her whenever he sees her.”
Avrin shivered slightly “-Sadistic sounds like an understatement, heh..-” He thought to himself before smiling.
“I shall see you tomorrow Avrin. I’m sure you would like to prepare yourself. Ayame is already in the dojo to the east of this place training. In all honesty Avrin, I don’t expect you to win. It is more so to teach her a lesson”
Avrin blinked before laughing quietly. It seemed like a weird joke, but it truthfully made him laugh slightly “Haha… It sounds interesting, Teacher” He spoke those words which made Shimaru grin happily “I'm curious to know what lesson you will teach someone by them hurting another individual”
Shimaru also laughed after Avrin put it in those words before nodding “You will have to wait and see, I won't go easy on you Avrin. I see potential in you unlike any other I have seen before...I intend to do my best to bring it out to the fullest. It must be a sign from the gods having sent you to me”
Avrin thought this man put too much faith on these gods. It was obviously on his own will and not some half baked individuals with barely enough power together to make a world.
Shimaru spoke while Avrin thought. “I shall be off, Avrin. I have my own duties I need to attend to. As for tonight, train or rest. It’s up to you.”
Avrin felt Shimaru was somewhat easy going as a teacher. Especially as a man that was considered incredibly powerful. There had to be something hidden. After Shimaru left, Avrin decided to walk around.
There was no doubt he intended to lose, and as a general he had strategies from an incredible number of battles. This female ninja had underestimated Avrin even when she intended not to.
After Avrin asked for directions to the white spring lake, he quietly made his way over towards it. It was a 10 minute walk north of the mansion, through the forest.
It seemed like the forest itself was quiet. Even as the night breeze quietly brushed against his cheeks, it was a calm, serene feeling. He didn't feel like there were wild creatures around.
After Avrin reached the lake he widened his eyes to see a beautiful pristine lake in a near perfect circle. As if it was cleaved from the land. The full moon’s light reflecting off it with the glittering reflections of the stars.
Avrin gazed around trying to take into account the terrain, but not before using his augmented eyes to get a better view of it. Even in the full moon’s light he didn't want to take a chance and forget something.
Avrin smirked to himself before he raised both his hands, emitting nebula mists from both of them.
“I’m sorry Ayame, but I will have to make sure your respect is given.” A dark grin appeared on his face as he began to tinker around with the area.
11 hours had passed and it was 10:00AM on the dot. Shimaru had earlier came to see Avrin sitting down, leaning against a tree with his eyes shut. Shimaru grinned as he looked around, feeling something was off, but he couldn't put his mind to it. As they waited, Ayame arrived in her shinobi attire. She seemed quite psyched, but her outward appearance showed she was a little bit fatigued. Most likely due to the all night training with little rest. She had intended to sleep after a few hours but she herself had gotten to into it.
“Ahh very good, you are both here. Well then” Shimaru gazed at Avrin who had changed his attire to a black fur/leather like outfit he had formed after completing his tinkering. He had used the hakama as a template after absorbing it, knowing if Shimaru wanted it he could reform it.
“Avrin...I will make sure grandfather sees that I am more worthy than you.” Avrin chuckled quietly. Clearly this girl was crazy and wanted attention, he thought to himself before smiling and replying as the two were lined up with each other over 30 meters in distance away. But still calling out enough for her to hear as if wanting to taunt her. “Dear Ayame, if you feel that you are not worthy, I shall clear a spot in my heart to please you”
Shimaru grinned as he was gazing from the lake, preparing to start the duel. Ayame’s face was red while she showed signs of anger from Avrin’s words towards her. She did not like being looked down upon or even treated too much like a girl. She could beat many experts in the clan at her age.
“I can see Ayame is about to explode with anger, so with those words sent I must explain that killing is not allowed and whoever gives up is considered the loser. And with that said begi-”
Waiting to hear those words, Ayame rushed towards Avrin with incredible speed. Not letting her grandfather finish. Avrin, who fully knew how fast she could be already, had his eyes augmented and could see her. But she was still faster than expected. He smirked while sweating slightly. It was his first proper battle with an expert after all. He uttered two words while raising his palm.
“Shadow wall….” The ground began to rumble as purple mist seeped out from it shooting up like geysers in many spots before forming in many large 2 meter wide by 3 meter tall pitch black metallic walls that seemed to have a glow. Little did those two know that Avrin had spent all night tinkering with the landscape to develop a technique with his current knowledge that would let him combat Ayame.

Ayame froze in her spot, but at this moment she had already closed the gap half way to Avrin and was dead in the center of the shadow wall technique Avrin had used. She gazed around in surprise as well as shock, somewhat nervous as she had never encountered magic like this before let alone much magic at all. Shimaru was also quite surprised as his eyes were wide open, not daring to blink as to miss what might occur next.
Ayame heard Avrin’s voice and quickly unsheathed two kunai these kunai were made with the metal Aerium. As the name would imply, it was steel with special properties towards the air affinity making it light, and when thrown it was as if it could fly. It was also quite durable. A perfect material for a shinobi.
“Ayame, I dared not underestimate you...Especially during our first encounter...You have speed going for you so I pondered my situation...And the solution was simple.” Avrin smirked as he was concealed behind dozens of shadow walls.
The wall in front of Ayame began to glow before a large jet black pillar made from dark matter shot out quickly towards Ayame. She was nearly caught off guard, she barely managed to avoid it by jumping to the side. The pillar retracted back into the wall
Where Ayame had landed, behind her another shadow wall began to glow before another pillar shot towards her at an incredible speed. This time she was taken by surprise, barely having enough time to turn and attempt to block it, but the force of the hit had knocked her back several meters and onto the ground after she had hit a shadow wall and slammed down.
“S...Shit...” She coughed up some blood to which Avrin sighed in relief. It seemed he had now gotten the advantage
“Ayame, I don't intend to injure you greatly. Please forfeit…” He spoke not in a boastful manner but he tried to make due with his situation and convince her to surrender. But this was the wrong move on his behalf, he was not dealing with people in his universe who were outgunned. This female shinobi had pride and honor.
“A..Avrin” Ayame spoke softly as she stood up clutching her kunai with a trail of blood across the sides of her lips a large amount of killing intend seeping out of her “You cheap bastard…..I’m going to…”
Avrin blinked as he felt this killing intent. Without hesitation, 2 walls in front and to the side of Ayame shot pillars towards her. But she managed to dodge one expecting it and jump on the other before jumping on the ground again.
“Kill you…!!” Avrin’s eyes narrowed. He had to step up his game. He called out “I won’t lose Ayame…” All the shadow walls began to glow before shooting out rapidly at a lightning pace. This caught Ayame off guard, thinking he could not control them all at once. She had barely dodged a few as the pace they shot out was almost as fast as her. But the pace as well as the placing of the shadow walls was too much and she was hit several times.
Like a ragdoll that tried to protect itself she was hit around while crying out in pain. It made Shimaru almost cringe and Avrin himself who was keen in showing her he was not to be trifled with felt a little pity for her, but he knew he had to beat respect into her one way or another.
A tactic used when training troops when they are disrespectful, beat them down until they submit. Of course this usually only worked with those troops that were aggressive.
Avrin stopped using the barrage of shadow wall pillar’s and lowered his hand which was somewhat numb it was a new technique and creating it overnight exhausted him as well as used quite a bit of energy. Even now he was absorbing mana from the surroundings. Until his body was honed and trained more he could not be as efficient as he wanted.
He didn't want this fight to drag on. Especially against someone like her who has trained for years and was used to fighting. Ayame had laid limp on the ground with her body battered and bruised, but this didn't stop her. She began to twitch a bit before leaning up. Her eyes covered in darkness as they weren't visible. Her hair messed up as it covered her face.
Shimaru was quiet as he dared not interfere in this match. Avrin felt something was wrong. One thing his senses as a general told him was that quiet during a battle was not a good sign. Ayame stood up, clutching her kunai as her hair began to wave around in the faint breeze. A surge of killing intent followed by a surge of mana from inside of her, burst forth.
Shimaru called out first “ A..Ayame you cannot mean to…” A white symbol began to appear on Ayame’s forehead. Avrin couldn't see well physically when his eyes were augmented but the shape of it going from it was like a dragon curled up. The mana that poured into it from her body seemed to condense and turn an extreme white that seemed blinding. Even he squinted slightly.
“Not good..” Ayame suddenly jumped up in a flash before landing on top of a shadow wall. Avrin’s eyes widened as he clenched his teeth. He didn’t have a way to counter when she was on top of it. A negative of a technique developed overnight.
As she rushed towards him her speed seemed twice as fast and she navigated around with no interference. Avrin knew he was in trouble and quickly tried to augment his arms. Even though she was twice as fast he saw her vanish, but her mana then trailed behind him. He quickly moved to turn and block and was met with a powerful kick against his forearms the force sent him crashing towards the middle of the makeshift arena of shadow walls, crashing into a couple that tumbled down onto the ground but still retained their shapes.
Avrin’s forearms had not fully augmented and he could feel several bones were broken, but already being repaired. Shimaru had caught sight of his arms and was quite interested in this ability of his to strengthen a limb.
Avrin stood up as to not give his opponent time to attack again but Ayame was standing still at the place Avrin had previously been.
“I can’t believe I was forced so soon to use this….Argh Avrin...You make me angry.” Avrin’s eyes twitched a bit. Clearly she was making the situation worse then it seemed. He tried to think of a way to get around this, most of his abilities were intended to kill. He couldn't use the void spheres without worry.
Ayame on the other hand, being more trained had better control. She reached to the side of her shinobi attire and pulled out what seemed like two crystals. One black, one white.
She then smirked towards Avrin before throwing the white one in the air. As it moved above the middle of the arena she used a sort of hand sign, Avrin felt a flow of mana that seemed to twist before the white crystal seemed to explode, emitting a bright light that was blinding even to Avrin. He quickly tried to shut his eyes enough to stop it and still see Ayame but she had disappeared.
She had jumped up to avoid the light and use it to her advantage as she was coming down towards Avrin. She used another sort of handsign before the black crystal broke releasing a dark affinity magic that engulfed her body.
Unauthorized use: this story is on Amazon without permission from the author. Report any sightings.
As the white light slowly faded, Avrin saw her mana trail and quickly looked up to see her greet him with another powerful kick. With her body covered in a thin dark aura, the only exception being the white dragon like symbol on her forehead. Avrin was pressed into the ground and a small crater formed as he gasped for air while coughing up blood. 
It was the 3rd most painful thing he had experienced. The first being executed, and the second being hit by that elven bitches arrow. Ayame had jumped up spinning in the air before landing several meters away with a smile on her face, still engulfed by that thin black aura.
Shimaru spoke out “Oo, Ayame you have indeed improved, it seems you have managed to pass the intermediate rank and achieve Expert. Remind me to take you to check your spirit stone after this battle.”
Ayame grinned and smiled before replying “I've been training very hard grandfather… Day and night, I won't let anyone surpass me so easily, so won't you consider training me instead? And as for this battle I think it’s already over” She said somewhat smugly.
Shimaru grinned and motioned her to look. She did so before widening her eyes at the crater. She saw Avrin making his way out, panting heavily with his own blood trailing down his lips as he gazed at her and smiled before speaking “T..That hurt...I’ll be sure to return the favor…” He wiped the blood using his sleeve before smirking.
I think I can do this….. He raised his hands before firing several void spheres that shot towards Ayame who quickly took up a defencive stance and smirked. “Those arent going to work against me, Avrin..”
Avrin showed a dark grin as the spheres stopped and hovered around her. “I was afraid I might kill you if I used this...But I’m sure that you can handle it if I try to control it...So be a good guinea pig would you..And stay still”
Ayame clenched her teeth. The same vein from before appearing on her forehead near the white dragon symbol “Guinea what??!!! You little.” Just as she was about to move the spheres burst into void crystals 1x1 in diameter. There were hundreds of them that made escaping from all of them nearly impossible for her current self.
(PR Note: Didn’t really know which measurements to use, so just imagine they’re really small)
She showed a nervous worried look as she gazed around “A..Avrin, what is this…” She spoke worryingly. Shimaru was also quite worried “Hmm...Avrin I think this is a bit too much.”
Avrin only smiled before replying “Don’t worry teacher...I'm confident I can do this...They are not as strong as the ones during that event” This seemed to make Shimaru relax. It was somewhat amusing that he would relax at the thought of his granddaughter being injured.
Ayame glared at Avrin again before raising her kunai. She tried to slash away at the void spheres but for every one she hit, a black scorch mark was left on the kunai where it hit, which seemed to slowly eat away at the tip. This made her gasp and stand still as she looked around.
“Give up Ayame… Last chance…” Ayame spat on the ground before showing a prideful look. “I refuse to giv-” Avrin didn't have the intention of waiting for her to finish. He knew she wasn't going to give in, regardless if the opponent was stronger than him to an extent, or more experienced. It came down to what was known in most cases, and how things were used. He willed the void crystals and they all began to hit towards Ayame who tried to avoid and block.
Several crystals smacked against the thin black aura tearing it like paper and giving little protection, but as soon as spots were open it didn't take long before they hit Ayame’s main body. As if she were hit with a needle and punched in the exact location she let out a scream of pain.
Avrin himself was somewhat annoyed that he had gone through the trouble of making a technique when this had proven more effective. But Ayame’s will would show to be more than he bargained for. As the crystals bombarded her, not so much as to overwhelm her as Avrin didn't want to over do it. She bit her lip and blood ran down not only from the wounds that had been inflicted upon her, but her lips as well.
“D..Damn you...Avrin!!!” She kicked her feet as she charged towards Avrin, and an incredible speed too fast for the crystals to keep up he had let his guard down for a moment but grinned as he had a plan.
Right as Ayame intended to strike with the scorched kunai, she was about to pass over one of the shadow walls that had fallen. Avrin, taking this as an opportunity, used it to his advantage and a large pillar that was larger than then the ones prior had shot up from the shadow wall consuming the remaining dark matter and hitting ayame straight in the stomach, sending her upwards at an astonishing rate. The pillar then disintegrated.
Avrin was smiling happily before blinking and coughing and gazing up. she was quite high up. Maybe a little to high. “That’s higher than I expected….Hmm why isn't she moving?..” Avrin had gotten quite worried. Even though she had been aggressive towards him, he felt no need to kill her.
Ayame was limp in the air. She had been knocked unconscious and was falling rapidly. Avrin had been exhausted from this fight, especially after using so many shadow walls and even the night before, tinkering and trying things out to make it. He fell to his knees as he tried to think of a solution.
He began to rapidly absorb the shadow walls around him as they disintegrated and began to gather. “Not good...My nebula mist won't be able to form anything quick enough..” As Ayame fell near the ground Shimaru vanished in a near instant and jumped up catching her with ease, princess style. He landed with grace and gently laid her down.
“Dear Ayame, you pushed yourself quite a bit for this duel…” He spoke to her, the white dragon symbol long gone from her forehead. Shimaru gazed at Avrin and smiled with a grin “Avrin...If it was anyone else in a different circumstance, I would of had their head by now..But this was to be expected...You exceeded my expectations with your ability..I have seen some more of what you are capable of”
Avrin still clutching his stomach and panting slightly was still absorbing the dark matter and was slowly healing at a quicker pace due to the dark matter reserves being refilled. “She indeed gave me a run for my money...I'm sure she intended to kill me” He joked. To which Shimaru laughed quietly and replied.
“Please do this as a favor to me. Do not rub this loss in her face..She is a prideful girl and not doing so will still crush her, and by doing so, she will be crushed even more.”
Avrin stood up a little and nodded “It was not my intention… Besides, I should thank her. She helped me understand a bit more about my ability”
Shimaru then nodded as he grinned to Avrin and stood up,0 putting his hands in his sleeves before speaking “Well then, you can carry her back” He laughed before vanishing in a near instant. Even Avrin’s augmented eyes could barely see anything but a white, greyish blur. A shocked look on his face.
“That old man...And he is supposed to be my teacher..” Avrin approached Ayame and gazed down at her. She seemed helpless and cuter than her usual self. He sighed. The most worrying thing was if she found out he did this for her. He scooped her up into his arms, the same princess style that her grandfather caught her with, and began to head back to the main building before grumbling. “That old bastard…So much for trust.. Heh “ He made a slight chuckle.

After Avrin had arrived with Ayame in his arms, the servants tending to their duties had freaked out, thinking he had done something wrong. This annoyed him but things settled after the vanished Shimaru had reappeared and assured them everything was ok. Ayame was then taken off his hands and sent to her room to recover and be tended to.
Shimaru gazed at Avrin who seemed somewhat lost in what to do for today.
“So Avrin, how did your first battle with an expert level opponent feel..Ayame is physically stronger and faster than you but your enigmatic ability seems to have saved you.” Shimaru spoke without bothering to compliment him.
“It was intense… I knew I couldn't beat her at her own game in speed, but I never knew her physical strength was that powerful...But the mark on her forehead, her mana condensed there. What was it?.”
Shimaru raised a brow as him and Avrin began walking to his dojo “Ho ho ho! you saw the symbol of our white dragon clan. Only us in the main branch have the ability to manifest our mana into a source of power because we are warriors in a sense. Our mana is barely used but as we train our bodies and minds that internal unused mana grows and grows.. Avrin, the white dragon symbol is a bloodline inherited enigmatic ability. It takes that unused dormant internal mana and imbues it into its host.
It is incredibly unique as magic abilities that augment its caster are quite hard and are only minor unless the caster is a sage or higher. And even then this ability is more powerful. I was scared she may have done you in. Hehe”
Shimaru grinned as the sliding door opened. Him and Avrin had started heading inside. “Interesting..An ability that augments using internal mana. Although I can't say I'm jealous of it.” Shimaru nodded “It seems you have a way to augment yourself without casting...Your enigmatic ability is mysterious. It seems to have many ways to be used.”
Avrin just smirked, not bothering to correct him or throw him a hint. “So teacher, what is it you would like me to do now?”
Shimaru nodded “Ahh yes, yes. I think it would be best if I teach you techniques to prepare your body for training. Sit down Avrin” Shimaru spoke clearly
Avrin followed and sat in a cross legged position and Shimaru did the same, but his hands were placed together, his fingers pressing against each other as the palm section was open. Shimaru began taking gentle breaths that were deep but constant and flowed well without trouble.
“Avrin” he began to speak in a tone that was quieter and more fluid. “This meditation position is called Pulsing Dragon. It uses the internal mana of your body as well as the affinity around you to help stimulate muscle development in your body. This meditation alone is dangerous if you do not train yourself correctly to have techniques that are capable of matching the body you receive.
“
Avrin listened intently. The one thing he was worried about was that he didn't have internal mana  and he decided to speak. “Teacher.. What if one doesn't have mana at all inside of them but a different source of energy?”
Shimaru opened his eyes in an instant and gazed at Avrin. Shimaru himself was not stupid even though he acted care free. He knew Avrin’s question was legitimate and referred to himself. If that was the case he could only give him a template.
“Avrin, all energy in the end is the same. It empowers, it gives life, or takes it. If it was another source of energy then the person with that energy could slowly adapt this position to suit them”
Avrin nodded before Shimaru began speaking again. “I noticed you were exhausted quite quickly during your battle. Ayame herself was not exhausted, you could see she sustained more injuries than you and continued on. The only thing that stopped her was the knockout blow. This is a perfect way for you to train stamina, but do not rely on this position too much. Physical training is essential after all. New muscles that aren't put to good use are just useless clumps of weight.
Avrin smiled and nodded again. His teacher was indeed referring to what is the point in having this position stimulate muscle growth if Avrin wasn't going to train physically to help stretch those new muscles.
After that was spoken, things had gotten quiet. Avrin began to feel slightly cold and could feel that the air had gotten dry. As he looked at Shimaru, he could see a white glow eminate from him. A white aura was flaring around him, steadily pulsing out gently before retracting inside and then pulsing again and repeating. Shimaru didn't speak and Avrin only watched.
It was only 10 minutes later that Shimaru began to speak while keeping this up. “This technique, although it is useful in stimulating muscle and stamina growth, If used for a long duration on a body that isn't able to handle it will do more bad than good. I dare not tell you what might happen if you continue this for more than an hour a day with your current body. That being said, intermediate level people are able to start with 30 minutes maximum a day, but I feel you’re an exception.“
Avrin smiled as he was glad he wasn't looked down upon. He mimicked Shimaru’s position in an attempt to copy him. And while he was trying to get the feel for it shimaru spoke “Avrin, try to block out everything that is unimportant. There is only you and the flow of mana around you and inside of you. Try to will this mana into the fibres of your being.”
Avrin did so but instead of mana he used his dark matter. The internal energy was slowly seeping into the muscle fibres and began to fuse somewhat slowly, as if massaging them. The feeling was relaxing but it also felt weird. It was a unique sensation, his body throbbing all over but not in pain. As he continued, Shimaru smiled as he felt Avrin was getting the hang of it.
That was until he saw the dark matter materialising a devilish pitch black aura with purple trimmings and static that shot a few inches away from Avrin. Avrin was to encompassed in his meditation to realise this but Shimaru’s eyes had widened as he watched this. He thought to himself “-W..What a menacing aura….This isn't mana...I can't feel it even though it is right in front of me...What sort of individual is this boy…-”
The aura around Avrin began to steadily grow. As it touched the ground it began to slowly devour it, as the ash would float up as if gravity was no longer holding it, before even the ash vanished out of existence. Shimaru knew it was dangerous to continue. “Avrin enough…”
Avrin had did as Shimaru told him and tried to block everything out including Shimaru himself “Avrin…!” He yelled out to which Avrin opened his eyes quickly as it was still his first time his trance was not perfect. The aura pulsed out at the sudden feeling of Avrin awakening, spreading several feet astonishingly quick which made Shimaru gasp.
This was until the aura condensed just as fast as it spread making its way back into Avrin who wobbled a bit then pressed his right hand onto the tatami like mat and coughed slightly.
“I...a..apologise teacher...It seems I overdid it for my first time.” Shimaru stayed silent before sighing and sitting down “It’s fine Avrin...I'm more astounded at the fact that you managed to get the hang of it so quickly...But that aura of yours...I've never seen anything like it...Incredible…” He mumbled those last few words silently to not allow Avrin to get big headed, but Avrin just grinned as his ears picked it up.
“Oh dear.. I'll need to have this all repaired” Shimaru sighed before gazing at Avrin, annoyed slightly. Avrin nervously chuckled before bowing slightly as if to apologise. “Avrin, I think your pulsing dragon is too dangerous to use in this estate...You will go to the lake where you battled Ayame and continue it for 50 minutes before training your body. If you take the left path from the lake you will find the training equipment.
Love what you're reading? Discover and support the author on the platform they originally published on.
“Teacher you won't be guiding me?” Shimaru sighed and folded his arms “Avrin, I haven't shown myself to be a great teacher so far and that is my mistake. I need to attend to matters of our clan. It seems some humans in the central continent have discovered our existence..” He spat those last words out.
Avrin also blinked. This affected him as well. He had hoped things here would stay secretive for a bit longer but he had an aura of bad luck around him that couldn't be helped. So he stood up and bowed to Shimaru again after the conversation was over. He then made his way out while gazing again at the scorched floor as well as the small marks on the ground caused by the static.
He exited the dojo and began to make his way to the lake again until Izanami quickly came beside him and hugged his arm against her chest and it squeezed between her plump breasts.
“Sir Avrin, you are heading off to the lake to train. Won't you take me with you?..”
Avrin’s right eye secretly twitched at this succubus in human clothing attempted to seduce him. “I’m sorry Izanami“ He smiled warmly but it was quite fake. “I would like to train alone. I need to get stronger as quickly as I can.”
Izanami pouted then grinned. “Sir Avrin, I have an idea. Won't you let me keep an eye on you? I may not look it but I am an expert level individual“ She spoke in a boastful manner. Avrin then pondered this. Surely he could spar with her a bit to train his skills and take his frustration out on her for trying to seduce him so openly.
He wondered if Shimaru, his teacher, would allow it but shrugged it off as it would be positive in assisting him. “Hmm... Very well Izanami...But do not try anything…” Avrin snatched his arm aggressively from between her breasts which made her give a kya! like sound before blushing faintly and nodding.
As the two made their way to the lake, Avrin, with Izanami’s help, found the location of the training equipment. He was somewhat surprised as it was similar to what was used in his universe. It had similar gym like equipment and makeshift wooden dummies.
Avrin went over to what seemed like a meditation spot and spoke out as he entered a cross legged position. “Izanami, I ask that you do not disturb me for 50 minutes. If anyone is looking for me other than your grandfather please tell them this” Izanami sighed as she went to lay down on one of the spectator seats reserved for an instructor to observe and nodded with a mischievous smile “Very well sir Avrin, anything for my new love”
Avrin felt like vomiting from this women’s vile words. He knew she was only after him based on his looks and potential. He had no need for a women who would use him for such things. Just like in the dojo, Avrin began the pulsing dragon meditation for a second time. This time being more cautious in his trance, trying better to focus the dark matter aura that slowly began to seep out.
Izanami also caught onto this and gazed with awe as she whispered “Impressive...An energy that can't be felt. That is most definitely not darkness affinity...Is this why grandfather considered it too dangerous for him to meditate in the estate?”
She whispered quietly. Avrin did not pick up on her words due to him being in a semi trance. He did not know Izanami had been secretly spying on them, and she would have gotten caught by her grandfather had not it been for his surprise and attention focused on Avrin.
Avrin was indeed correct to assume she wanted him for his appearance and ability, she knew her grandfather had picked him to train personally. Something that had never happened, even to her own dad. His own son and a genius was not personally trained, what made this person so special. She knew he was unique and she felt her hunch was right.
The aura around Avrin which consisted of dark matter flared around like a menacing fire of void. It was a unique type of darkness. One that seemed glossy as well as sparkly. Slightly as if space was reflected upon it.
He tried to focus the energy outside, back inside, and from there, slowly into his body fibres. Of course, it was still new for him and he ended up coughing up some blood when he occasionally got the amount of force wrong and added too much. He had gotten used to augmenting his body and it helped with this.
The difference between augmentation and this was that augmentation was like an armor that covered his muscles as a whole and injected darkmatter as a sort of foam to increase strength and durability.
While the pulsing dragon would use his dark matter and carefully knead it into the fibres of his body, making it more effective. The pain was incredibly less but Avrin still was careful. To not try and over do it.
As 40 minutes had passed his aura seemed somewhat more stable and his skin seemed to give off a shine. He also felt he was able to breathe better. The pores on his body open as if they themselves were taking in the fresh air.
Izanami was laying down while gazing at Avrin, drooling from how attractive he looked and at the prospect of her being able to use him for her own gain.
After the 50 minute mark had passed, Izanami wasted no time in calling out “Sir Avrin! 50 minutes has passed!!”
Avrin who had not entered a full trance as to keep aware just a bit in case his aura went rampant again. Slowly he began to condense the outward energy completely and would bring it back inside himself before slowly opening his eyes and looking around.
He slowly stood up and stretched. His bones and muscles felt as if they had been taken out and given special treatment, like he had rested for years. He felt reborn, the feeling was similar to how he felt when he first got this body.
He raised his hands and created a void sphere. To his surprise it was at least 20% quicker and 15% larger as well. It also had a darker gloss color and purple hue. He fired it towards a nearby tree as Izanami jumped slightly at the sight, as well as fright. This being her first time seeing such an attack.
The bolt collided with the tree trunk as it cracked through half way before the rest had been eaten away. The tree which was quite thick came crashing down as the birds that were resting in it flew off in fright. The sound echoing for a few moments before dying down.
“In general, the bolt since the elven forest is 3x stronger, but with this I suppose its even more so..I'm eager to continue..” Avrin then heard clapping from the far left and he turned to see Izanami and sighed in his head realising she was here.
“That was incredible sir Avrin!“ She smiled, full of compliments for him. She then stood up and made her way towards him. “What will you do now?..”
Avrin knew she would interfere in his training so he decided he would try and put an end to this. “How about we spar Izanami?..” To which she happily jumped up and down before nodding “Please give me a moment!” She left and went into the forest towards the mansion.
15 minutes had passed and Avrin was doing pushups, reaching his 3rd set. He didn’t want to overdo it on one section of his body and also did sit ups and chin ups using a nearby branch. But he stopped as he saw Izanami shoot from the forest like a blur. He widened his eyes to see her in her shinobi attire.
He then grinned “Very good Izanami. I shall finally get to see you in battle” He spoke as he had figured Ayame was the more powerful one. to him, Izanami was something to take his frustration out on.
She smiled with a faint grin “Thank you sir Avrin. Well then, like the rules with Ayame, no killing, and only when one gives up or a knockout occurs is when the match is over. Let us begin”
Avrin widened his eyes “Wait you were present for that due-!” Before he finished, Izanami shot out like a black blur which shocked Avrin who quickly augmented his eyes only to see her a few feet away from him. If he was to guess, she was at least twice as fast as Ayame in her normal form.
And he didn’t even have time to set up a shadow wall. He quickly formed a void blade using his left hand and slashed downwards towards her. Izanami showed a menacing look before her mana condensed on her forehead, emitting the white dragon symbol before she vanished with frightening speed. Avrin could barely notice her. He saw her mana trail but she had vanished.
He knew it was over. The word “-overkill-” Appeared in his head before he blacked out. Izanami had landed a powerful kick between his shoulder and neck knocking him out effectively. She was more precise than Ayame who wasn't good when it came to aggressiveness.
Avrin collapsed downwards but Izanami vanished again before catching him in her arms. “Oh dear oh dear. Sir Avrin, I apologise...It’s been so long since I have battled someone I admire...And your battle with Ayame had gotten me excited in more than one way…” She blushed heavily. Even though Avrin couldn't hear her she continued to talk.
20 minutes passed and Avrin slowly opened his eyes. He felt his head was on a sort of pillow, it was comfortable he could see the sky and the sun, but something was wrong. Why was half the sky missing and half the sun too.
What was those black bulges blocking his view of such a beautiful sight. He then opened his eyes some more and looked carefully he then widened them before leaning up hitting his head against the bulges. “Kya!! Sir Avrin, so assertive..” those bulges were Izanami’s large breasts.
Avrin quickly pushed her away as he rubbed his head showing an annoyed look as he thought to himself “-Damn this seductive crone...-” Not only for her pulling such a trick after knocking him out, but for the fact that she beat him with little effort. She was obviously more powerful than Ayame and he underestimated her based on her personality.
He then turned to gaze at Izanami who was sitting down. Her knees bent down as she grinned with a smile while looking at Avrin. “Sir Avrin, would you like to try again?..” A droplet of sweat appeared on his forehead before he shook his head with annoyance.

Avrin had managed to shoo Izanami who left with a sigh and a pout, but he cared not for her frustration. After she had left he began using the dummy that was nearly identicle to a wing chund dummy in his own universe. Something used by martial artists.
Although this one had some sort of mana inside of it, and it responsed to Avrin’s movements. It was somewhat quick to hit away his hand but he would have no trouble memorizing its attack pattern. It didnt seem to be so advanced so he adjusted himself to it.
He continued to use the dummy while also continously training his body with a regime of push ups and sit ups aswell as several sets to train his legs. His own worlds excercises seemed weird here, but it was still as effective if not even more so due to the physics being different.
He did not forget to train his posture and attack stance. This was due to him looking at a large tablet sticking out from the ground showing attack stances that seemed like a basic building block for the white dragon. Although he saw Ayame use it before, she seemed to remove it completly. Most likely due to anger.
Izanami on the other hand had just rushed at him and ended it quickly, a truly frightful opponent. Avrin found the stance of the white dragon clan to be quite good, although it required one to tighten their muscles and move their legs in a position that would make it hard to budge. It seemed like this stance was mainly used for defence.
What intrigued him was what use was this stance for a clan that specialised in killing techniques.
The day went by fairly quickly as Avrin found himself to be enjoying it quite a bit. He had removed his top and left only the tight outfit that pressed against his muscles melding quite well with his upper body.
He dared not remove it all as he was worried Izanami would spy on him. Once he had finished, he dropped down onto a bench and panted heavily. This training was indeed more effective than when he was in the cave. He had more open space as well as ideas to follow the feeling of his meditation. It helped a lot and gave him a sort of adrenaline burst that made him feel energetic.
“I can definitely do this for months on end if it means I can get stronger…“ He spoke while panting softly. To which a voice called out “Ho ho ho! Avrin, it seems your working hard! I’m glad to see my first personal disciple isn’t a slouch.”
Avrin turned to see Shimaru walking toward the training area. “Teacher, you’re back?” Shimaru nodded “Yes, everything is taken care of. Speaking of which, I can already see a change in you. You seem to have used the pulsing dragon correctly. You know, not everyone gets it right after a couple of goes. It’s a technique that takes months to learn and years to master.”
Avrin chuckled with a smile “Unfortunately I have only learned it. I doubt I am close to mastering it.” Shimaru nodded and as he approached a small arena like section he gazed at the basic stance that was drawn. “Oo, I forgot we had this here. It represents the Dragon’s Gaze stance.
And just like that, as if his motions were fluid like water, he used the stance that put Avrin to shame. No movement was in a stutter, his entire body moved as if each limb knew what to do and had done so a million times. As he entered the stance perfectly, he did not move a centimeter, not even the wind could budge him. It was as if he was more still then a statue.
“Amazing..” Avrin thought to himself, although he wondered how good the stance actually was . Avrin grinned and formed a void sphere, not skimping out on its power before firing it towards Shimaru.
Shimaru’s gaze was fixed infront of him and the sphere headed to his side. The moment the sphere entered his personal space, as if like a blur, it was like he teleported 5 feet infront the sphere hitting him but it seemed like what it hit was an after image.
The void sphere/bolt shot upwards towards the sky before vanishing to god knows where. Shimaru smiled as he broke his stance and leaned up casually towards Avrin. “Avrin, the Dragons Gaze is a stance that focuses on the surroundings around its user. Nothing escapes it. Its as if everything is right infront of you even when it is behind you.”
Avrin was indeed interested in learning a technique. He could not just rely on his augmented eyes to detect people. Afterall, he couldnt see the back of his head. “Avrin, this stance is also a precursor to the Dragon’s Wrath. A powerful counter attack. If used right there are some spells that can be sent back to the caster if countered correctly. Being projectiles of course.”
Avrin stood up nodded as he bowed to show respect. He indeed didn’t want to show any disrespect to Shimaru who could definetly teach him a lot.
“Very well then Avrin, we are continuing your training.” Avrin blinked “But teacher, I’ve just finished?” Shimaru only chuckle and grinned evily “What are you talking about...Whatever you have done until now was only a warm up.”
Avrin felt it was dangerous to argue with this man even though he knew where this was going. From that night, the days went on fairly strictly with Avrin training like no tommorow until his body collapsed each time. And when he could move his body again, he was forced to train more.
He felt as if his heart would stop at any moment, and it was so intense that it made him want to vomit. It seemed training fatigue was less here, which was a bonus, but not enough to help significantly. Ayame had also recovered and demanded a rematch with Avrin. There were several times where she was indeed aiming to try and secretly attack him while he was training, but Izanami was tasked with taking her back.
Avrin of course, knew this would happen and could only laugh a bit everytime this occured. He knew that sooner or later he would have to fight Ayame. Shimaru also seemed to enjoy himself. Occasionally he would leave to tend to his duties as well as deal with issues, leaving Avrin to train by himself, but when he returned he made sure Avrin worked twice as hard.
Avrin felt his training regime was more fluid until it became second nature. He didn’t have trouble finding things to do, it was like an endless clock. He moved from one thing to another. Avrin also didn’t forget to use the Pulsing Dragon. Shimaru did his best to be around when Avrin had done so.
It seemed with each time Avrin entered the Pulsing Dragon, the time he could sustain it increased by 5 minutes, and his aura became sharper and more stable. Like a silent fire that gently fluttered in the wind. But it was far from complete.
Shimaru had also told Avrin regarding times his clan had fought the demons. It turns out Shimaru’s great great great grandfather had been the son to the clan leader at that time. There were several demons that tried to kill him at the same time but he had used a technique and in a near instant killed them all.
Avrin wondered if there were other individuals as strong as these people, and if they were compareable to sigil wielders. Of course Shimaru replied by telling him that sigil wielders, no matter what, were capable of monsterous abilities that rivaled dragons. Even if it meant there bodies themselves weren’t trained as much as Shimaru, they would still be a force to be reckoned with.
Also, over the course of the training, Avrin felt his mind ease up. As if he had forgotten the outside world. There had been several times where he had even forgotten he was in a different universe altogether. The famillar feeling brought a smile to his face.
He had also managed to build a relation with Shimaru as well as the others. Although Avrin hadn’t returned to the main house in nearly 6 weeks after beggining his training in the open, he was told to live in the outdoors and get used to the environment as well as the sounds.
Avrin, who felt like there was a reason, didn’t hesitate to accept. Life went on quite hard but well for Avrin. Meanwhile in the demon capital of Yasha, a large castle like building adorned with what seemed like black jade and other imposing materials that would make one think of an omen just by looking at it, seemed to be heavily guarded.
Inside this building was the thousand demon hall. A near pitch black hallway that spanned several hundred meters to the sides, showing no visibility with only the pillars bieng revealed with what seemed like torched emiting a sort of mana fire.
At the end of the hallway was a large throne adorned with gold and expensive jewels as well as several skulls from what seemed like many species. There were even several skulls that emitted a sort of divine feeling. One would know those skulls belonged to angels.
On this throne was a female wearing a dress that had its bottom section open, revealing her perfectly shaped thighs. The dress itself consisted of a few shades of red, black, and purple. As one looked up they could see this female also had a fairly large bust, but if they looked up more they would see she looked quite uniquely attractive. But also terryfing. She had large horns sticking out of the side of her head as well as elven like ears that were pointed. Her face showed a terryfying smile and her eyes narrowed as she gazed at an object. Her hair was quite long and was a deep crimson red.
Support the creativity of authors by visiting for this novel and more.
The object she had been gazing at was what seemed like a book that was open. The book itself gave off a terryfing aura and seemed to be detailed and made quite well. But what the book showed was even more interesting. As if showing a hologram.
It revealed Avrin during his fight with Syrana and his appearance as well as somehow managed to transmit some of his aura/dark matter. The book was the Void grimoire. One of the great sigil weapons that had many unique magics. And its user was none other then the Demon queen Driada. Whos eyes were fixed on the creature that was Avrin. She spoke in a soothing yet sharp voice “It’s a shame I cant enter the sylph lands. I would of liked to have gotten that man..” She licked her lips showing a smirk “That aura is truly different to what I have ever seen before” She gazed at the synthetic dark matter that void seemed to have made. It was only small fragments.
“I’ve never heard of a case where void was not able to fully reproduce energy” She gazed with interest and as she touched the dark matter. It ate away at her finger causing her to clench her teeth and pull her hand back to which a voice replied. “My queen! Are you all right!!?”
Driada chuckled and smiled “It’s fine“ She spoke as the wound began to heal. “This is terryfing. An energy that devours...I do not think that Myra would allow Syrana to kill this individual so easily… I must have him and I must have his ability...Herutus, take three of your trusted men with you and go to the Sylph lands. Find anything you can about him. I will allow you to take a fragment of void to help you track him.”
The man that had called out revealed himself as he knelt down. He wore a thin plate of dark steel armor that covered his body. Even his head had a makeshift helmet, with his back also revealing a cloak that showed the demon empire symbol and colors. “Yes my queen..”
Without hesitation, he vanished to accomplish his task. Even though he knew it could take decades to track this man down, failure was not an option, as the demon queen was not forgiving.
Driada continued to watch the event on replay with a smile on her face “Oh how he reminds me of him…”
Seleria itself had gone on without issue over the course of this time where there were events of powerful individuals appearing in Gaia academy as well as the human king leo who held many events to try and win favor with this individuals, even though he was much stronger.
Little did anyone know that an individual would soon come to shake the foundations of not only Gaia academy, but the entire world of Seleria itself, in good time.
2 years had passed since Avrin begun training. To him, the first few months were like an endless cycle of hell where he was barely allowed to rest. Even his own body had trouble keeping things in check. But after a certain amount of time training, his body developed significantly quicker. He had developed his stamina as well as the efficiency of his muscles.
He had even developed more abilities in secret, and managed to improve his energy and power overall. Avrin was seated on one of the few rocks sticking out of the lake in Pulsing Dragon position. His aura had showed but it seemed like it froze in midair. The appearance was more clear, it had a sort of cosmic feeling to it.
As if when one looked at it, they could see the stars and space inside of it. A mysterious aura that seemed to be frozen in time. Avrin’s appearance hadn’t changed at all, other then his body seeming more toned, it seemed like being a Spectral had its positives.
As his eyes opened from completing his Pulsing Dragon, his eyes emited a purple glow to which the aura burst forth from his body emiting a shockwave that caused the large lake to rumble before the energy retracted back inside of him.
A voice called out. It was from a young boy who came towards Avrin after the event had ended. “Big brother, grandfather has asked you to return to the dojo” The voice sounded a bit more mature then the previous years. It was none other than Amias, who wore his own shinobi gear. With a smile, he looked at Avrin who was now standing up. “Very well.. I’ll be there soon” Avrin’s body seemed to glow a deep purple for a moment, as if it flashed like a camera going off before he vanished and reappeared on the shoreline. His speed in general wasn’t as fast as that, but it was a technique he developed imbuing his power into the White Dragon’s skills. It was called Shadow Step.
He developed this ability on his first year, although there were mishaps such as him appearing in midair and falling, it consisted of him using his outer and internal energy to pull himself across the mana in the air. Although what really happened was his body was converted to dark matter in a near instant and reformed at the position he wanted.
He had practiced with many inatimate objects and even with animals such as fish or a squirrel like creature with failure and success. Sometimes the objects or animals wouldn’t reform and were devoured completely. He worried he may devour himself but after practicing and training he felt he had done well enough to not worry about it.
Avrin began to make his way toward the dojo. His appearance was that of shinobi like training pants, but he kept his tight shirt on. “I wonder what he needs from me. It’s the first time in 2 years that I’ve passed through this section” Avrin spoke, somewhat excited, even though he didnt show it.
Avrin then blinked as he looked around and smirked. He entered a stance that resembeled the Dragon’s Gaze but the difference was that dark matter slowly emited around him. He kept silent. That was until several objects like kunais were thrown towards him.
His body seemed to distort slightly as the objects seemed to vanish from one side and repappear on the other. This technique was known as Shadow Dragon’s Gaze. A name fitting as it incorperated Dragon’s Gaze and Shadow Step into a stance and a near perfect defence.
“Would you believe that 2 years ago...You would have the coruage to face me head on, but now it seems like your sticking to your clans teachings and sticking to hiding” Avrin spoke out in a snicker.
To which a blue streak made its way toward him before reappearing above him. It was none other then Ayame, who seemed quite pissed off as her signature vein appeared on her forhead. She kicked her leg towards Avrin. “Die bastard!!!!!!!”
Avrin shut his eyes before shifting and turning his body in a slight spin. He had swepped over to the Dragon’s Gaze stance and, as if it was second nature to him, avoided her kick. But at the same time elegantly dodged and hit his left palm towards her hip. A large thump sound was heard as the force of the attack was not as strong as he made it to be due to not wanting to severly injure her, but it was enough to send a small shockwave towards the tree line.
Ayame screamed out and gasped as she was thrown several feet and rolled before clutching her hip. “N..No fair….Grandfather trained you...It’s not fair that you’re stronger!!”
Avrin felt a bit of pity for her, and decided to cheer her up. He walked over and smiled as he leaned down and tried to sound as if appealing to her. “Ayame, I want to thank you...If it wasn’t for the duel years ago, I would never have had the confidence to continue..It’s only because I looked up to you that I wanted to continue and work so hard.”
Ayame’s face lit up a deep red before she kept silent. As if steam was about to leave her ears “W..W..W.W..Wha..Wha?” She was indeed speechless as  she was not used to these words. She covered her face before standing up forgetting about her injury and heading off somewhat giggling to herself.
Avrin shook his head after realising it was all clear “Simple minded girl...But It’s fine” He chuckled to himself before heading towards Shimaru’s dojo. He hadn’t seen him for nearly 3 weeks, so he was eager to meet him again.
The servants also greeted Avrin as he entered the dojo grounds and pressed his hand againt the door. He spoke “Teacher, I’ve arrived…” Before opening the sliding door. His eyes widened at the sight as a vein appeared on his forhead before he managed to keep his composure. But his muscles pulsed in his body as if they were going to burst forth from anger, but he let out a fake smile.
“Ahh Avrin It’s good you are here.. I would like to introduce you to the Sylph that helped our clan all those years back. She is one of the two leaders of the Sylph race. Her name is Myra”
Myra who was sitting a few feet away from Shimaru turned and blinked as she gazed at Avrin before giving the slyest grin one would ever come to realise.
