Avrin had entered and taken a seat opposite of Myra, his arms folded and his eyes shut as he tried to hide his anger that wanted a chance to come out of the years of being suppressed to a degree. Avrin had managed to deal with Ayame whenever she tried to attack him. Every time she would, he would just give a few sweet words and watch her light up like a firework before heading off for a few days. She was the brawn and no brain type to an extent and it was also amusing to watch.
Izanami often bothered him but it seemed she had been told by her father as well as Shimaru to stop bothering Avrin, so he hadn't seen her in nearly a year and a half, which was good. Amias was the same considering he had his own training. Avrin had seen him battle an opponent before he was sent to train for 2 years and secluded. Amias had potential, others said he was a genius like his father but Avrin didn't know enough about his father to know.
And now comes the main point, the one that had trapped Avrin in a magical shield and had to make him feel like an experiment. What made it worse was she was the one that had helped Shimaru’s clan. Avrin had to think of a way out of this, but was also wondering why she was here.
The room was silent for awhile before Shimaru let out his joyful santa like laugh and spoke “Ho ho ho! Myra I forgot to ask, what brings you to this humble estate?” Shimaru asked as if trying to also seek an answer.
Myra smiled as she sat cross legged. It looked cute considering she was a loli “Shi, I received your letter regarding humans knowing of your clans existence” She spoke in a somewhat lecture tone towards him which made him rub the back of head and grin as if he were a child. Then again, Myra, being a Sylph, was most likely centuries older than him, even if she didn't look it. “I’m sorry Myra, it seems my old age has made me forget a bit to often.”
Myra smiled and then turned to Avrin with a mischievous grin. She could see he was hiding his frustration “Avrin, Shi has told me in his letter about a disciple with an enigmatic ability with a unique aura unlike anything of this world. I just had to come here and see for myself”
Avrin gave a soft glare. From her words alone, it wasn't hard for him to know she identified Shimaru’s disciple as him. “I’m grateful lady Myra that you consider me as such an important disciple of teacher.” He spoke giving face to Shimaru. This test was to see how well he did under pressure. The last time they met, Avrin showed a lot of anger, and this sudden change made Myra widen her eyes in shock as if she were speaking to an entirely different person.
But it seems they both had the idea that they would not let Shimaru know they had met before. “Ahh yes Myra, Avrin is indeed unique...Over these past 2 years his progress has been astonishing...I have never met anyone like him before. I'm starting to even doubt he is a demon considering his body’s development” Avrin just gave a soft chuckle and spoke in a jokeful tone “Haha teacher, you even doubt your own disciple. I feel saddened”
Shimaru gazed at Avrin and grinned “Was it you who put the condition of not asking personal questions? This cannot be considered personal“ Shimaru was right. As long as he did not personally ask Avrin it wasn't considered unfair.
Myra smiled and looked at Avrin with a wink “Well your disciple is indeed handsome. That is a fact. I’m sure there are many females out there who would want a strong and attractive individual like yourself. I’m sure even Syrana would be intrigued with you”
That name made Avrin almost cringe as he tensed his stomach. He knew she did that on purpose and his face was a little red. Not from embarrassment but from anger. He gave another soft chuckle and spoke “My dear lady Myra, unfortunately I am not interested in a relationship as I have my own self to work on.”
Myra nodded and gazed at Shimaru “Shi, I would like some time alone with your disciple. If that is ok. It seems this way I may get to know more about him.” Shimaru gazed at Avrin. Even though he was his teacher, he wouldn't force Avrin to do something he wouldn't like. Avrin smiled and bowed to Shimaru slightly “Teacher, it is fine. I would also like to talk to lady Myra. Maybe I could get to know the outside world more”
Shimaru folded his arms and let out a sort of lonely huff before nodding “Very well, very well. Then I shall take my leave. I need to speak with my son anyway.” Shimaru, although old and wise, was still young at heart, which was why he acted younger than his age occasionally. He got up and left, leaving Myra and Avrin gazing at each other.
Myra spoke first “So Avri-.” before she could continue Avrin interrupted. “I have no idea what you are doing here..But I recommend you not bother me. I've little patience for your kind after trapping me like a pet”
Myra blinked in surprise before laughing “Hahaha, you waste little time in releasing pent up frustration. Ahh, I guess that was a bit uncalled for. I apologise Avrin, but as you know I take the safety of my race before anything else… As for keeping you there” She sighed and pouted “It brought quite a bit of bad luck so I wouldn’t dare to bring you back. I’m afraid of the angels finding out again”
Avrin raised a brow and spoke “Angels finding out again? So that battle with those winged creatures. They were angels?” Myra blinked and smiled “I would expect you to know about them. There isn’t a being alive that doesn't know angels exist. At least a few times in a lifetime one will see an angel, but there are drawings of them. And yet you don't know what they appear like”
Avrin kept his arms folded before speaking “Whatever the case, I owe them thanks. Without their interference I wouldn’t have been free from that cage” Myra sighed and gave a soft whimper “Heyy thats a gift from the goddess Lenaya. Have a little respect brat“ She spoke angrily which was also somewhat cute.
Avrin grinned as he wanted to anger her a little more after what she did “I'm sorry, but I do not believe in the gods of this world” Myra clenched her fists while making a sour face before realising something. “Oohh gods of this world. Does that mean you're not from Seleria?”
Avrin only smiled “I’m sorry Myra, but I’d rather not answer that. Oh yes, I have to ask your Sigil Weapon something. Do you have it with you?”
Myra almost jumped back at being asked that question, as she was cautious. “Yes I do. I never leave without it...Do not attempt to steal it…” Avrin raised his hands as if surrendering a bit “I wouldn't dream of it. I would only like to examine it a little. After all, you're more than capable of defeating me easily”
Myra pondered this. She was a bit cautious, he was, after all, a being that was dangerous enough to be kept in that cage. In truth, she did wanted to capture him, but she knew Shimaru would interfere, and she did not want to ruin relations. Not to mention she knew Avrin had gotten more powerful and was giving her face by saying she was more powerful. In truth, she felt like it would be a dangerous battle.
But she discovered something. She smiled “Oh I will let you hold it and examine it for as long as you like on one condition” Avrin raised a curious brow expecting to give something in return. “As a fairy, our curiosity, unlike our elven counterparts, are easily piqued. And you are more than just an enigmatic level user. I want to know more about you Avrin… If you satisfy my curiosity I will tell you all you like about moonwing and even assist you in what you need.”
Avrin thought carefully. On one side, he got to see the structure of a Sigil Weapon as well as receive her assistance whenever he needed. The sigil weapon alone is enough for him to consider it, as he needed a template of the gods power. But what she asked for made him iffy. Regarding it, he wouldn't be able to lie to a being of magic. 
The author's tale has been misappropriated; report any instances of this story on Amazon.
Especially a Sigil user like her. “Very well. I'll tell you the bare minimum. There is no way for me to see if you are trustworthy or not...Since you will be the only one I have told on Seleria, if this spreads, I'll know who spread it.“ He spoke in a sort of threatful manner which made Myra shiver a bit.
She smiled and nodded before scooting closer to Avrin with curious eyes, like a child. Which made him feel uncomfortable. He shook his head and took a deep breath before looking around making sure no one was listening in. Especially Izanami. After it seemed clear he spoke. “I am not from this world or from this plane of existence…” He spoke thinking they wouldn't know what a universe was. It seemed easier.
Myra gazed for a moment giving a sort of poker face before examining Avrin to see if he was lying. Reading his outward mana as well as his expressions, and in that moment her mouth dropped open “Wow wow WOW!!!!!!!!! Doesn't that mean you're a god to?!!!!!!” She almost wanted to jump around and cling onto him to ask more but he spoke to keep her still “I am not a god...Infact you can say that I was a human who was given a second chance by god..”
Myra tilted her head and spoke as she clicked her finger “Reincarnation!” Avrin nodded “Indeed” Myra then smiled and spoke again “Then which god Reincarnated you? Was it Septem? Or maybe Zephiroron? Or eve-” Avrin sighed and spoke “None of those lesser gods….Don’t lump them together with god himself”
Myra was astounded at his words. Referring to the creators of Seleria as lesser, she was sure the heavens would split in rage if they had heard. He continued to speak “The god I am referring to is creature of this existence. The creator of your gods….Do not tell me you thought that since you live on Seleria that those 8 gods created everything else? Hah” Avrin almost chuckled which made Myra turn red with embarrassment. She didn't know what to say. She felt Avrin wasn't lying to her, but she was still careful.
“Then who is this one god?” Myra spoke before Avrin smiled “That is all I’ll tell you about him. I'm quite sure he is listening in right now and I would not like to face his wrath. Moving on, I am not a demon, and I am not an Enigmatic level user.”
Myra’s jaw almost dropped again but instead she asked “Not a demon? But you look so much like one!“ She reached over and began to tug on his pointed ears before stopping, giving a teehee sound as she saw he looked irritated. “I’m what the god that created me calls a Spectral. I know little of this race but I dare not share information with you as it may be used against me” He spoke solidly. Knowing it wasn't wise to speak about what he was. It was an advantage he would rather not tell, even though Myra was pouting like a child before speaking again.
“Fine fine..Then, if you won't tell me that. What did you mean by you are not an Enigmatic level user?” Avrin opened his palm and emitted a nebula mist. “In this existence, mana creates everything. From inanimate objects to life itself. There isn't anything that isn’t made from mana. That is where I come in.
I am made from purely what is known as dark matter. It is manas equivalent in my own plane of existence. I am able to convert mana and turn it into dark matter to create my abilities and so forth. You could say in this world it would be like an individual who is freely able to control mana without limits”
Myra blinked with interest. She was indeed right to assume Avrin was unique and cage him to begin with. His potential, if given time, was indeed capable of being godlike and somewhat frightening. She dared not ask questions without first confirming something “So a being such as you with limitless power...What do you intend to do on Seleria? Become a hero or someone that burns everything to the ground?” She spoke with a serious tone and look.
Avrin gazed and only grinned “That is my business. From what I have seen, Seleria is indeed interesting, and burning it will be of no use to me as long as people do not provoke me. I have no need to hurt or kill anyone. As for my purpose” Avrin smirked and narrowed his eyes at Myra. His eyes began to glow a deep purple as they emitted an aura which frightened her a bit. She knew Avrin was indeed significantly stronger than before.
“I intend to be a god myself” Myra froze as she stayed quiet for a moment before gazing at Avrin, clenching the hand which the sigil was imbued in. “A god?...Do you not want to help people and receive praise?...There are many that are suffering even in these times of peace, you would be hailed as a hero.”
Avrin chuckled softly and smiled “I have no need to help those who are in distress. I do not want to be a hero. That title has no meaning for me, nor do I seek pleasure in praise from those individuals. I would like to progress by myself and focus on my own path. I shall not bother anyone if they do not bother me a fair deal. Now then Myra, if your curiosity is sated I think it’s fair you allow me to examine your Sigil.
Myra frowned at Avrin’s reply but she knew someone with his mindset and self arrogance could not change easily, but she was certain she could change it in time. Someone like him, capable of being a god, could be the symbol of hope. The gods of Seleria did not interfere, so she wanted to try and change his mind in time.
“Very well Avrin…” She raise her hand to which an object which seemed like a broken semicircle floated from her right palm into midair before a bright light flashed and the staff Moonwing appeared. Before she could hand it to Avrin he reached over and took it as he looked at it.
His eyes augmented as he examined the mana flow as well as emitted a new type of dark matter particle that helped discern materials. “This is indeed powerful….I can see why Syrana managed to use her own to nearly kill me so easily..” He spoke with annoyance.
Avrin then noticed some runes on the staff rod of moonwing “This is...similar to that of the tome. Myra what do these markings mean?” He spoke curiously to which she smiled and scooted closer to Avrin, almost brushing against him playfully “These markings translate to The Divine Staff Moonwing, given by favor of the divine gods to help protect the Sylph Race From the Draconic power”
Avrin tilted his head. “Draconic power?” Myra, now knowing Avrin was new, explained to him “Centuries ago, a Dragon awoke during a war and decimated nearly all the forces of 4 races. And in return, the god Septim, along with the other gods, bestowed Sigils upon their created race to combat Dragons should they attack.”
Avrin smiled. He enjoyed the history of Seleria. It seemed so unreal, like a plot in a fantasy game. He felt a little otaku inside himself as he grinned. “So you can read these runes... Well then, do me a favor…” Avrin, using the nebula mist that was floating in mid air after he grabbed Moonwing, formed the mythological Tome in a few seconds which was significantly quicker than when he first did, so he truly had advanced a lot.
He reached for the Tome, taking it from mid air as the faint nebula mist like aura engulfing it dispersed. Myra, who was watching with curiosity, was handed the Tome by Avrin “The markings on your weapon resemble the ones on this tome...Decipher it please”
Avrin knew shop keeper understood a bit of the words on it, but seeing Moonwing’s markings made him forget about the weapon altogether. After spotting the runes on the weapon, he wanted to know what this tome hid. And it had been 2 years since he had bothered to think about it. Now was perfect.
Myra was gazing curiously at it. She would then raise her hand, imbuing a light magic onto the Tome to see it clearer. She gave a look of excitement and happiness. “Amazing! This Tome... It’s from one of our most prominent Sylph mages. The first fairy Archmage, Li’redion“ She smiles as if she had remembered something nice. “He is also my grandfather…”
Avrin knew Myra seemed to be somewhat thankful to have something that belonged to her family. Then again, he only wanted to know what it held. If she were to try and steal what it was after he went through the effort of stealing this tome himself there would be problems. He spoke softly “It reads, Myra?..”
Myra shook her head and snapped out of her memory like daze as she began to decipher the Tome

chapters.title: Chapter 41 The past, The Anger, The Task
chapters.content:
:Very Important: Regarding the poll results it was obvious to me on the 2nd day of ch 39 which choice won so i made the order on the 3rd day. there is no eta for the artwork as it is done when i feel it is good enough it will be harder to do right compared to the past ones.
So i got the new 3ds for the new monster hunter 4 game and i was hoping to take atleast a week off to relax and play it aswell as spend time with family and tend to rl matters before uni starts for me i hope you will all understand.
this means unless i feel bored i wont be writing any raws and no chs will be pred until everything's settled. i know the contents of this ch so i would like to apologize in advance for those of you who know how i end my chs this may be the deadliest one yet.il see you all in a week il be active for the first day or so to look at this thread and comment on you guys. :) enjoy ch 41
-------
Myra was over the moon for a chance to read a relic left behind by her grandfather, a fairy that had been proclaimed as the most powerful Sylph to have ever lived with magic no inferior to abbadon or the demon king. A man who had helped during the first great war and had saved many lives.
A tear was welling up and she seemed like she was about to burst out crying but Avrin cleared his throat to get her attention and she laughed quietly “Hehe..It begins with this. The Heavens are said to be the limits of what us mortals can achieve, and there is no arguing that it is. The heavens where the 8 gods reside and take care of their duties is a place of joyous harmony where departed mortals may meet their makers. But one would be shunned if they were to think there was something beyond the heavens. I shall not shy away from admitting I am one. The sky erupted with a flash and brought down a tear of fire leaving only a mysterious rock no larger then a human arm.
It is strange yet divine, it is menacing yet it is comforting, it is enigmatic yet it holds much. It lies where he rests, as a token of friendship the one k...known as...l...Lung…” Myra stuttered those last names with fear as she began to wobble with the tome in her hands. “I..I’m sorry Avrin, but give up getting whatever is hidden….”
Avrin, who seemed excited that she was able to translate it, now frowned with disappointment at her words “And why is that?” He spoke firmly with no intent to back down. Myra looked him in the eye before giving a faint smile. “Because the one known as Lung...Is a Dragon of this continent…”
Avrin’s heart froze the instant he heard that. Although he was not one to back down easily, dragons, after the gods, were the most terrifying of creatures capable of wiping out armies with a single breathe. Only Sigil wielders were capable of combating them and having a chance. Even then it is unknown.
Avrin was quiet before speaking softly “Myra, where does this Lung dwell?..” Myra’s eyes widened at the fact that he may ask “Are you out of your mind Avrin? to go is certain death and you want to steal from him?”
Avrin thought as he rubbed his chin “Surely a dragon would have no use for a piece of sky metal like that… I’m sure I can offer a trade to him of something more useful.”
Myra seemed to calm down a bit but was still thinking that this idea was crazy. She began to rub her temples as she gazed at him “Avrin, if what you have told me is true, you are an individual with limitless potential...And something like that shouldn’t be wasted if your going to go. I would like to send someone with you. That is my only condition”
Avrin glared at her “Do you mock me, Sylph?...To think I need a babysitter?...” Avrin was annoyed at her by thinking he needed protection like that. Myra gasped and frowned, quietly she said “Avrin, this is a dragon capable of destroying kingdoms….I'm not mocking you in any way, but assistance is always helpful…”
Avrin let out a deep breathe before sighing after nodding. “Before I accept who is it you're sending with me?” Myra seemed to smirk a bit before speaking “She should be here soon...After all, she was the one that helped train Ayame.”
Avrin had a bad feeling, his heart was itching at this “Wait, she?...And helped train Ayame…?” He began to think about the situation but couldn't exactly put it together, but something was telling him it wasn't a good idea. “Heh...Regardless, does the tome say anything else about the sky metal? Anything at all of where it is kept?”
Myra gazed back at the tome and nodded. “From where we left off...It is said its kept within Lung’s chambers, stashed with endless riches accumulated from tribute from creatures of that time.”
Avrin began to ponder about the situation. “To identify something like that will be annoying...I can only hope I come up with a fair deal for the dragon to let him get it for me...Otherwise I’m not fond of becoming a morsel…” He nearly spat out.
A gentle voice was heard outside. “Lady Myra, sir Avrin, your friend has arrived.” A loud voice called out. “What the hell? Avrin??? That bastard is here!!??” It couldn't be. Avrins eyes widened as his mouth opened slightly, his fist clenched and he gazed at Myra, giving her a deadly, icy glare. Myra seemed to avoid eye contact as she twiddled her thumbs together. “Myra you…” Avrin gently spoke to which he looked at the door as it was slid open and almost broke. Standing in the doorway was none other than who Avrin cursed daily under his breathe. It was Syrana.
“-This wench…-” Avrin thought to himself. Syrana then gazed at Avrin and quickly formed eclipse in her hand. “I dont think so…” Avrin spoke before using a shadow step, appearing directly in front of  Syrana after a flash of dark light, who gasped in surprise right as Avrin was about to impale her in the stomach. Syrana show at him with an elemental arrow.
Myra called out with her mana bursting forth “STOP!!” Right then they both stopped at the moment they were about to end each other. Avrin came to his senses and took a deep breathe as he backed off, knowing he was better than this. He had held a grudge against her for so long he acted too rashly. It made him almost want to laugh. As he made his way back, he spoke.
“Myra, I hope you don't intend to send this sadistic woman with me…”  Syrana glared at Avrin, her bow, Eclipse, still in hand as she had sweated a bit from Avrin’s near instant speed. It had caught her off guard, she felt he was incomparably stronger than before.
“I am not sadistic….Couldn't you stay dead….Endangering the forest, and now you're here in this estate…” Avrin clicked his tongue and huffed as he sat down, recomposing himself before Myra patted the seat next to her for Syrana who just walked over to a nearby wall and leaned against it. Myra sighed and began to talk. “Syrana, long story short...Avrin is now the disciple of Shimaru… And we have come to an understanding..”
Syrana rolled her eyes and gazed off, but she didn't bother arguing. It seemed that things had already been settled. “So what is this with this sending me with him stuff?..” She spoke fiercely but curiously.
Myra then replied. “Avrin found a relic of my grandfather...And it reveals the location of a piece of sky metal.” Syrana’s eyes were focused on the tome in Myra’s hand, then grinned “Oo sky metal. I have yet to see a piece. If I remember correctly Myra, your grandfather was the most powerful of our race. To think he was in possession of sky metal.”
Myra cleared her throat and spoke “It is no longer in his possession. It is with, uhh...Lung” Syrana stayed quiet before a deadly killing intent slowly leaked out. She despised dragons even more so than Avrin. After all, her father was killed by Tiamat.
“So were getting it...And we are fighting Lung for it?..” She spoke with a hungry tone. “There is no we. There is only me and any other Sylph you have at your disposal. I refuse to go with her.” Avrin spoke softly and in a composed tone.
Myra gazed at Avrin “Avrin, please be reasonable. I would go myself but I cannot stay away from my people for long. I must head back soon and take care of matters...And Syrana is the only other person with a Sigil weapon that we have connections with.”
Syrana glared at Avrin “It’s fine Myra, why don't I just go by myself. Who needs him anyway...:” Her words annoyed Avrin but Myra seemed to speak fairly “Syrana, regardless of the circumstances, he found this tome and by right it is his. Besides...Avrin in the future will be a powerful ally, so this sky metal will be a token of friendship.”
Syrana was skeptical regarding Myra’s sudden change of heart, but she figured something must have happened to convince her, and she was someone she knew for several centuries so she didn't argue yet again.
Avrin was also quiet before speaking “Argh...If we are to go together, she isn't to engage the beast in combat...I doubt a silly half Sigil is capable of defeating it..”
Syrana shot a dagger like glare at Avrin as sparks seemed to form between the two “Says the one with no weapon…” Avrin only smirked to himself “If this task goes well, I'll change that using the sky metal…”
Myra’s interest was piqued. She gently scooted closer to Avrin which made Syrana shake her head in disgust. “Y...You know a method to forge sky metal?..” Avrin shook his head. “Not at all. But I know someone who does. “
Myra only gazed with interest before looking at Syrana “Will you go with him?..” Syrana was quiet before she looked away “Fine...But if he or the dragon annoys me they're both gone..”
The deal was settled. Avrin was about to stand up but a head peaked out of the opened sliding door. “T..Teacher?..” A female like voice rung out as she looked towards Syrana with a teary face. Syrana then smiled widely and stood properly. “Ahh, little Ayame. It’s been so long!” 
This book was originally published on . Check it out there for the real experience.
Avrin only let a huh? like sound before Ayame came running in dressed in her kimono before cuddling up to Syrana, pressing her face against her chest as she began to cry with happiness. “Teacher...You haven't visited in years!! Have I been a bad student? I’m sorry!!..” Syrana only hugged her and chuckled softly before smiling. “Don’t be silly. I’m sorry, I've been busy, but I will do my best to visit more”
Ayame smiled as she cuddled up to Syrana before opening her eyes and noticing Avrin. “Y..You bastard! You tricked me!!! Being well off with your words to avoid a duel...You pig!!!”
Avrin clenched his teeth while holding his anger back while Syrana let out a grin while rubbing Ayame’s head. Avrin thought to himself, while Ayame continued to curse at him silently while cuddling Syrana “-It figures both those vile bitches are student and teacher. Both of them hate me too-”
Ayame then smiled at Myra as she gently parted from Syrana and bowed. “Lady Myra, I am glad to see you again” Myra gently motioned with her hand as if to say hello “Ayame, you sure have grown since last time. I'm sure you are much stronger.”
Ayame nodded while holding her right arm as if trying to flex and show off. Avrin stood up. Clearly disgusted by the atmosphere of Shimaru’s so called ‘sacred dojo’ and made his way out.
At that moment, both Ayame and Syrana called out in anger “Where do you think you’re going!!” Before they both looked at each other and smiled, to which Avrin called out while outside “To go hang myself…” He spoke in frustration to those two.
After he exited, he noticed Amias waiting outside. He smiled at Avrin. “Ahh, big brother...I have good news..I couldn’t wait to tell you..”
Avrin gently patted his head as if to fake favor with him and smiled “Amias, you seem quite happy. What is this news of yours?” He then spoke, trying not to jump up and down. “Father and grandfather have decided to send me to the Gaia’s branch academy in the central continent! Can you believe it!!”
(PR Note: It’s official, we now have a Naruto character)
Avrin tilted his head and frowned slightly. It seemed even though he tried not to like Amias, he had a little bit of relation with him and would be somewhat sad to see him go. After all, he was used in plans to keep Ayame at bay as well.
“Congratulations! I’m sure you will grow up to be a powerful shinobi. Use this as a chance to spread your clan’s name” Amias nodded. Confirming that was what he intended to do. Calias then came walking by in a casual outfit that resembled a sort of noble attire.
“Amias, are you ready? We need to head off now if we want to reach the ship by nightfall.” He spoke while having three other cloaked individuals around him. Most likely other shinobi that would guard them.
Amias nodded and smiled “Yes father, I was just saying goodbye to big brother” Calias let a sort of hmph sound as he gazed at Avrin before nodding “Very well, let us be off now. The carriage is waiting.” Amias nodded to which he followed his father towards the outside of the estate.
Avrin knew Calias was jealous of him for winning his father's favor, but it mattered not. This was still only a stepping stone to improve himself. As Avrin made his way towards the main house, he felt someone behind him but with no killing intent. As he slowly turned he was met by a large embrace as well as a large pair of breasts against his chest as he was hugged tightly.
“Sir Avrin!!! Oh how I have missed you. You are so cruel to keep me away from you for so long~” This was none other than Izanami, who seemed to hold even deeper feelings towards Avrin now.
As he tried to push the lustful female off him with annoyance, Syrana and Ayame came out. Ayame spoke “Izanami, can’t you stop trying to get into his pants!? He is a despicable man!!” Syrana only nodded with agreement before speaking “Izanami, why do you continue to go after men. You should find yourself someone and stay with that person. Love is love. Besides, your younger sister is right, this Avrin is worth no female.”
Avrin only glared at the two while Izanami pouted and spoke “Please stop picking on me. I am free to love who I want, and sir Avrin is the one I want.” Avrin had been annoyed quite a lot today even with his good fortune of finding the location of sky metal. He released a small burst of killing intent. He learned how to use it quite some time ago. And Izanami jumped with fright as it was directed at her. She fell on her butt and whimpered while gazing at Avrin who was walking away.
“Izanami, in the future keep, your hands off me please…” She gazed at Avrin and nodded as she seemed somewhat sad, but not much as she was still intending to use Avrin for her own goals. Ayame went over to help her as she then shot a deadly gaze at Avrin for treating her sister like that regardless.
Avrin, after entering the estate, went looking for Shimaru although he said he would trust him, he never had a good opportunity to tell him about himself and it was long overdue. After being directed, he was led to an internal training room where Shimaru was engaging in a Pulsing Dragon position.
His aura emitting a powerful light and presence as his affinity showed to be air, and was quite clear. Avrin sat down cross legged as he waited for Shimaru to finish. But Shimaru’s voice called out “Ahh, Avrin, you're done with Myra? How did things go?..”
Avrin spoke softly “I plan to leave with Syrana with intention to go find the dragon Lung.” Those words caused Shimaru to break his Pulsing Dragon meditation, which was dangerous if done quickly. A trickle of blood came down the side of his lips but he kept his composure.
“For what purpose would you go to seek your demise?..” Avrin sighed softly as he let a small gulp out. He knew Shimaru was the type to beat him near death to stop him from leaving. “I seek an audience with it to trade something for a fragment of sky metal it wields. I do not seek to combat it.”
Although Shimaru had read that dragons were mostly rational and easy if not angered or provoked, he still didn't like the risk. “And why should I allow you to go. You are my disciple after all, I would rather you train for 5 more years before even thinking of doing so…”
Avrin began to think, that was until he had an idea. He had planned to tell Shimaru about himself without cost but now he could use it as a chip. “If I come back successfully, I will promise to tell you about myself and who I am.”
Shimaru knew Avrin wasn't the type to offer useless things if it was regarding who he was. It would most likely be something important and worth him offering as he was going to risk himself with an audience with a dragon. Shimaru only huffed and began to think. “What would you do with sky metal anyway Avrin? There isn’t anyone capable of forging it”
Avrin only smiled and nodded. “There may be a way to forge it, but i won’t know unless i have it, teacher..Please let me leave for this task.” Avrin knew he could leave whenever he wanted but he felt he owed this man a lot and over the years of training he came to know honor and pride were what made a person. It was something he wanted to be recognised for as well.
Shimaru chuckled softly “Ho ho ho, very well Avrin. How can I deny my disciple. Then, when you return, you will explain yourself to me..”
Avrin smiled and stood up. “Avrin, before you go, take this with you.“ Shimaru went over to a table and picked up a dusty book which seemed like a sort of manuscript. “I had intended to give this to you tomorrow but it is better now since there will be no time. I expect you to learn it on your travels…”
Avrin gazed at the book as he felt it was something that was priceless. “Teacher, what is this?..” Avrin opened the book before widening his eyes, seeing descriptions of attacks and stances as well as techniques he had never heard of before.
“Although you were trained away from the other students and shinobi for 2 years, I taught you all that they know and learned. This manuscript is something my grandfather passed down to my father and from him to me...I had intended to give this to Calias but...I feel he hasn’t truly deserved it...So I want you to have it for now…If I was to judge its rarity Avrin, it is easily of legendary value… I expect great things when you return, so train hard…”
Avrin tilted his head and smiled “I am honored, teacher, and thankful for your assistance over the years. Avrin began to devour the manuscript as Shimaru gazed with a gentle interest. He had found out Avrin was capable of absorbing books and reforming them in the 1st year. His reaction was shocked as he spoke of the many benefits this could reap but was saddened after Avrin declined.
After Avrin said his farewell to Shimaru, he went over to his room and gazed at his belongings that he had not seen for these 2 years. They had gathered some dust, only because no one was allowed in this room, not even to clean, until Avrin returned.
Avrin began to tidy up until a knock was heard on the door. As he continued he spoke “Come in..”
From the door as it creaked open, Ayame walked in and shut it. Having a stern look on her face. “Avrin….Please let me come with you and Syrana!!”
Avrin stopped for a moment before chuckling softly and speaking in reply….

chapters.content:

Avrin seemed to shake his head as he chuckled at Ayame’s words. He continued to pack some pre-made rations and began to plan tools he may need. Ignoring Ayame completely. Ayame waited for a few seconds before releasing avrin had no intention of replying to her. In fact, to her, it seemed he was ignoring her. She clenched her fists.
“Avrin don’t ignore me!!” She furiously yelled which made Avrin’s ear twitched as if her voice irritated him. She continued her short rant. “I'm more than capable of joining teacher and you on this journey!!” Avrin’s eyebrow twitched as he stood up and placed the sack he had bought before at the town, and now another one that was larger and wasn't enchanted that he had made during his training, on his shoulder. “Ayame, please shut up…”
Avrin spoke casually as he walked passed her with a satisfied smile on his face. He had no obligation to answer her, only replying to her irritation that affected him. Ayame’s jaw dropped as she had never heard Avrin be so openly annoyed at her.
It confused her. Considering whenever she wanted to fight him he flirted with her and used that to make her give up and flee.
“W..What did you say!” She called out as she followed behind Avrin who was walking down the hall, passing servants that bowed to them both. “Ayame you seem to misunderstand some things. One-it wasn't my choice to let your so called teacher join me.
Two-I despise her with all my heart. Three-I'm sure we both have better things to do then babysit someone who thinks a journey to see the most powerful creature on Seleria is something you're capable of. And luckily, four-you have been too aggressive towards me so consider this a bit of revenge.” He spoke while looking back to grin at her.
She seemed to stop following him as she was speechless, yet again her face turning red, this time out of frustration. “You bastard…” She huffed and walked off knowing there was no way for her to go with them on the journey.
Avrin didn't want to waste time which was why he was preparing now for the journey. He expected Syrana to do the same but it seemed she was outside, speaking to Myra, who seemed to be engaged in a serious conversation with her around the corner of the dojo. Avrin only picked them up on luck as he passed a window that showed around it.
Avrin didn't hesitate to augment his ears just encase the conversation involved him, and he was right to do so as he picked the conversation up hearing Syrana speak. “Myra, I don't trust that guy. He brought nothing but trouble for us before..”
Myra huffed and folded her arms. “Syrana, your worry is indeed right as he does have a cloud of bad luck hanging over him. And that tablet...It had more than what I told him..”
Avrin’s eyes widened as he balled his fists. Whispering to himself “Calling me bad luck when you were the one who captured me to begin with. And then lying about the contents of the tablet” He glared as he continued to listen.
“Syrana, Lang was given the sky metal not just as a gift but because my grandfather felt an ominous power from it. As if it were alive. The tablet from him spoke of it corrupting the minds of those who didn't have power to resist it.
And even then it seemed to weaken his body. I wonder why he didn't destroy it though” Myra began to think to herself before Syrana spoke.
“Hmm... If it corrupts minds, isn't it possible that for the time he was with it, that it gained enough influence over him as to not be destroyed?” Myra stood quiet for a second before nodding “That’s a possibility.”
Syrana seemed to think as her eyes narrowed “Myra, why did you agree to even let him obtain something so powerful to begin with. Who knows what he might do with it..”  Myra smiled and spoke “I have a feeling that it’s fate Syrana. Besides, I'm certain he doesn't know how to forge it, and he may become a valuable ally.
But I will leave the judgement to you Syrana. If you see it and think it is too dangerous than please destroy it…”
Syrana grinned and nodded. “If he tries to stop me you know it won't turn out well..” Myra sighed and nodded “I should hope you explain things to him but if it can't be avoided, protect yourself. But do not kill him “
By now Avrin had begun walking off. His face revealing a smile but also a fury as he hid his anger. He was planning to get revenge on Syrana to begin with but now he was 110% sure that she would get in his way. So he would deal with her with no mercy and if things went well he could get his hands on her half of the sigil even if he had to take her arm with it.
He had little time with Moonwing but enough to know that it had a strange feeling and a unique mana flow. It made him uncomfortable but also told him that he would need at least a day to absorb something like that, and it was only a half sigil. He couldn't fathom a complete one.
As Avrin had gone outside and headed to the dojo, he saw Syrana and Myra make there way out from around and spot him as they walked. Myra waved to him with a smile “Avrin your back! And what’s this? You're already set to go so quickly? Not even waiting?” Avrin tilted his head “The sooner this is done the better. I have no intention of wasting time”
Syrana let out a ‘hmph’ sound as her arms folded. She eyed him up and down “Well that's one thing we can agree on. The journey takes at least 3 days from here, its located near the latent mountain southeast of here”
Avrin thought to himself “-3 days with this wench and then the return trip. So 6 days in total…-” It almost made his stomach churn. Thankfully he had the manual that Shimaru had given him so he had extra reading material and time to train using it. During his training he had also had time to go over the knowledge of the books he had absorbed, so he was more knowledgeable regarding Seleria.
He then spoke in return to Syrana “Very well then, let’s leave now.” Syrana gazed at Myra who nodded with approval, and Myra then spoke “Avrin, please do not offend Lang in any way. He could turn this continent upside down, which is why Syrana is going with you” She then gazes at Syrana “This goes for you too. Please do not engage Lang unless it can't be avoided.” Syrana huffed as she had a disastrous anger towards dragons which was why it was not a good idea to send her. But it couldn't be avoided. Myra would just have to trust her.
Syrana went over towards the exit of the estate while motioning for Avrin to follow. Avrin then gazed at Myra “Doesn't she have any bags or food?” Myra chuckled and winked. “Oh I’m sure you could eat together.
Surely you could share?” She said in a joking turn, but Avrin made a sour unimpressed face. Myra then laughed “Hahaha, do not worry Avrin, she is a Sylph, our strongest warrior, she lives off the land. Besides, bags would only slow her down”
Avrin nodded and then bowed with a fake respect which made Myra wiggle shyly before he headed off towards Syrana, who seemed to be annoyed as she waited. “Hurry the hell up..” She spoke but Avrin continued his pace and sighed again, knowing these 3 days were going to be the most irritating of his life. He had wondered if he would be able to form a vehicle from his universe to combat the distance as well as save time with her but he would save that thought for now. Considering he was not strong enough to protect such technology if someone stronger came after him for it.
At the exit to the estate there were several shinobi who waited and bid them farewell. Shimaru was also there as well as Calias’s wife. But Ayame seemed to be missing. But it didn’t bother Avrin. He cared not if she was missing or not.
As he bid Shimaru farewell, as he knew him better than the others, the shinobi saluted him as they considered him one of them, since the elder had trained him. The goodbye with Calias’s wife was short as he hardly saw her other then that night at dinner.
10 minutes passed before Syrana and Avrin were seen walking through a sort of forest path. Avrin having his hood on as he looked around. He hadn't left the estate’s main exit in years. It felt weird for him, but also as if it had never happened. It was as if yesterday he had left one village, only to be trained by a hidden shinobi clan, something found in a novel. It made him want to laugh at himself.
He only let a slight smirk out which Syrana noticed and spoke “Please do not make that face, it worries me…” Avrin then frowned. It seemed the one he called bitch was quite good at ruining moods in an instant, but he ignored it as they continued on.
This story originates from . Ensure the author gets the support they deserve by reading it there.
Avrin then blinked as he looked around. He had learnt during his training, the ability to detect mana faintly without the need for his augmented eyes. That and the training of his senses made it still significantly useful. He had felt they had been followed.
But he ignored it for now, thinking it was a shinobi tasked with guarding them. Both of them quietly continued on for several hours without uttering a word to each other. It was as if they were strangers going down the same path. The forest seemed to become thicker, as well as the appearance of chirping birds.
There were indeed creatures lurking around, but these creatures felt as if these two individuals were dangerous. Avrin still felt that they were being followed and it was making him a bit uneasy. He gazed at Syrana who seemed to pay it no mention. He spoke “Have you seriously not noticed..?”
Syrana blinked and gazed at Avrin, as she wondered what he meant, before realizing it. She had been a warrior for many decades and her senses were still more sharper than his. “Oh that..” she chuckled softly then gazed forward and spoke “I guess she intended to follow after all..” Avrin made a ‘huh?’ like sound before widening his eyes by now they were at least 5-6 hours away from the estate.
“And you didn't tell me before?” He sighed to which Syrana seemed to ignore. Avrin knew it was her who followed. He spoke out as they continued to walk “Ayame, I'm quite sure I told you that you weren't to come with us…”
Ayame wasted no time jumping down and smiling at her teacher as she was walking beside her, and Syrana didn't seem to mind. In fact, she felt more comfortable, as if she was glad she came. Ayame then turned and glared at Avrin. “I don't care about you, I'm here with teacher…”
Avrin sighed. He then knew that Syrana told her to go but this changed nothing. It only meant that he now had two people he found irritating to get revenge on. Two birds with one stone. He knew that something like this would happen but he shrugged it off, thinking nothing of it until now. There was no point in arguing. “Fine.. Do not look to me if she is in danger Syrana. She is your problem”
Syrana had no friendship towards Avrin and spoke “Fine. Now stop talking, your pissing me off..” Avrin only shook his head. It seemed she really despised him, especially since now her and Ayame were speaking with each other regarding the Sylph and her training.
Avrin felt like the 3rd wheel even though this journey was meant for him, so to speak. But he then found the positive of it. If she isn't annoying me then it’s good. They continued on down the forest southeast with no issue. The sight was truly something to behold.
It was filled with numerous herbivore like creatures as well as a beautiful atmosphere that was soothing to a degree. Avrin wondered that maybe earth would still be like this if humanity had never existed. It seemed the people of Seleria were more responsible regarding nature.
They had been walking with no rest for 16 hours and the sun was starting to set. Syrana then spoke “We’ll rest here..” Avrin replied “We're not continuing?..” Syrana shook her head. “Keeping stamina 100% everyday is more important” Avrin shook his head slightly. This Elf clearly spoke as if she worried about being ambushed. Then again she was older than Shimaru and lived outdoors, so he didn't argue and nodded.
Syrana and Ayame began to gather materials to make a makeshift tent, and with Syrana’s expertise from wilderness survival they did it effectively, but even went as far as warning Avrin to keep several meters from them at all times.
They made their campsite at a large mossy boulder near a tree that seemed to be hundreds of years old. Even more positive was that there was a small lake nearby.
As Ayame and Syrana spoke, ignoring Avrin’s presence. He had no desire to camp with them and walked off for a good minute before emitting his nebula mist, devouring the landscape to a degree, until the leaves, sticks, and such were clear, and even until the land was flat.
He had trained to use it more effectively and wasted no time improving all his qualities as much as he could. He even had more varieties of creation. As the mist then began to form a large box shape as if a large glass rectangle made of energy appeared on the flat land.
The land itself in the presence of the creation began to emit a slight aura, but then the box began to condense into a shape quite quickly until it had completely condensed into the intended shape, which was a spacious pod style tent. It was quite large and it put Syrana and Ayame’s leaf and stick tents to shame.
He grinned as he examined it “Hmm... This one turned out better than my last did. It doesn't seem to have any structural difficulties and it’s larger too.” Avrin happily went inside which was a nice open area with a sleeping bag and a spread table with a fold out chair already set. As he went inside it was large enough for him not to duck down to enter and was large enough for him to stand inside as if he were in a small house.
Avrin went over to a unused part of the tent and removed his cloak as he folded it and placed it to the side, before he sat down in a cross legged position. He then shut his eyes, knowing the other two were doing there own things. He entered an early state of the Pulsing Dragon meditation. But a voice, as if on cue, broke his concentration.
“Incredible! What is this!! Is it a house in the forest?” He then heard shuffling outside as well as touching against the pod tent. “Hmm its made out of some weird paper, but its pretty sturdy” Another voice spoke out “Teacher, that’s one of Avrin’s creations. Uhh, I think grandfather said Avrin called it a teee nnt or uhh tnnet. Or along those lines”
Syrana, being the voice before, spoke out “What a silly name...And what a silly contraption to begin with. We are out in the outdoors. Shelter is all around. Besides, it is unfair for him to have one. Avrin come out this instant.
Avrin kept quiet, hoping they would go away, as he reentered his Pulsing Dragon meditation. His mind blocking out everything outside of his own presence, as his aura began to emit like a sharply controlled flame that gently fluttered around the unused room, touching the walls but not damaging them.
Avrin, several times over the years, concluded that this meditation, with his own bits and pieces, improved the strength of his skills significantly, as it seemed to refresh and strengthen his body. He could use his ability even more so.
As if a door had been opened bit by bit, every time he had used it. He had completely shut himself out from the outside world and a few hours had passed before he felt it was enough for the night.
As he opened his eyes he noticed Ayame in the corner, tending to her equipment, and Syrana in the room in front, making what seemed like a paste made out of fruits. “What’s going on?..” Avrin spoke as soon as his mind was refocused.
Syrana blinked as well as Ayame who both then stared at Avrin. Syrana spoke “Well, considering how unfair it was for you to have shelter like this, we decided to join you”
Ayame nodded with a smile and spoke “It’s definitely large enough for the 3 of us, if not more” Avrin didn't know whether he wanted to laugh cry or curse them out of this tent, even more so since they told him not to be near them to begin with.
He decided to get some fresh air, and stood up. He began to make his way out. Syrana spoke “Where are you going?”
Speaking as if she were his wife he replied “The river. I'm going to wash. Is there a problem with that?..” He spoke clearly annoyed and she could tell, which made her grin with satisfaction. “Not at all, go ahead...Dear…” She spoke and began to giggle to her own deluded joke
Avrin, who felt like hanging himself with disgust, immediately made his way out towards the river. “Those two, I'll be dead from anger by the time we reach that dragon. God, is this some sort of punishment?.. I can't remember a time in my past life where I treated a women unequally..” He spoke in a pitiful tone.
As he reached the river, he began to remove his clothing. Little did he know that Syrana had intended to test how much he has improved. She had left a minute after him, after asking Ayame to continue on with food preparation. Syrana gazed at Avrin, hiding her presence and also her own internal mana as best she could.
Avrin, without his augmented eye, wouldn't be able to detect this with his current senses. She gazed like a predator watching its prey as he continued to strip down. She had a large rock in her hand and she had Avrin in her sights.

chapters.title: Chapter 43 The First Night
chapters.content:
This somewhat special to me :) il let you guys find out what it means for the story. enjoy a 3:45 am early release i was so excited that i had to get this to you guys early enjoy.
Full Pr credits to draconis
Please dont forget to rate/follow/favourite :D -------------Syranas POV----
As Syrana pulled her hand back with a joyful smirk on her face as she hated Avrin for hurting the forest. And even more so for bringing the Sylphs bad luck. She was about to throw the menacing rock towards him. She had his head in her sights. But then stopped and blinked as she gazed at him, her body freezing not by an ability but by being unintentionally mesmerized.
At that moment, before she stopped, Avrin had moved his hand, caressing it through his own hair as he lifted his head up, the moonlight glistening off the water as well as his toned body.
Syrana had never realised it earlier due to her hate, but she now understood Avrin was incredibly handsome, if not insanely attractive. It was as if the gods had combined an Angel and Elf as well as Demon into one, all 3 being the most attractive races to a degree.
She gulped as her mouth didn't make sound, her arm lowering as she admired his abs as well as what seemed to be perfectly toned pectoral muscles. His body seemed perfectly shaped and there wasn't a single negative quality.
She had wondered about her own love life as she pervertedly admired Avrin from the tree. “I've never really had a love life. I’ve been to busy with my own personal training as well as protecting the forest….”
She somewhat face palmed as her cheeks brightened up a deep cherry red as she gazed at Avrin again, who was currently using some sort of ribbon to tie back his hair. “W...Why is it him I feel this way towards?...He has brought nothing but bad luck for me…”
Her lips parted as her mouth slipped open slightly, as if she were about to drool. The reason being Avrin getting closer to shore revealing more of his lower body. Syrana was hungry for more but also deeply disgusted about feeling attracted to someone she detested.
------Avrins POV--------
He sighed as he raised his head, trying to wash his hair as he struggled a bit “It would be a lot easier if I had shampoo...Argh, I’d get a haircut but I’m sure long hair suits this body more. I look like a girl” He irritatingly spoke to himself as he continued to wash his body with a makeshift scrub he had formed several times during his training, as a sort of recycle method.
Avrin then shivered. “I feel like I'm being watched..That whore better not be doing anything..Never mind, I'm done” He spoke to himself as he began to make his way to shore. He blinked as he felt something closing in on him. Before he had revealed his entire lower half, a figure dropped a few meters away on the shore. He nearly instantly gazed at it and then made a ‘huh?’ like gesture.
The figure was none other than Syrana who called out while pointing her finger at him. “Avrin, it seems even though you are despicable and a black cloud constantly hangs around you, the only quality you seem to have in my eyes is your a...attractive body…”
Avrin was quiet as he tried to figure out just what was going on. He then snapped out of it as he realised Syrana was eyeing him up and down with a sort of predator look. He had been holding his anger for a long time and he felt it was necessary to release a little frustration. He called out while still keeping his manner.
“Hah!.. I knew you were bad Syrana, but I never knew you were also a pervert.” Avrin began to laugh as he backed away into the shore a bit. “Do me a favor and keep away from me. Also, stop staring at me, I feel like I’ll need to wash myself again..”
Syrana snapped out of her perverted gaze and heard Avrin's words as a vein popped on her forehead. “You despicable… I am NOT a pervert! Y..You are the only perverted one here…!! “ Syrana who was still clutching the rock from before at that moment threw it towards Avrin who seemed to notice it. Regardless it was still a throw from an expert fighter and was quite fast. As if its speed was faster than an arrow.
Avrin emitted a nebula mist in front of him that seemed to seep from his body like an aura. The rock hit against it and before it even passed through it seemed to disintegrate. This technique was called Shadow Aura and this was only one of the many uses it had.
“Syrana, I can't imagine what you were doing with that rock...And if I put the fact that you were perving on me earlier I can only put two and two together and say that you were intending to throw it at me while I was occupied…” Avrin glared at her as he raised his arm, augmenting it to a halfway point.
Syrana who took a step back wasted no time getting in a battle position, but not withdrawing her bow. Wanting to prove to Avrin that she could also counter what he threw at her. “Avrin, let me show you the difference between us. I won't need your corrupt magic to stop whatever attack you throw at me…”
Avrin seemed to glare at her. The fact that his attractive body was still revealed no longer bothered Syrana as she felt the danger he currently posed was more so than before.
Avrin used the nebula mist to form an exact replica of the rock she had thrown at him. But Avrin kept walking deeper into the water as if gaining more distance. Syrana blinked “Planning on running away are you?.. Hah, I knew you couldn't do it..”
As she began to lower her guard Avrin chuckled and like a baseball player who had half his body submerged in water he threw the rock towards her with his half augmented hand as the pressure emitted a mini sonic boom that caused the water near Avrin to split as if screaming as the rock was crumbling bit by bit under the pressure while heading towards Syrana.
The water splitting in two as it emitted a screeching sound as if a banshee was being tortured. Syrana was frozen with fright at the ferocity of his attack, she remembered when she was casually able to nearly kill Avrin when he had formed into a demon like monster, but with only a hand that half resembled it, he was able to release such a disastrous attack with a rock. How strong had he gotten? How did he get this powerful to begin with? And just how much potential did he have?
Syrana, with fright, covered her hands as she took up a sort of cowering pose. But as the rock reached her, unable to take the pressure any longer, it disintegrated and only the pressure of the air that lingered blew Syrana back into a bunch of bushes.
Avrin gave a smirk as the water still shook, slowly calming down “That will teach you to perv on someone.. So much for a Sigil wielder..” Avrin began to make his way to another portion of the shore.
As he got closer he felt a large killing intent approach him from afar. Syrana, with near lightning speed, pounced out into the air towards him as he blinked and gazed up. She seemed quite angry in his eyes. Syrana pounced on Avrin as she grabbed him by his shoulders, trying to wrestle him under water as if wanting to drown him.
Avrin tried to push her away as if she were some sort of parasite. “G..Get away from me you crazy bitch!!” Syrana only roared her reply as she continued to wrestle in the water with him, her clothes getting wet. But she cared not “I'm not crazy you bastard!!! You almost killed me!!”
All of a sudden another figure approached the shore line and called out to them. “Teacher!! Avrin!! What are you both doing!!!!?”
Avrin and Syrana suddenly stopped, but the position they stopped in didn't do the sight any justice. With Syrana’s hands on his shoulders and Avrin’s hands on her waist just barely above the water. Syrana was the first to speak. “A..Ayame this isn't what it..looks like..”
Ayame spoke “T..Teacher, I t..thought you hated him...Y..You had these sorts of feelings for someone like him?..” Avrin felt like he was being looked down on. “Ayame...She’s right. Besides, who would want to be with a crazy wild women like her…” He grinned as he let go of her while turning his back.
“Wild what??!!” Syrana pounced on his back as she pulled his hair. Avrin glared as he was pushing her off but it seemed to hurt more. He would skewer her had it not been for the fact that he had use for her. As well as her relation to Shimaru. They both stopped as Ayame spoke.
“T..Teacher…” Ayame glared and pointed her finger. “If you are revealing your feelings for Avrin than you lied to me. Therefore I lied to you to!! I also have feelings for him and I don't plan to lose to you...E..Even if..y..you’re stronger..But I won’t..g...give up” Tears began to well up in her eyes as she ran off into the bushes.
Syrana called out to her as she got off Avrin and got closer to shore, her clothing dripping wet as it stuck to her body more so. “Ayame wait!!” She then shot daggers at Avrin who seemed to be laughing. “You bastard!! See what you did?!” Avrin, still laughing, spoke “Hahahaha, wow I never imagined she would actually have feelings for me. 
Support the author by searching for the original publication of this novel.
There is a saying that if a woman treats you bad it means she likes you, but I would never be one to believe that. But two times in one night? What an interesting night.” He grinned at Syrana who seemed to be blushing with anger as well as embarrassment.
“S..Say what you want, but I only find you attractive because of your body, n..nothing more.” Avrin grinned again. “Oh that’s fine with me. Like me if you want, but don't perv on me again..And do me a favor, try not to sneak into my bed at night” He gave a wink as he had finally been able to piss her off. It had made him joyful to the point of him breaking his personality to an extent.
Syrana only huffed and stomped away in the direction Ayame went off in. Avrin finally got out of the water as he began to dry himself with a towel he prepared earlier. “Women of this world are indeed interesting. Although if someone like her likes me for my appearance, this may be troublesome. If I ever enter a place such as Gaia Academy I’ll need to work on a way to change it. I wonder if its even possible with magic, let alone my ability”
Avrin pondered this even after he finished redressing and made his way back to the tent. He had intended to kick them both out but felt he shouldn't make things worse after tonights commotion. He could already sleep happily.
As he approached the camp area he saw Ayame in Syrana’s arms, hugging her somewhat tearily. Syrana was currently wearing a second attire that was more revealing, like shorts and a sort of tank top with the cleavage area open. Her wet clothing was drying near the campfire. Avrin whistled a tune as he made his way into the tent with a smile that made Syrana gaze away with anger. She knew he had gotten the last laugh.
Ayame paid no mind as she tried to believe her teacher’s words, but it seems like the cat was out of the bag, and she had told Avrin how she felt. As Avrin entered his section of the pod tent, he grabbed the zipper to the rooms entrance and closed it for even more privacy. He emitted his aura and coated the material around the room with it, making it thicker as well as more protective.
Avrin then began to form the manual that Shimaru gave him, as the jokeful nature of the night had ended. He was truly eager to know what techniques the manual had. It seemed forming it took nearly no time at all, as 5 minutes had passed and he was currently reading it while admiring the positions as well as stances in the manual.
“Dragons Sweep: An ability that manifests internal mana with body strength in a leg to create a pull in the air bringing opponents closer as well as crushing their bodies with the strength of the attack. If they are uninjured by that, it can be followed up by a Claw of the Dragon, an attack that is commenced after the Dragons Sweep.
The Dragons Sweep, in general, after being used, spins your body to use the Claw of the Dragon. You need to take into account the strength of the opponents resistance to your attack, as it may take longer or shorter. Therefore, the Claw of the Dragon needs to be timed, but the result is deadly.
It uses the force of the Dragons Sweep to become even deadlier than it would be if used without channeling your internal mana and body strength in a hand with all fingers extended like a claw thrust into the opponents body transmitting the force into them. This combination can result in a one blow kill.”
Avrin was amazed in a sense. These attacks sounded like abilities from a cartoon, but after reading the finer description that stated that training as well as methods of the Pulsing Dragon needed to use these techniques as well as the perfect angle of the sweep and spin as well as the timing. It sounded more technical.
“This sounds like quite a lot of fun but it’s also incredible. I wonder what sort of result I’ll be able to create, if any at all, with dark matter. Dark matter also has the ability to manipulate gravity and magnetism, but I know I'm still far from that. I can't fathom how dangerous it would be if I added that kick to the Dragons Sweep”
Avrin was fantasising about the possibilities of imbuing his power with techniques that required mana. He knew that alone made this world even more so enjoyable. But practice makes perfect. He was eager to train these, but he would need to master the basic stances first.
“It seems the manual does well to link attacks that work better with each other such as Dragons Sweep and Claw of the Dragon, but they also have a level of ability marked by the power rank needed to use these abilities to their fullest.” Avrin had suddenly remembered something. “That’s right, I have yet to know what I rank as. If I remember correctly, there is something called a spirit stone that measures ability...I truly want one..”
Avrin had a lot to do when he had taken the time to think about it. There was also so much to see. He stood up after he had been reading for a good 20 minutes and exited his room. He made his way out as he turned to see Ayame in her section practicing her meditation. She seemed to block everything out. He had no desire to annoy her as he respected that she was using the Pulsing Dragon.
He made his way outside and saw Syrana getting dressed as she was putting her large boots on. He blinked and grinned as he folded his arms. He wanted to tease her a bit more as it was too tempting to resist. “But you know Syrana, you look quite beautiful yourself…” Syrana blinked as she had not noticed Avrin until he spoke. As she stopped and looked up at him a bit confused before her face flushed deeply “Y...You shut up! Your words are like poison...And stop staring at me!”
Avrin chuckled quietly as he went off to the large sack he had forgot to take inside. He then went to it and took it and approached the fire near Syrana, but opposite her side, and sat down near it. As if keeping warm. “Unfortunately I have a“ He coughed before continuing “Favor to ask you….” Syrana stopped again as she was now fixing her top.
She was often used to being around warriors on the elven side when they put equipment on, as they never really admire each other in moments of equipment, as when they did put their equipment on, it meant serious training or battle.
Syrana tilted her head and grinned as she shut her eyes, fixing her top. “I’ve little desire to help you, but I'm curious to know what it is. Maybe I’ll consider it..” Avrin let out a playful sigh and spoke “I’m sure you know that there is something used to measure ability, I think they’re called spirit stones...I'm currently in need of one. Do you know where I can get one from?”
Syrana was a little dumbstruck, but chuckled “That’s right, you haven't had the chance to get one. But then again, unless you go to a capital city or a special place, you won't be able to get your own. But I have one.” She finished putting her clothing on and held her right hand out as mana began to emit from her hand and formed a prismatic diamond like object that seemed to be a dark brass color.
Avrin let out an awe like sound “So that’s what it looks like” He stood up and approached it curiously. “Although its a little small….I expected yours would be a bit more...Uhh, appealing?” He spoke, not intentionally mocking her. “Idiot…” Syrana spoke as the stone turned back into mana and went into her body.
“All inactive spirit stones are that size. If mine was active it would be much better...But I don't plan to show you...Besides, this is all I'm telling you. I've nothing to gain by helping you, nor do I want to. You're lucky Myra even allowed this to happen.”
Avrin tilted his head, a little doubtful about it, as he wanted to see it some more. “Uhh I’m sorry, I’m sorry“ He then smiled and thought. “Well then a trade is in order… For letting me examine the spirit stone you possess, name something you would like in return?”
Syrana who had been tending to the previously mashed paste from before that seemed to have been formed into a cookie like shape, raised her head with interest as she then grinned evilly and turned to look at Avrin. “Ohhh?...” She spoke almost seductively.. “Something I want in return from you..Heh...Hehehe...Heh..”
Avrin began to sweat a bit. He knew he should have gave her a set item instead of offering her a choice. With a women like her, who despises him as well as finds his body alone attractive, who knows what sort of disheartening thing she may ask of him.
“Very well… There is something I've been wanting from you, and ever since what happened in that lake, my interest is even more peaked….What I want from you, Avrin, is…”
