As the large vessel docked, Avrin had already gone to the lower deck to see Kael prepare his horse. Keeping silent, Avrin also began to prepare his own. “When we leave, stick close and don't wander off” There were many creatures he had read about on the Verge Islands.
The creatures weren't as strong as the ones on the Twisted Lands, but they were better in terms of sneak attacks, and had a bit of intelligence.
It would be safe to assume the Verge Island would be a great place to practice awareness. Kael kept quiet, as he was inwardly disappointed. He didn't know why, as the emotions welled up. Angry at Avrin for lecturing him as such, but angry at himself for being too caring.
The port was not a city, but a fortress outpost with large wooden palisades that were fortified to a heavy degree. Several guards stationed at the top of wooden watchtowers were vigilant and looking around carefully.
Kael and Avrin mounted the horses, wasting no time in making their way outside of the docking area. “There aren't any civilians here...” Kael spoke as he looked around. All he could see were merchants buying the loot of returning adventurers. He didn't see any women or children living normal lives.
“This would be a terrible place to live. The only people you will see here are merchants, adventurers and the guards. You can consider this a sort of battlefield” Avrin spoke softly as he also looked around to see what sort of goods the adventurers sold.
“I'll buy those 2 batches of fur for 2 gold each” A merchant spoke to an adventurer, who seemed a little disappointed at the price as he replied “2 gold Are you crazy?... Those Devil Bears almost tore my 10 man group to pieces… I won't go lower than 5 gold each…”
The merchant laughed grinning “Hmph… The best I can do is 3 gold eac-” Before he had finished, another nearby merchant called out “I'll give you your 5 gold friend! Come here!” 
After being cut out by the other merchant, the adventurer gave a satisfied look and began to walk towards that man.
Not satisfied, the merchant, who at first tried to rip the adventurer off, called out “5 gold and 5 silver!” The adventurer was dumbstruck but began to return with a smile, which was when the other merchant clenched his fist “5 gold 6 silver!”
From there, a sort of bidding wore occurred, but no one looked at them, as if this was a common occurrence. “There seems to be a lot of gold to be made here” Avrin whispered to himself as he and Kael passed through.
“Kael, we will wait at the Inn” Nodding to Avrin, they both made their way towards it. The inn’s entrance had 2 guards. Avrin could only assume this was necessary, just in case the adventurers became violent with each other.
Making their way towards the large wooden door, they were cut off by a group of 4, who went ahead of them while laughing to themselves, as if they didn't care. Kael was pushed aside by one of the skinnier men who didn't seem to even spare glance.
“T...That rude bastard…” Kael mumbled anger in his eyes. Avrin replied “Ignore him...” Kael frowned before taking a deep breath, as if trying to calm himself down. Both Avrin and Kael entered. The inn’s interior was quite large, spanning nearly 50 meters, with many tables and adventurers seated about.
“It's huge…” Kael mumbled. “This is probably the only inn in this place. It has to be this large to accommodate all these people.” In the distance, a large group of mercs where seated on the right side. They were mostly familiar to Avrin, but Kael’s eyes were wandering off, as he admired the adventurers who seemed to have seen their fair share of battle.
“Avrin, over here!” A light yet tough voice called out towards them from the group of mercs. Felia was standing up and waving at them with a smile adorning her face. Both Avrin and Kael made their way across, taking a seat at her table that seemed to consist of her and a man with scars all over his face.
“I apologize for being late” Avrin spoke. He didn't want to be rude, since it was, in truth, his fault. Felia laughed softly “its fine. At least you made it.” Kael seemed nervous as he looked around. He was keeping an eye out for Wyni, who may pounce on him from god knows where.
“Avrin, I'm curious, why did you postpone coming with us?” Felia couldn't help but ask. Avrin glanced through the eye holes of his mask before speaking “I had to attend to something.” Felia grinned mischievously.
“Oh? So it doesn't have anything to do with a certain 10,000 gold potion?” Freezing for a second, Avrin looked at her, before he caught the attention of her other fellow mercs who also seemed curious.
“Where did you hear that from?” Avrin spoke. He also couldn't help but ask. Felia tapped her fingers on the table eagerly. “I have eyes and ears in a lot of places” Narrowing his eyes slightly, his reply was fierce. “It would be a shame if those eyes and ears were cut off for seeing and hearing something personal”
Felia laughed again, while the man next to her kept a straight emotionless face while looking at Avrin. “Fine fine, it's your business. I'm sure it must be something incredible.” From there, she began to speak about things Avrin showed no interest in.
Felia, seeing he was slightly bored, decided to take it up a notch. She took out an aged parchment and placed it on the table. The parchment had drawings all over it and appeared to be a map.
Avrin eyed it with renewed focus. “Where did you find this map anyway? Surely something that rare wasn't acquired easily.” Felia looked at Avrin. Although she was smiling, she showed a ruthless look. “Sometimes the best way to get something isn't always the one with the most moral” [Sometimes the best way to get something isn't always the most honorable method  ]
Understanding her meaning, Avrin decided he needed to be on guard when it came to her. Felia began to explain in detail everything they had seen and gone through as they travelled and entered the dungeon until they came across the draconian humanoids. 10 minutes had passed before they found out that Wyni, along with a group of 15, were sent ahead to keep an eye over there.
“To reaffirm our deal. 1 piece of ore that I desire, whether it's low quality or something that would start a war. And I will progress at my own pace.” Felia, after hearing this, couldn't help but feel a drop of sweat run down her cheek. She was cautious of Avrin. Ever since he spoke that he wanted a piece of ore, she wondered why he would even gamble like that.
“I remember. In fact, I guess its better like this, heh. More for us” With the agreement coming to an end, the rest of the time the mercs spent eating and drinking. “Kael, it's time for us to go. We will go join up with Wyni and meet your group there”
Felia, who was stunned a little, spoke out “Huh?! Don't you want to enjoy yourself here a bit? There's no rush” Avrin stood up and Kael also copied. “My focus is with the boy’s training "Avrin turned to leave before Felia laughed, not denying it. But as Avrin made his way forward, a strong voice called out. “Bastard… Who do you think you are to act so high and mighty?”
The area became silent. Not only Felia, but her mercs, as well as the nearby tables. The voice came from the man with scars on his face, who glared at Avrin. He stood up, emitting a fierce aura, one of an expert who has seen countless battles.
Avrin turned and shot a curious glance. Even Kael was a little dumbfounded. “Hmm? I apologize if I have offended you, but this is just how I am” Turning around, he began to walk again. After being spoken to in such a casual way and in a manner as if it where nothing, the man’s face twisted in fury.
He vanished with incredible speed, and appeared 2 meters in front of Avrin. “My name is Clovis; I'm an early stage master. I should be more than enough for this dungeon.” Avrin blinked, somewhat surprised.
He ignored Clovis for a moment and looked at Felia. “This guy is new to your group?” Felia, showing a nervous look, nodded, as she stood up and made her way towards the two, stepping in between.
“I made a deal with Clovis. He is renowned across the Central Continent as an incredible martial artist. 20% is his share.” Avrin raised a curious brow.
“You didn't offer me a deal like that when you met me.” He spoke, somewhat disappointed. Felia pursed her lips and tried to look innocent, but Clovis was angry, regarding Avrin’s personality.
“Hey you, Avrin… I challenge you to a duel.”
Whispers began to echo silently across the inn. The owner himself was shaking a bit. He didn't want this place to be turned upside down. Avrin eyed Clovis for a moment. “-This guy is pretty strong indeed. It should be nice to show Kael a better fight-”
“Very well. I accept.” With the whispers growing into words that could be heard more clearly, the entire group left the inn and made their way towards a training area. Kael was standing next to Felia, gazing nervously.He could feel Clovis was stronger than his old master, but was also angry that he spoke to Avrin in such a way. Clovis’s casual clothing was changed to a sort of leather martial arts attire. He began to practice on the spot, as if trying to show off his Prowess (A.N it was to show off he's strength but i took the PR’s Advice as it sounded better)
“Wow, he's fast…” One merc spoke, while another nodded in agreement. “Calm and composed. It’s not easy to do that before entering a fight.” Felia folded her arms under her bust as she spoke to Kael nervously.
“Hey kid… Sorry about this, you're going to have to stay by your master's side at the medical area… This Clovis learned an ancient martial art, which is another reason why I hired him”
Kael looked up at Felia, confused. “Ancient martial art?” Felia nodded. “It's called Flame Fist. Imbuing a flame affinity into one's arm and increasing the strength. He should be able to match a majority of rare grade weapons.”
Avrin looked at Clovis as if he were a clown trying to seek attention. “-How should I handle this buffoon? I don't think it would be fair if I used my ability. Flame Fist, huh? I guess I'll only use martial arts too, and see how I fare-”
A man wearing armor stepped between the two and spoke out “When fighting, if someone gives up or is KO'd, they lose. There is no killing or cheap attacks. Everything else is fine” The man, seemingly a guard, needed to oversee this fight spoke, before he walked over to the side and called out.
“Begin!” After those words escaped his lips, Clovis vanished with great speed, and began to barrage Avrin with several casual strikes towards his body, but Avrin casually dodged and stepped back as he avoided them all with ease.
The genuine version of this novel can be found on another site. Support the author by reading it there.
“-Hmm... He is holding back, but I can see he is aiming at vital spots… Is he testing my defences to see if he can penetrate them and hit?-” He thought to himself. Avrin was also seemingly testing Clovis.
Felia blinked. “Wow… Already pushing Avrin back? Maybe Clovis was right and he is enough for the dungeon” Kael gazed worryingly after hearing Felia’s words. Clovis snickered as he began to pick up the pace and speed things up, his arms becoming a blur.
“Hmm!?” Avrin became more aware as dodging became somewhat harder, but he was holding himself back greatly. Clovis then jumped back and laughed.
“Ha, you're pretty good. I didn't land a hit on you even if I was holding back. You're definitely something. Well than… It's time I show you why I'm a Master level...” Clovis’s body began to emit a red fiery energy, before that energy, being mana, siphoned across his body before engulfing his arms.
The transparency grew weaker and became more solid as it went towards his hands. His fists were incredibly red and emitted a flame like look. “Flame Fist, First Strike...” Clovis vanished nearly 3 times faster than before as he appeared in front of Avrin and punched towards his gut.
Avrin blinked in surprise, stepping back as the fist scraped across his leather attire in the section of his stomach, causing it to scorch and burn significantly.
“-That's dangerous...-” Right as Avrin finished stepping, Clovis spoke. “Flame Fist…” He vanished again, moving nearly 4 times faster. “Second Strike!” His right hand turned into a flaming blur as it hit towards the same location, this time managing to strike, but not significantly.
Avrin could feel the burning sensation, as his leather attire was burnt through, leaving a scorch on his stomach. He winced a bit, but was enjoying it. “-Ha… Good good!-” He thought to himself.
Clovis seemed to also enjoy himself, as he vanished again, turning into a blur as he jumped up and punched downwards like a shooting star towards Avrin. “Flame Fist Third Strike!” Avrin was a little shocked at how fast he was. Nearly 6 times faster. The fist smashed into Avrin as he raised his hands, barely in time to guard, as he couldn't avoid it while holding himself back.
The earth trembled as dust and rocks scattered everywhere, a crater forming under the strength. Clovis released a powerful surge of hot air rushing all over, causing everyone to tremble and step back.
“Master!!” Kael called out. As he was about to rush in, Felia grabbed him and pulled him back. Clovis jumped back, a little exhausted, as he laughed and smirked. “Ha...ha…” He panted softly and spoke. “Damn… Maybe I overdid it… Is he ok?” He whispered to himself.
As the dust settled, the guard nearby was about to end the match, before a silhouette appeared from the crater, dusting himself off. Avrin’s mouth had red blood dripping from the mouth area of the white mask, as the mask itself was a little cracked.
His leather attire was burnt significantly, with his cloak turned ragged and nearly torn off. His stomach had a large wound on it as it bled. Avrin looked at Clovis seemingly impressed, and not fazed much by the wounds. “That was good; it hurt a lot...…. What else do you have?”
Clovis widened his eyes, shocked to see Avrin was still able to move. “You're...impressive… I take back what I said…. You can indeed take a few hits… Not many can handle the third strike and move… But...”
He spoke that last word as if he had a trump card. Clovis began to take a steady stance, moving his hands around slowly as an intense mana began to burn around him. “The most powerful move I have and also the fourth strike. Inferno Fist…” Clovis’s body began to burn slightly, as his clothes tore a bit.
“Avrin… I may kill you with this move…. Do you want to surrender?” He spoke, as the mana began to burn up. Avrin looked at him with a joyful smile. “If I die, then I die… Come at me with everything you’ve got.”
Avrin extended his arms in welcome, his face showing excitement. He wanted to test how far his body could go from an early stage Master while holding himself back.
“S...Shit, that mana…. It's so intense…” Felia bit her lip a bit. “Kael...don't look...” She spoke, trying to save the boy from seeing his master die. People began to step back, as the air became dry and hot, as if they were in a scorching desert.
Clovis’s fist began to burn like a blinding light, as he vanished with incredible speed, 10 times faster than before, using all his strength and pushing his body to his limit, even as pain tore against his muscles.
“Inferno Fist!” A large typhoon punched towards Avrin as Clovis appeared in front of him, smashing it against his body. The earth trembled and split, as if a mountain was trying to push its way through.
The force of the attack blew an intense wind towards the direction Avrin was standing, but by now, he had already disappeared in the light and effect of the attack. With people screaming and trying to flee, it began to settle moments later.
As it disappeared, a large scorch mark spanning a hundred meters appeared. Clovis was sure to aim it in a way that no one would be hit, so it fired off in a direction that led to the sea, where it wasn't populated.
Clovis fell to his knees as sweat adorned his face. He began to pant, clearly exhausted. ‘Ha… I did better than the last time I used this… Master would be proud. I take it back Avrin, you were brave to take that attack with your body...but also dumb. You let yourself die without even fighting back”
“M...Master…” Kael’s eyes widened as he tried to free himself from Felia, his body shaking and quivering. Felia felt bad, but did her best to hold him. “-Damnit… Why did he die so easily…-” Felia was also annoyed, not sure what to do with Kael or why Avrin died in such a way.
From the wide line of the scorch mark, a figure stood up from the ground covered in dirt. As he stood, his left arm was twisted in a broken state, and his stomach was scorched greatly, to the point where it opened up and then became cauterized by the flame.
The mask on Avrin’s face was black from the heat, changing the metal, but also cracked and broken, but holding on, showing how well it was crafted. “Damn, that fucking hurt….” He whispered to himself.
Looking carefully, he found blue blood running down his lips as he coughed out some more of it. “Ah, I see, so it was enough to do that, huh…” By then, as Avrin talked to himself, Clovis had already gazed and was frozen; stunned that Avrin was still alive.
“I...Incredible… This guy’s fierce...” He mumbled, before standing up, taking another fighting stance. “Master!” Kael called out with a wide smile on his face. Felia was also stunned at how Avrin had survived such a dangerous attack.
“Incredible…” She spoke with shock. Even the other onlookers were somewhat stunned. But regardless, they knew that this match was still in Clovis’s side. “I have to admit, you are indeed strong.”
Clovis smirked and stood up. “I'm going to risk it all… You are an opponent I can try it all against… Live or die...Masters try their best to always be on edge. Prepare yourself, Avrin.” Clovis began to condense and emit the same mana as before; using everything he had, as he was going to use the same attack.
Avrin smiled as he began to walk towards him. “I won't just stand there and take it this time. That hurt quite a bit…” Clovis nodded, before he had gathered up the same mana. “That's fine… Prepare yourself!!!”
“Avrin, give up!!” Felia called out, knowing the outcome wasn't good. Even Kael agreed. “Master, please don't go this far! You can't win!!” Avrin frowned, as he was being looked down on.
“Whelps... You take me for a fool? If I knew I would die this time, I would move…” He mumbled to himself.
Avrin took his own stance as he moved his right arm back, opening his hand and extending his fingers as dark matter began to gather and his muscles strengthen. His face showed a mad look, with a desire to test himself.
Clovis roared out “Inferno Fist!!!” The same scene occurred. The powerful surge of heat and energy punched towards Avrin with no mercy. But as it neared him, Avrin’s face showed a smirk.
“Claw of the Dragon…” Using more energy and not holding back as much, as he calculated Clovis strength. Although the attack’s effectiveness was useful with the Dragon Sweep, with Avrin’s strength, this was voided, as it was still useable.
As Avrin thrust his opened palm forward, the wind screeched as it tore greatly. His fingers also slashed downwards at the right moment, as if they where blades. The energy he added causing the wind to split apart as well as the earth split in the directions his fingers had slashed downward in.
The Inferno Fist’s energy trembled and was suppressed, and it was then torn apart by the force of Avrin’s attack.
With the force of the attack slashing past with no mercy, Clovis, who was exhausted, was barely able to block in time, but was still blown away. In the direction the fingers cut down, the earth split apart for several hundred meters.
Avrin’s intention was to disperse the attack, so his attack was focused around the Inferno Fist’s energy. As it settled, Clovis had his body bloodied greatly, as he weakly stood up. Avrin’s body was already recovering extremely quickly, and the visible wounds were healing well, leaving only the dirt and stains of blood to adorn him.
Avrin looked at Clovis, who was wounded and bleeding, barely moving. He didn't intend to kill him, but at the same time, didn't want to show off an immense amount of power that would draw unwanted attention to him.
Clovis chuckled as his left eye was shut and he held a major cut wound across his chest. “I...Incredible… To disperse my attack so easily….even after taking so much damage… What a monster”
Clovis mumbled to himself before yelling out. “I forfeit…. I can't fight him.” Avrin was already dusting himself off, extending his left arm, as it was being repaired and reshaped by the dark matter in his body. He already knew the outcome.
The nearby onlookers were not just the mercenaries, but other adventurers and guards, even some merchants. They all erupted in cheers of the excitement that occurred. It was rare to find such a good fight without paying to watch a tournament, or even going out on the battlefield.
“That's...incredible… I never knew he was so strong...” Felia, who was trembling, spoke. Kael frowned as he clenched his fists. “I don't get it. Why was master still holding back in the end…?” He knew Avrin’s magic like ability and couldn't understand it as he ran towards him.
Felia, having heard Avrin was holding back even in the end, didn't know whether to laugh or cry (A.N sorry guys i love this line :3 ) “To think he was that strong…and still holding back. I will have to be sure not to piss him off” She smiled, happy that she had 2 people on a Master level assisting her. This dungeon would be easy.
Kael approached Avrin, who was walking towards him. “Master, why were you holding back?..” Kael spoke. Avrin looked at him. “Hmm? Well it wouldn't be fun if I beat him so easily. Here is a lesson. Me and Clovis both knew martial arts, I also have other abilities. I wanted to see how my martial arts fared against his.”
Kael rubbed his head, confused, as he walked beside Avrin. “Master, I don't get it… That's confusing..” Avrin laughed quietly. “It is hard to explain, but consider it a matter of pride. When you are older and experience the same situation, you will understand”
Avrin walked towards Felia, and she only gazed silently, still trembling a bit. “I guess spending the day here will be necessary. I would like to wash up..” He sighed quietly, as he also needed to fix his attire.
Felia only silently nodded, and then looked at Clovis, who was being helped by people and tended to. “Avrin….” She whispered his name as her cheeks turned a soft cherry red while a sly grin appeared on her face.------------------------

-----------------
Having returned to the inn, Avrin had remembered that the horses have yet to be fed, so he told Kael to go handle it. If he was to not give him some responsibility, than the boy would think this easy.
Raising the badge Gregson gave him, they received a surprising discount, and even received the VIP rooms. After telling the innkeeper to alert him when Kael returned, Avrin made his way up and headed towards his own room.
Removing his attire, his upper body, which was bare, had only a few cuts and scratches that would disappear in a minute. It seemed that ever since the particles of his body grew in strength, so did his regeneration.
As much as he wanted to examine his inner workings, he decided not to, as he realised there was a personal mini spring bath built into the VIP room. Extending a few meters and made from shaped rock, he was awed by it.
He remembered reading a book about the country of japan that was famous for many things, including their hot springs. He had never gotten to visit it as a general, even when given the chance due to his tasks, but he felt he could enjoy himself here even if it where a sort of replica.
Stripping down, he removed all of his attire and stepped into the bath, before sitting on a sort of edge as he spread his hands over the shaped rock to relax. The steam was incredibly good, as it relaxed his skin even to the point where his Divine Sense was turned off.
He began to think about the others. “If everything went well, they should be nearing or already on the Northern Continent.” Avrin’s face went a little pale, as he worried that there may be dangerous people there, or even monsters.
He remembered the faces of all the people, from women and children, to men looking for a new start. He felt that it will be a tough road ahead, but with their bodies and potential, they will be able to overcome the hurdle if they put their mind to it.
He began to carefully think about the future, and things that were important at that stage. He knew this planet was created and inhabited by not only the Gods but their creations. If he himself became a being that rivals or even surpasses a God, would he even want to be here?
He felt it may seem weird, as if he is hijacking or stealing the work of another. “Maybe if I ever achieve that, I can find a planet for my people” The thought caused his heart to jump a little, as the very words were something only a child with an a large imagination would say.
“My own planet… A being stronger than a God…” Avrin had no doubt he would achieve that strength if he was careful and gathered enough Sky Metal and strengthened himself. Who knew what his limits were, or even if their was any.
He began to think and ponder things and remember his own execution. How he was betrayed and used as a scapegoat. It made him frown, but then smile. “If I play my cards right, maybe God will give me a chance at revenge..” When judge Dere sentenced avrin and irritated him after betrayal, it caused his anger to swell.
He had been a partner to Avrin, and assisted him, and who he assisted many times. And for the sake of his own advancement and to be considered a great figure, he easily betrayed Avrin. Not only that, even his own crew had done so.
“Cure on it's way…. That bastard… It would have been too late…” Avrin spoke, as Dere, at the time of his trial, had cursed him, telling them a cure was found. Although Avrin was to blame to a degree, the planet with the virus was on the outskirts of where humanity had inhabited. It was next to two other planets that were not yet infected, and for their sake, he had to exterminate the infected planet.
A shallow look appeared on his face as he remembered the nightmare he had at one point. At that point, he was broken from his train of thought, as a knock was heard from the door to the spring area.
“Yes?..” He called out, not bothering to emit his Divine Sense, as he wanted to just relax and focus on relaxing. He reached over and grabbed the broken mask on his face, before removing it and gazing at it while waiting for an answer.
“Avrin, I’ve decided we can leave tomorrow morning. Clovis will remain and heal, and then join us later. Will you be joining with him while you heal?” The voice was none other than Felia’s.
“I will also join you in leaving tomorrow. My major wounds are already gone.” This caused Felia to be silent. She felt Avrin was mysterious and unusual. She called out. “You are indeed impressive, Avrin. I never would have thought you were hiding your power and still holding back.”
Avrin blinked, as he placed the mask to the side of the tiled floor. “Holding back? Did Kael tell you?” Felia gave a soft laugh. “Was it wrong of him to do so?” She spoke as she leaned against the wall next to the door to the spring. She gazed curiously at the ceiling.
“It's fine. Is there anything else?” Felia was silent, and then replied a few seconds after. “You're welcome to share my bed tonight. Are you interested?” Avrin himself blinked and smiled with a gentle laugh. “You are quite assertive and brave. Is it my power you're after?”
He himself was curious. Felia replied blatantly. “I think a person who is powerful yet doesn't brag of his strength is someone to respect and adore. I am also curious of your appearance. You try hard to hide it.”
Avrin could hear the tone of her voice. He didn't feel that she was lying, but it seemed she liked strong people who were respectful. “Hmph… Is my appearance a major role? You seem like you're taking a gamble. I may be as ugly as a goblin” He grinned to himself.
Felia seemed to laugh. “Ahh, there is no way you are. For you to say that, I can only assume you're confident. Besides, appearance is only a side thing. You seem special in your own right. For instance, those wounds you got from Clovis, you said they’re already healed. I can see why you took his attacks head on. You must have a strong body”
Avrin wasn't sure how to reply, but he could see she was perceptive. “I used some potions I acquired from the shop” Felia was starting to think that was probably the reason. After all, to her, she had never heard of someone recovering so quickly without the use of expensive potions.
Felia moved and on spoke “Lets make a deal” She mumbled out. Avrin raised his head and spoke “Deal?” Felia continued. “If I ever manage to impress you, will you show me what you look like?” Her curiosity had gotten the better of her, as she was intending on finding out.
Avrin’s lips pursed for a moment, and he didn't reply. “Avrin?” She spoke, wanting to know. “If you manage to impress me somehow, I will show you what I look like then.“ He didn't feel that she was a bad person. In fact, his agreement was mainly because he had thought of Syrana.
He had remembered when he betrayed her and Ayame. It made him feel a little bad how aggressively he wanted revenge, but he still was sure he didn't want to be followed and pursued by them. He felt that at that point, it was the only way he could do it. Any other way and he would have lost the Sky Metal.
Felia gave a rare honest smile. “Great! I'll be off then. Don't forget, my bed is big enough for both of us.” Avrin gave a quiet laugh. “Idiot..” He whispered to himself, before the sound of Felia leaving and the door closing was the only remaining sound.
After Avrin had finished and formed a new set of clothing to replace his tattered attire, he decided to get some rest, even though he didn't need it. The evening had soon passed, and morning came. By the time it was 6:00 am, Avrin was already equipped and prepared. Making his way over to the first floor, he knocked on Kael’s door.
“Kael, are you ready?” Immediately, Kael spoke as he opened the door, wearing one metal boot while he had his under attire on. “Ahh, give me a bit, Master!” He spoke, looking at Avrin before Avrin then nodded and went off downstairs.
Greeting him on his way down was Clovis, who was bandaged up but was looking good. He smiled at Avrin and laughed. “Ha! You healed so fast, one wouldn't think you were fighting intensely yesterday. I'm jealous!” Avrin gazed at him. He felt this man was indeed strong for himself. “Potions make the difference” Clovis nodded as he followed Avrin downstairs to the dining area. When people saw them, the conversations they were having had gone silent. Yesterday’s match had spread quite far to those who didn't have the chance to witness it.
“That Avrin healed so quickly… Can potions do that?” One merc whispered, while another responded. “Probably expensive ones. He’s a lord after all, he must be loaded… I'm more irked at him taking a Master level attack head on and only fighting at the end… That's crazy”
Avrin ignored the words as he went over to an empty table where breakfast was being served. Clovis even decided to sit opposite of him, as he had taken a liking to Avrin, and began to tell him of his training.
“The Flame Fist technique took hundreds of years to develope, and you took all 4 strikes without dying, and even healed that quick… It makes me feel silly. I will have to train harder” He spoke as he began to eat.
His quiet attitude from yesterday had turned to one of openness, as he had no more reason to belittle Avrin. Before long, Felia made her way down, all prepared. She gazed at Avrin and Clovis and smiled, before making her way over and sitting at their table.
“We will be leaving in 10 minutes. Yesterday night a messenger appeared from the advance group. Everything at the dungeon is quiet as usual, so nothing strange. We should be good when we arrive”
Clovis nodded. “Good, good. I can't wait to test my strength against these Draconians.” Avrin’s mouth section had reformed and shut. Having finished eating, he spoke. “There's most likely a dragon down in that dungeon”
He had thought he may as well let them know, but having spoken, Felia responded “I figured as much. As long as we are careful, it should be a nice hunt” After she spoke, Kael made his way down and ate beside Avrin.
As time went on, the entire merc group had prepared themselves, and were off from the fortress like outpost. The journey itself, Felia told Avrin on the way, would take 3 hours. “We need to go through the Witchwood northwest of here, from there we go through a narrow mountain pass. The Witchwood itself is the biggest threat, since their are creatures lurking around. As for the pass, it should be good”
Avrin listened and replied “What sort of creatures are in the Witchwood?” Clovis laughed quietly, and decided to answer him. “Lurkers. Mana spirits of deceased adventurers who have had their spirits twisted in agony, not able to find rest. They manifest bodies from the Witchwood environment. We need to be careful around those”
Avrin had never seen a spirit creature. He had seen orcs and goblin like creatures, as well as the creatures in the Elven continent. He wasn't impressed, but he would finally be able to see something interesting.
“Master, how do we fight Lurkers?” Kael asked curiously. Avrin gazed to the side, looking at him. “It will be my first time fighting one, so we will have to see. I suppose hitting them with something” He joked.
Felia laughed and spoke “Without magic, it is going to be annoying for you both, so our mages can handle a few as long as we defend them.”
The group of 89 made their way onward. The path was quiet, and the creatures dared not fight them, as their numbers where too much, and they traversed in open space. As they went on, 2 hours had passed, and everyone had a look of nervousness. With no events occurring, everyone had time to think of the possible danger that lied ahead.
When they came across the Witchwood, with dead trees and swamp areas, with gas flowing out, their hearts tightened. “What are you all scared for? Lets go.. We haven't seen any Lurkers yet, and even the messenger made it through alone”
With that said, the group nodded in agreement and went on. The smell of the witchwood was one of rotting wood and strangely of flesh as well. Kael, holding his nose, had his face go a little green. “Master...this place reeks…” Avrin found no issue with it. On the battlefield when he was stranded on planets, he had to do some things to hide himself that he was not proud of.
“It isn't a big deal. On the battlefield, there are corpses all around you, it will smell much worse” As they continued on, the Witchwood had gotten quieter, until even the wildlife had stopped making sounds.
Everyone knew something was coming. “Be on your guard” Felia spoke, but not in a loud voice, afraid it may lure whatever was out there. Silence reigned, and Clovis whispered to Avrin. “I have heard stories of lurkers banding together to ambush large groups. I guess they’re utilizing some strategy from when they were alive.”
You might be reading a stolen copy. Visit for the authentic version.
Avrin looked around before augmenting his left eye. With that, he was able to see the flow of mana, and the spirits of the Lurkers were several dozen meters away, just eyeing them from afar.
“-50 to 90…. This is going to be annoying-” To Avrin, he had no issue protecting himself and Kael. He was more so thinking if anyone else would die. “We are surrounded, but they’re not moving. Just observing.”
Felia and Clovis showed curious expressions. “You can see them?” Felia spoke out of astonishment. “Yes, but whether or not I can see them isn't the issue right now. I'm wondering why they aren't attacking”
Clovis also wanted to ask what sort of ability Avrin had used, but found it wasn't the right time. “Maybe they are weighing the outcome?” Felia spoke out “Pick up the pace!” Her voice resounded.
The merc group began to speed things up, as their horses all began to move forward at least 2x faster. The Lurkers, who were watching from afar, found that something was strange. The group had suddenly gone faster. They started to emit strange sounds, despite not being able to be seen by anyone but Avrin.
“Screech!!...” The sounds of banshee like cries echoed all around them. Everyone began to look around as they sped up. The Lurkers had charged, as their bodies finally revealed themselves. Some made out of mud, stones and sticks, with a glowing core and twisted faces, as they dashed like ghouls across the Witchwood.
“Shit...you were right..” Felia spoke towards Avrin. Several Lurkers jumped towards the merc group, hoping to catch some off guard and knock them off their horses, but the merc mages, who had gone through many battles, managed to prepare fire bolt spells and blow the Lurkers away, injuring them as they limped back into the Witchwood.
Avrin hadn't attacked, as he was carefully examining the Lurkers and their method of attacking. He grinned. “Felia, at this rate, they’re going to kill some of your men. If you don't want anyone to die, listen to me.”
Felia hesitantly looked at Avrin. “If you want to speak, then speak…” She was also worrying about the loss of her men's’ lives. “Give me 5 people, we will try to lure a majority of them away, which should make it easier for the main group.”
Felia felt her eyebrows twitch heavily. “What?... A suicide mission is what this sounds like” Avrin spoke “Hurry up, the longer we take, the more of these things will come, until there are too many to handle.“
Felia pursed her lips before speaking up the names of the closest individuals and telling them to follow Avrin. They looked back, confused, but dared not to disobey orders. 5 of the mercs slowed down before they were in range of Avrin at the very back.
“Go deeper into the Witchwood with me” As he spoke this, Kael followed closely, and the others, although cautious and confused, followed him in. The Lurkers seemed to take notice, as they had thought the small group breaking off were running away. They considered this as easy pickings.
45 of them rushed towards Avrin’s small group as they rode left of the main group, deeper into the Witchwood. “Ride closer to each other.” Using his augmented eye and extending his Divine Sense, he was able to clearly see that there were many more Lurkers on their way. He made sure to direct them in the direction where the most would take notice, as well as towards an open area.
After riding several hundred meters, they were being chased by a mind boggling 90+ Lurkers. “Ahh, we’re going to die!!! You led us to die!!” A crazed merc cried out. “Be quiet and focus!” One of the others spoke to him, but he himself was nervous.
As they entered the open area with a bit of swamp around, Avrin spoke “Go to the center and stay close” Doing as Avrin told them, they had reached the center before the Lurkers came into the open, visible and still screeching as they began to surround them.
“Argh….. We’re gonna die…” The same man spoke, as tears were making their way down his eyes. “M..Master..what now?” Kael spoke. Avrin had no intention of revealing a large portion of his strength. If he did, the mercs would tell the others, and a rumor that gains him unwanted attention may appear. But he understood he shouldn't skimp out on his strength if he wanted to be sure of their survival.
“Perfect..” He muttered under his breath, before his Divine Sense focused on the open area, focusing all its strength there. It was as if the air became heavy. The Lurkers felt something was off, as they quieted down and looked around.
Avrin emitted Nebula Mist from his body, and entered the ground. His output was much higher than before, due to his Type 2 particles.
“Shadow guard.” He spoke softly, before the area around the group of 6, Kael included, was covered in a dome of dark matter walls, protecting them from the outside but also blocking their view.
The mercs were panicking at first, as this dark magic came into their view, but their voices were soon cut off as they were sealed away. The Lurkers hesitantly looked at Avrin and the shadow guard made out of dark matter walls.
“Why are you all hesitating?... Weren't you chasing us before?” Avrin quietly laughed, before his body tensed up and using his speed he appeared in front of a group of 7 nearby Lurkers. Extending his arms out, as well as his fingertips that acted as blades, he slashed away at them.
The wind itself began to scream, as it, along with the Lurkers were split apart. Avrin then moved on to the next group, as he began to tear through them with ease. He constantly held himself back when fighting a new opponent, as it was the best way for him to gauge strength so far.
The Lurkers all screeched with fury after seeing their companions being torn apart. They all rushed towards Avrin, punching, kicking and biting towards him. But Avrin himself was like an instant typhoon. One moment he would vanish, and a gust of sharp wind would form on one spot, and before they could even change direction, he would have vanished to another spot.
This began to instill fear and confusion in the Lurkers. Until they finally stopped and surrounded him after retreating. Avrin looked at them and raised a brow. He was utterly disgusted, as he then looked at his own hands, seeing the mud and materials that made their bodies all over his hands. As he looked around, he saw that their numbers didn't seem to decrease by much.
“Hmmm?... I'm sure I killed 40 of them. What's goin-” He stopped speaking as he looked at one of the Lurkers he had recently killed, seeing the core of it's body, that was intact, glowing red and blue before it's corpse began to repair itself.
“I see, you sneaky little devils. Unless I destroy that, you're going to survive. Haha” He laughed to himself, before he began a second wave of to attack them.. This time, after the 4th group of Lurkers, who now had destroyed cores due to avrins focus on them. The other lurkers began to shriek in terror as they saw he was now going for their very core.
They began to retreat with no hesitation. By then, Avrin had killed 80 or so of them, and when they had all retreated out of sight, he used his Nebula Mist to clean his hands while he navigated across the broken cores that were glowing slightly, and appeared at the Shadow Guard.
With a thought, the guard retracted, showing the group startled by Avrin. “You bastard.. You trapped us!” One spoke, before he and the others kept silent as they looked around, seeing the many corpses of the Lurkers.
Their faces had gone incredibly pale with shock. “Incredible…” One of the mercs spoke, as he looked around. “Wow Master, you don't seem injured, and you killed so many..” Kael spoke with amazement “I wish you would let me see next time..”
Avrin remounted his horse. As he was preparing to depart, he saw the mercs make their way to the Lurkers and loot their cores. “What are you doing?” He spoke, confused, before one of the mercs who was stuffing a sack full of the broken cores responded. “These cores can sell for at least 2 gold each. Even if they’re broken, they’re still made from mana. Mages use these for magic and stuff” He spoke.
“Hmm..” Avrin gave it some thought before nodding and giving them a bit of time before they took as many as they could. They then headed back without worry. Whenever some Lurkers spotted them, they saw Avrin and shrieked in fear and fled.
“Hahaha, Lord Avrin, those figures are scared shitless of you!” The merc that was near tears spoke. “Of course! Master is incredibly strong, these things are dirt for him” Kael tried to boast.
Traveling on and following the tracks the main group had left, they came across the tracks leading outside of the Witchwood. “Do you think they got out?..” One merc spoke to Felia as they were outside of the Witchwood, bandaging the wounded that had been injured in the attack.
“Of course… If he doesn’t, well….” Felia also showed some worry, wondering if it was the proper course of action to let Avrin do so. Clovis spoke. “Mounted combat sucks. Not much I can do…” He rubbed his head regretfully.
Felia smiled at him. “Clovis, that’s nonsense. Although Avrin led the majority away, you still decimated quite a few of them. Without you, I'm sure we would have had some fatalities.”
At that moment, someone pointed at the Witchwood as the group of 7 made their way out. Felia counted them before sighing in relief. Avrin and the others rejoined the main group, before the mercs who where with him showed faces as if they had gotten rich.
As they went to their comrades, they laughed. “Haha, you guys missed out on a ton!! We’re rich!” One spoke, while another softly pushed him. “Don't tell them dammit. Now we gotta share…” He spoke in a joking tone
Their comrades were skeptical about what had happened, and seeing the look of doubt, one of the mercs who were with Avrin spoke “Bastards, you don't believe us? Fine, show them..” At that moment, the mercs got the large sacks they placed on their horses and emptied the contents on to the ground, and the cores formed a large pile.
The mercs all crowded around, their faces turning red with envy and awe. One of the higher ranked mercs looked at the core pile. “Damn… There has to be a few hundred gold worth of magic materials. Some of these are in nice condition. I wouldn't sell those for 5 gold, maximum.”
Felia was gazing at the cores, not shocked at the worth, but more so at the amount of cores. “You were only gone for 8 minutes, and you killed so many?” Avrin looked at her for a moment. “Once you know their weakness, they’re not hard to kill.”
Clovis laughed, as he was nearby “Avrin I should have followed you. Wish I could have seen how you killed these things.“ Felia called out to everyone. “Ok. Now that everyone’s here, we’re continuing on!”
Within several minutes, the group had prepared themselves and headed off, leaving the Witchwood and entering the pass. Spending a good amount of time, the only issue they found was that they had to from a single file line. The path was well closed off, so there was no sign of any ambush.
Before long, they entered an open area with some shrubbery and jungle like growth. The path had linked into a small mountain that had some open areas where the sunlight was flooding through. Traversing in there were some eyes watching them, but they were not scared.
The eyes belonged to their comrades that had gone ahead with Wyni. Before long, they had arrived at a large stone like structure with a gaping hole in the middle. The structure had strange patterns all over it that seemed to resonate with mana a bit.
At the entrance, there was a small campsite, and the merc group made their way forward, joining up with them. “Wyni!” Felia called out, before a female Beastman looked up from a table that had a map on it.
“Felia, you came. But you're late..” Wyni frowned as she made her way towards Felia. The other mercs began to station themselves and see what they could help with. “We ran into some trouble, but thankfully, everyone made it.”
Avrin and Kael dismounted in an empty spot. Avrin began to check the supplies that Henreth had prepared, and directed Kael on what to take. Avrin gazed and saw a health potion Henreth had prepared. He placed it in his own enchanted sack before looking over the rest.
“Master… I can't believe we are here. People back home would kill for a chance at a dungeon… I don't think the people at Gaia Academy have ever come to a place like this!” Avrin looked at him and spoke.
“Good. If you survive, you can have something to brag about” He laughed as he walked off. Kael’s face turned pale, as he called out while following Avrin “Ahh, Master, aren't you going to protect me?!!...”
Avrin neared Felia and spoke “Now that we are here, me and Kael are going inside. Anything you need?” Both Felia and Wyni looked at Avrin, stunned at his words. But as Wyni saw Kael’s figure run up, her eyes showed hearts, and she gave a squeal before rushing over towards Kael.
Kael froze as he looked at her, and was about to run away, before she caught him and hugged him “Ahh! Felia, you brought me a nice gift!!” Wyni blurted out as she cuddled Kael.
Felia laughed and smiled, then turned to Avrin. “We planned to rest and recover till we were 100%. Kael must also be tired. Won't you at least let him rest?”
Avrin looked at Kael, who was being used as a teddy bear, before he looked at Felia. “Very well, he can rest…” Avrin then turned and headed towards the dungeon entrance. “Ahh, where are you going?” Felia spoke out, expecting him to rest as well.
“He is resting, but I want to see how well I do against these Draconians.” Clovis, who was nearby and preparing his own supplies, saw Avrin and overheard. “Perfect! I'll join you!” He laughed to himself before he followed behind.
Avrin stood and gazed at the dark entrance with several mana torches lighting up the inside that was still fairly dark. Using his augmented eye, he couldn't feel any traces of mana other than the mana the structure itself seemed to generate.

Hello guys before i continue with the usual i want to let you all know im recovering from the flu :( so Es  & the next sr may be a little slow.now for 2 pieces of good news. first piece is i'v started submitting chapters for my third project Mancer's Grimoire. this project may seem a bit more cliche but also appeal to some of you who like an mc proving people wrong and advancing fairly.  3 ratings man that takes me back to the days i first posted SR :)
the second piece of good news is i was able to get a lot of ideas that were flooding my head into that story and i now have a clean slate to work on SR and ES which i can focus on now.
!!!!! Pr Credits To Draconis & Tembulon who not only both pred it but improved this ch's quality greatly please rep them. Also Full Credits to Askard who maintains the Information Doc where a majority of spectral regalia information is written please Rep him to ^^!!!

avrin is a charecter with many things on his mind and the way the story is now i dont feel it would sync well with his charecter. that isnt to say there wont be romance for him im just saying right now isnt the time for it.
also a few of you want me to tell some parts from other charecter perspectives im sure many are wondering where are ayame and syrana? and where are those demons sent after avrin?. after this dungeon arc and the end of volume 2 i will have a nice way to go backtrack and buff up that content for the story. i hope until then you guys will bare with me.
if you have any questions please pm me or comment here. also please refrain from asking for spoilers the only time i ever plan more then 2 chapters ahead is when i have a concept that will fit with the story. other then that 2 chs is my limit this keeps things fresh and less cliche --------------------
Avrin and Clovis made their way inside the dungeon. Strangely, the interior was lit up quite well, despite the entrance showing darkness. As if it was an illusion to keep adventurers on their toes. “This place reeks...” Clovis spoke as he looked around, seeing bones scattered everywhere, broken and disfigured. One couldn't tell if they were human or an animal’s.
Avrin didn't reply. Instead, he was contemplating something strange. As much as he tried to spread his Divine Sense, he couldn’t. It was as if a wall blocked it. He couldn't scan for more than 3 meters in any given direction. This made him more cautious, as he wondered who the creator of this dungeon was.
“No doubt we are being watched...” Avrin looked around, his eyes augmented, as he would rely on that. He could see that everything used to build this structure emitted mana, and with so many sources, it would be annoying to find an enemy. If they hid well enough, they could blend into the walls.
Of course, Avrin knew the chances of the creatures having the same mana source as the materials of this dungeon was very low, but he had to take everything into account to be prepared for the worst.
As the two of them traversed deeper, Avrin looked around. He had a fair understanding of the dungeon’s interior. It was built underground, and had bricks and cobblestone infused with mana layered around to keep the earth at bay.
Of course, this was backed up by the fact that some parts had cracked and crumbled over the years, and the earth had managed to make its way in, blocking some paths. “I wonder how deep this place leads. “ Clovis spoke as he knelt down beside a mangled skeleton, trying to examine it.
“Probably a kilometer, If there's a dragon, no doubt deep enough to cover and hide itself” Avrin replied as he tampered with the mana infused materials, his Nebula Mist touching the surface of a loose brick. As his dark matter touched the mana inside the brick, the mana did something he considered strange.
It began to try and push back against his dark matter, as if having a self defence mechanism. But his Nebula Mist overcame it and it was soon devoured. “So this can be done? It will be irritating if someone knows how to use this for combat”
Avrin whispered to himself. As soon as Avrin finished speaking, a screech like roar echoed across the entire area they were in, coming from the tunnel up ahead. Clovis quickly got up, as he was surprised by the sound “Finally. Seems like they took notice of us” He laughed quietly.
Avrin gazed into the tunnel with his augmented eyes. He then narrowed them “-Strange… I don't see anyt--” As he was about to finish, he thought he felt something was off. He quickly looked up to see the ceiling emitted a magic circle that opened up, and a several figures began to drop onto the ground, until a total of 5 landed between Avrin and Clovis. Gazing quietly, Avrin examined them.
These figures wore spiked armor over their muscular bodies. Although it seemed protective, he could see these creatures also had scales that looked as if they were no weaker than the armor they wore.
The creatures had long, lizard like faces, with sharp, piercing eyes and long snouts. They hissed and stood up, their bodies nearly 3 meters. As soon as one looked at Avrin, its body tensed and its muscles rippled as it roared, giving a similar screech to the sound he and Clovis had heard before.
“Damn these bastards are loud...” Clovis glared. He also had to be focused. He could feel these creatures were incredibly strong. One of the creatures facing Clovis charged at him without waiting, and swung its large claw hand towards him. The wind rippled slightly as the claw moved in its trajectory.
Clovis quickly ducked before side stepping, infusing his hand with flame affinity mana. He punched towards the creature's abdomen. “Flame Fist First Strike…” As his fist landed against the creature's hardened armor, Clovis flinched slightly, as he found it to be harder than he had thought.
The creature was pushed a few meters back as it skids across the ground, spitting out a mouthful of green blood. Its comrades gazed at it, then all but the one focused and circling Avrin hissed at Clovis for injuring their friend.
Of course, the one he had injured felt fury, as its body surged with energy and it rushed towards Clovis again. “Ahh, resilient bastard...” Clovis clenched his teeth as the creature madly clawed in all directions towards him. Clovis found no issue dodging some of them, but it was quite fast. “Ahh…” He called out, before one of the slashes found its way to his arm, causing a large gash as blood began to run down it.
“Fucking shit…” He glared at the creature that seemed to enjoy bringing him pain. It charged towards him again. Meanwhile, the creature eyeing Avrin like a piece of meat decided to act. It hadn't attacked first, as it saw Avrin was strangely calm, and made no movements.
As it began to also claw in all directions, Avrin began to dodge like Clovis he had been. He watched the creature attack Clovis, so he felt he knew some of their movements, and it helped significantly. “Hmm… Indeed, not slow” Avrin spoke, as he was focused carefully on the creature attacking him.
As the creature felt like it was being toyed with, it roared madly, and began to increase its speed, which surprised Avrin. As the creature tried to corner him, he decided to act. His fist turned into a blur as he plowed it into the creature’s abdomen, wanting to see how much it would do. Of course, he made sure to hold back to gauge strength. The creature was blown away several meters, and spit a mouthful of blood as it winced.
Clovis saw Avrin hit the creature and laughed. “Seems like these guys are tough…. I bet their scales would make nice armor” As if understanding Clovis’s words, the lizard that was eyeing him after attacking him howled madly, feeling offense of his words. It swung its claws towards him madly.
“Bastard… Shut up..” Clovis narrowed his eyes before he vanished, jumping up, avoiding both claws of the Draconian that swung down towards him. “Flame Fist...Second Strike…” His fist landed on the side of the creature's face, as its cheek bones cracked under the strength, before it was plowed into the ground, causing the tunnel to rumble a bit as a small hole in the ground formed.
Clovis jumped back soon after, as the other creatures watching their comrade jumped towards him to try and shoo him away from their wounded friend. Clovis rubbed his sore hand, which was caused by smashing it into the creature's cheek. “Tough bastards… And they think of each other too. I'm starting to think they’re not mindless…”
The Draconian stopped attacking Avrin for a moment to see Clovis hit its comrade. Its face tensed, as its scales nearly changed from green to red. It was in a furious, and it decided to vent it's frustration on Avrin. It vanished like a blur and appeared in front of Avrin, its claw slashing across his body.
Avrin had stopped for a moment, seeing Clovis attack the creature, and was caught off guard by the creature's sudden speed boost. A gash appeared across his chest, but the gash wasn't simple, it also held some blunt force, pushing him back several meters.
Red blood began to cover his attire as he looked down at his wound, then slowly raised his head towards the creature that still had a fury that could match fire in its face as it rushed towards Avrin.
The 3 Draconians that were watching Clovis assisted their comrade into the hole, as it then looked at Clovis and made a strange sound, as if communicating with its friends. The 4 Draconians then turned to Clovis and hissed and roared. “S..Shit, not good… I'll have to go all out. I wonder I’ll survive, hahahaha” He began to laugh, as if to try and cheer himself up.
As the creatures were about to rush, a green blur blew past them and smashed against the wall, causing rubble and debris to fly out. This shocked them and Clovis, as they waited for the dust to settle.
The Draconian that was fighting Avrin had been smashed inside, causing a large indentation on the wall. Its body bloodied and its right arm torn off as it twitched, clearly unconscious. The Draconians shivered at the sight, and right as one turned to look at Avrin, it was met by a sudden pain against its ribs.
“Claw of the Dragon…” Avrin muttered, his face under the mask showing an annoyed expression. The Draconian that wounded him had pissed him off by catching him off guard. His opened palm crashed against the creature's side, causing the scales to split and even its bones to break as it was blown away, spinning in a cartwheel motion before it too became a sort of indentation on the wall not too far from its unconscious comrade.
The Draconians near Avrin quickly retreated as they hissed, somewhat afraid of him, who defeated their friends in one move. Clovis on the other hand, was over the moon “Hahaha, you dumb bastards, not so tough now!! Going to gang up on me.“ He then turned to Avrin. “Avrin, I never knew you were so strong. How about we take one of these things back with us to dissect?” Clovis knew these creatures understood his words from before, and he spoke those words on purpose.
The Draconians faces filled with anger at the thought of them being treated in such a way. One of them rushed towards Clovis, howling in fury. Clovis’s eyes widened as he turned into a blur and spoke “Flame Fist Third Strike….” His fist engulfed in a large typhoon like fire that stunned the Draconian charging at him.
But it was too late for it to change course. It tried to sidestep, but Clovis was too quick. His fist smashed upward, as if uppercutting the creature. The Draconian could only try to block as it barely managed to.
But the strength in his attack was by far stronger than the last two. It was smashed upward against the ceiling, as fire began to burn against its scales for a few seconds, before the creature that crashed against the ceiling fell limp onto the floor.
The remaining Draconian looked at both Avrin and Clovis nervously, before it screeched out in a strange way. “Argh.. Loud bastard..” Clovis covered his ears, and even Avrin felt it was strange.
A few moments later, several more magic circles began to appear all over the place, as figures began to slowly pour out from them.

Avrin and Clovis gave strange looks, and they both bolted out the way they came from, knowing it would be annoying if they were surrounded, especially in a small space like that hall. “That unfair...shit, calling his friends..” Clovis couldn't help but feel annoyed as he ran beside Avrin back towards the way they came.
“It can't be helped. They seem pretty smart, no doubt they would call for backup.“ Clovis then looked at Avrin. “Avrin, why don't you fight them? I'm sure you can beat them all.”
Avrin looked at the grinning Clovis and frowned under his mask. “You take me for a fool? Why were you holding back? Surely your best move can defeat them all. And in that hall, you could get them all in one go”
Clovis chuckled. “True… But it uses too much of my mana. No way would I exhaust myself and let you take all the goodies that lay beyond.” Avrin laughed inwardly. “I'm not a thief. Besides, we haven't even seen anything that resembles treasure.”
As the two were running from the large amount of Draconians, the screeches and roars of the creatures echoed around the dungeon, and even outside. Felia, who was organizing several things to prepare for the dungeon, was wondering when Avrin and Clovis would return.
“Wyni, we should probably send a few people in” Wyni, who was sitting beside Felia, was also focused on the task. “You think they cleared the way in?” She spoke, to which Felia replied. “Most likely. It would do us good, but they may also take some treasure, leaving us down a bit”
Kael, who was sitting silently, felt irritated as he spoke. “Don't say that… My master is not a thief. He gave you his word. He won't go back on his word…” Kael frowned, his arms folded, as he was also waiting for Avrin and Clovis.
Wyni grinned, and she reached over and pinched his cheek playfully “So adorable when he is angry, Felia!” Kael frowned, as a vein appeared on his forehead. He could only swat away at Wyni’s hand, as both her and Felia laughed at him.
Their laughter was cut short by the screeches and roars of the Draconians that reached out of the dungeon. Not only them, but everyone raised their heads and quickly went on guard, as some surrounded the entrance.
The screeches and roars died down as two blurs blew passed the guards and landed softly on the ground. Clovis began to chuckle out. “Those things were strong! I can't wait to head back in. A shame they cheated by calling so many. I think they’re all peak Expert levels. They wouldn't be so hard if they weren't so durable” Clovis began to make his way towards Felia, as her, Wyni and Kael rushed over towards them.
Avrin gazed at the tunnel. It seemed the Draconians didn't follow them too far out. It was like they were bound to the dungeon. Felia saw that the two were back, as she was sweating when thinking something was wrong. But she relaxed as she saw they were both safe.
She then saw the gash mark across Avrin’s chest and a look of worry showed. She walked over “Avrin, are you ok?.. What happened in there…” Avrin nodded “I'm fine. One of them just caught me off guard..”
Felia gave a grin as she folded her arms, pushing her fair bust up. “So, how was it? Not as easy as you thought, right? It took all we had just to keep 3 of them at bay while we retreated.” Clovis dusted himself off. The rubble the fight had caused made him dusty.
“Hmm, they’re not so tough, as long as their numbers aren't too high we can fair well. And even then, I should be able to kill quite a few of them as a last resort.”
Felia smiled. “Clovis, you don't seem harmed. You seemed to do better than Avrin.” Clovis soon laughed. “Me? No way. Avrin was something else… He beat two of them easily. That Draconian really did get lucky by injuring him.”
Avrin had already walked passed them, towards the tent that Kael and some others had set up for him. Kael looked at Avrin worryingly. “Master, are you ok?” He could see the wound on Avrin. “I'm fine. This wound will heal quickly. Kael, why aren't you resting?”
Kael was silent, before he smiled “I couldn't rest while you were in there, Master. I'm so eager to venture in.” The look of excitement on Kael’s face couldn't be hidden. Avrin laughed softly, which caused Kael to blink twice, as he had rarely heard Avrin laugh.
“Hmm, well, go rest. I'll wait, and we will go with the main group.” Kael gave a soft sigh of relief, knowing he wouldn't miss out again. He nodded and went off to his own pavilion tent. He could see the emblem of the human kingdom, which meant that Henreth had packed this. Avrin understood what the 2 large packs on the sides of his and Kael’s horses were for.
Entering inside, the tent wasn't fancy. It had a simple bed, a table, and a few chairs, with Avrin’s stuff already inside. After closing the tent’s flap entrance, he removed his cloak and set it on the chair. His Nebula Mist was emitted around the wound, and it began to clean it, and also fix his torn outfit.
“Sky Metal is capable of creating things. I wonder if forging armor is possible..” He began to think of the possibilities, which caused him to smile. He then went over to a corner of the tent that was clear, and his Nebula Mist blew out like a breeze as a small carpet was formed.
Walking over to it, Avrin sat down cross legged and began to enter his body’s inner workings to check on the progress of things. Soon, his consciousness seemed to drift, as if a transition was met.
He could see sparkles of energy, both light and dark, drift around, he could see the very structure of his body. Any lesser man would have gone crazy, but Avrin was used to it all, having even seen God. It would take a lot to surprise him with shock and awe. “-So 90% Type 2 Particles. Other than a few I made myself, they all have twice the strength of a Type 1 Particle-” Avrin was silent for a moment, as he felt a little dissatisfied.
“-Such a complicated method… But it's good. It allows variety, and in the end, it's all progress. Let’s test something-” Using a bit of his energy, he reformed several Type 1 Particles, and he then ordered 5 C.Particles to use them in a sort of way to refine a single Type 2 Particle.
Gazing carefully, 3 Type 1 Particles were led to a lone Type 2 Particle that was then surrounded by the 5 C.Particles. Slowly, the C.Particles emitted a faint ripple, and 1 of the Type 1 Particles was trying to fuse with the Type 2 Particle.
As several minutes passed, the Type 2 Particle was x3 stronger than a Type 1 Particle, but was also larger in mass. Avrin felt something was off, and had gotten one of the Type 2 Particles he had gotten and compared the two.
The one he had created was the size of a Type 1 Particle, but was 10x its strength. He couldn't understand why, as he spent a bit just comparing the two. “-Hmm, the book God gave me doesn't tell me anything-” He began to understand that God only gave him a manual. He didn't want to hold his hand and tell him everything, as it would be cheating.
Avrin began to think carefully as he examined the two Type 2 Particles carefully. He then laughed a bit. He discovered the Type 2 Particle he didn't make had 3 layers, as opposed to the one he made, which was a single layer.
“-So the process wasn't complete-” Avrin began to carefully remove the layers of the Type 2 Particle the C.Particles had made. For him, the process was quite easy, as it was only a matter of removing the miniscule sheet that separated the energies. As he removed one layer, the Type 2 Particle shrunk in size, and by the time the other layer was removed, the Type 2 Particle was left with one layer, which was the outermost one.
Although it was 3x in strength, it was the size of a Type 1 Particle. Avrin understood that every time it was fed to increase in strength, it would need to have the layers removed. Avrin felt that the layers that were removed could be recycled into dark matter. As small as it was, it still helped.
Avrin began to separate the C.Particles. Carefully. In total, 10% of his body’s particles were C Particles. He would split them 40/40. Some to feed the Type 2 Particles and increase their strength, and the others to remove the thin shell and recycle it. The other 20% would carefully create Type 1 Particles to be used.
It hadn't taken long before his inner workings became a hub of activity, as several glowing dots began to reconfigure and get to work. Avrin felt this would take quite a bit of time at first, for the particles to get used to this process, but as time progressed, it would be quicker, as the C.Particles would gain the experience they needed.
Avrin began to ponder something as he looked at the C.Particles. “-Hmmm.. I wonder-” He took 2 C.Particles, and then began to fuse them together carefully. It had taken a bit of time before he was left with a satisfying result. The method in fusing the two was no different than fusing a regular particle.
Gazing at the product he had finished, the C.Particle was emitting the same color as a Type 2 Particle, but it had strange zebra like patterns around it that began to move. At that moment, the C.Particle did something strange.
It emitted a faint pulse to Avrin’s mind, as if trying to communicate. Avrin understood the pulse. It was a simple message “-Give me a task, oh? This little thing is quite handy-” Avrin smiled as he looked at it floating within his body.
He then gave an order that was a bit more advanced, but he wanted to see if it could handle it. The order was simple. “Oversee everything and let me know when all Type 2 Particles the C.Particles created are 3x in strength” The Type 2 C.Particle, as he dubbed it, soon emitted another pulse, before it began to drift into the center of Avrin’s body, where activity was going on.
From there, the thin zebra lines shot out towards the other C.Particles, linking onto them, as if it established a connection. Of course, it couldn't do this for all, but from there, the C.Particles that were linked, began to form one of those zebra like lines, before they also shot out to another C.Particle.
“-Establishing a link. You don't have enough energy to connect to them all, so you use a bit of the energy from those other C.Particles to increase the range. Very handy-” Avrin thought. Before long, he felt a presence outside of his body, and quickly left his inner workings to let his particles get to work.
As he opened his eyes, he saw Felia kneeling down in front of him, reaching quietly to his mask, as if trying to be as silent as possible. His eyes carefully opened. He had forgotten to leave his Divine Sense on, but had felt her as soon as she got too close.
As her hand drew near, he reached up and grabbed it. “Have you forgotten the deal you made?” Avrin spoke quietly. Felia jumped, before her face turned red from embarrassment, feeling Avrin’s grip.
“Oh, Avrin! You scared me.. Yes, the agreement… My fault. I saw you like this and figured I would maybe take a peak?..” Avrin let go of her arm as he stood up. “Don't do that again…” He spoke, somewhat irritated. Felia looked down, feeling she angered him. She tried to change the subject.
“Well, you didn't come out. Yesterday, when you and Clovis went into the dungeon, things were silent, so we thought it would be good today to leave early and enter”
Avrin blinked, a little surprised. “Yesterday?..” Felia nodded. “Oh, you must have been in quite a meditation to even lose track of time.” Avrin agreed with her inwardly. He realized there was indeed a fair time difference in his inner workings and outside.
“Very well. Let's go.” Avrin spoke as he walked passed Felia, who gave a smile as she followed behind him. Avrin’s intentions today were to go as far as he could in the dungeon. He truly wanted to see what treasures lay in the deepest part, as well as what these Draconians truly were.Secret Suprise.
