Please Rate/Follow/Favourite/Share/Enjoy ch 79
P.s never realised how close i was to #3 till earlier today *rubs hands together* i hope olyver wont mind me taking it >.> mwuahaha! -------------------
Jumping up towards the Draconian, Avrin grinned under his bloodied mask, as his face twisted slightly, before kneeing the creature in the jaw with as much strength as he could muster with one jump. The Draconian felt a surge of pain, as its brain and skull rattled slightly. Its jaw dislocated as it stumbled back in a daze.
Avrin landed softly on the ground as he rubbed his knee. “Your body...it's surprisingly harder than your brother’s… Why didn't you help him? You and him could have made it tougher for me if you worked together...”
The Draconian slowly recovered from its daze, as it managed to finally overpower the dark matter with its mana. It reached up with its large hand and twisted it's jaw. The sound of bones cracking slightly was heard as it's jaw was soon placed back into its position.
It seemed unfazed, which made Avrin somewhat disappointed, but he knew he could injure it. “The great one's law… Only one of us Half bloods may be present in any battle chamber… We may not act until intruders come to our room...”
Avrin raised his brow curiously. “Interesting… Why would this great one set this ru-” The Draconian dared not give Avrin time to rest, as it knew he had some sort of healing ability. It emitted it's terrifying killing intent as it smashed down towards Avrin.
Avrin chuckled in a pouty way as he jumped back, avoiding the attack. But the ground wasn't so lucky, as it smashed and split under the creature's blow with debris flying around. “Can't we talk things through? “ Avrin raised his hands in a calming gesture.
But the Draconian seemed to have taken this as an insult, as its eyes narrowed. “I'm done toying with you…. Your friends will be here soon…and I need your corpse to welcome them...” The Draconian reached behind it's back and took the hammer that was hanging around a strap that went around it's body.
Avrin felt a spine tingling threat. “-That hammer… If I get hit by that, it won't fare well for me…-” The Draconian took a deep breath, before it's body radiated an intense amount of mana that shook the room and engulfed all around it.
The hammer seemed to respond by radiating a dark mana that matched the intensity of the Draconian. “Void Greatsword...” Avrin said, raising his right hand. A large amount of dark matter surged down his arm before forming a large greatsword that seemed similar to the Void Sword, but had a thicker, more menacing edge, as it also radiated energy.
The Draconian charged towards Avrin. With each step it shook the chamber, before reaching near Avrin it gave a casual swing towards him.
Avrin also swung the great sword with both hands towards the hammer, and as the two weapons collided, a pulse of energy caused the metallic tiles to crack and the walls to twist. Kael, who was frightened to death on the other side of the door, could only pant heavily from fear at the rumbling sounds. Although he wasn't skilled, the energy and mana dispensed by the attacks and the Draconian was enough for him to feel that the battle was intense.
“Master….forgive me… I'm so useless…. I'm useless!” Kael uttered helplessly as the two combatants battled for supremacy. It was obvious Avrin’s greatsword was weaker, as cracks had begun to form. He had to emit Nebula Mist to heal it. But the Draconian snickered before roaring out. “Earth Shaker!” The hammer emitted a menacing dark affinity mana before it seemed to form a manifestation of energy that soon crushed towards the greatsword, effortlessly shattering it and smashing against Avrin.
Seeing the mana of the hammer form, Avrin wasn't dumb enough to take it head on. He knew his sword couldn't withstand it, and he willed the Nebula Mist to form a Shadow Wall, managing to create one at the right moment.
The hammer smashed against the wall, also shattering that, but losing a majority of the force before it hit towards Avrin, who crossed his arms to block. The force was enough to blow him back several meters and break some bones in his arms, as well as dent the metal in his gauntlets.
Feeling that his arms were numb, Avrin frowned while gazing at the Draconian. “-I could use Void Crystal, but infusing it with more dark matter is something I haven't managed to master yet…I’ll have to go with what I got-”
As his broken arms had healed enough for him to raise them, the Draconian cautiously began to walk towards Avrin. “-I'll just outsmart this guy...-” Raising his hand, Avrin began to charge Void Spheres, before firing them towards the Draconian. The sounds of them launching echoed slightly.
The Draconian snickered, before the dark mana around the hammer emitted more powerfully. The Draconian then began to hit the Void Spheres away, deflecting them with ease. Avrin continued before snickering. He formed two more Void Spheres and fired them towards the Draconian, who neared him.
The Draconian laughed heartily and spoke out. “It's useless… Your vile magic can't defeat my Legion Hammer the great one himself gifted me…” As he was about to hit the Void Spheres, the spheres themselves stopped in midair, and shattered into shards that than surrounded the Draconian.
“Void Crystal shards…” Avrin uttered quietly. The Draconian looked around, not daring to make a single move, as it eyed around itself being surrounded by hundreds of small glowing shards of dark matter.
“Tricks won't save you…” Avrin willed the shards to attack the Draconian. The Draconian laughed out, before the energy of the Legion Hammer extended, blocking the Void Shards with ease. Avrin made sure to fire 2 more Void Spheres that shattered into Void Crystal shards to try and keep the Draconian at bay.
The Draconian felt no issue as he began to walk, with the Legion Hammer’s dark affinity mana protecting him. “It's no use… This hammer was gifted to the great one by the former demon king! It's made from Unique metals combined with magic! A gift from a demon to kill a demon! Hahahaha!”
Avrin remained quiet, before stopping his assault on the Draconian. As the Draconian neared within 2 meters, Avrin spoke. “I'm curious. Why is it that you only came when my companion triggered a trap?”
The Draconian tilted his head as the dark mana shield remained. “I’ve always wanted to see the look of despair on someone's face as they realize they have done something that spells their doom”
Avrin tilted his head and raised his hand. “I see.” The Draconian grinned before taking another step forward, but stopped, as it saw a faint purple glow under its feet. It's eyes widened with worry.
Underneath the Draconian, Nebula Mist had gathered into a large circle under it. It began to think to itself. “-When did he do this… Wait! He kept me occupied and focused on thinking! He was weak...but I should have seen this!-”
Avrin wasted no more time before forming a Shadow Dome around the Draconian. “I bet you're thinking why you couldn't see it… I hid the mist under the debris and the cracks in the ground… You were simply too dumb and let me gather such an amount”
“-This should buy me some time-” Avrin thought to himself, before he raised his hand and began to gather a large amount of Nebula Mist, having used a large amount of dark matter to heal his wound, then and continuing to heal them. He had no choice but to devour the mana around him to shape the Nebula Mist.
“Insect!” The Shadow Dome began to shake, as small cracks started to form. Avrin showed a sign of worry. “Hmph… That hammer is tougher than I expected...” Forming the mist into an object, Avrin was grinning menacingly. “-Just wait you lizard bastard… I'll cook something up for you…-”
“GRAGH!!” The Draconian roared out, before the Legion Hammer emitted more dark mana, and with both hands he swung with full force, managing to break apart the shadow dome. He then gazed at Avrin, who seemed to be still, but eyed him as if he were waiting.
“Your physical strength is impressive, as well as that weapon. But I don't think you're threatening enough for me to fight with my life on the line… You're only so-so. “Avrin spoke, as he hid his right hand beneath his cloak, using his left to make a swaying gesture to taunt the lizard.
The Draconian’s eyes twitched as it hissed at him. “Insect… How dare you mock me!! Perish already!!” Raising the Legion Hammer with both hands, it began to infuse the weapon with its own mana before rushing towards Avrin.
“I can't seem to take you seriously… You're threatening, but I don't feel that I will lose my life. As an apology, have this.” Avrin raised his right hand, holding a round object with a dark blue color with two words inscribed on it. If one gazed carefully they would see that the words read, P.F Grenade”
Turning around, Avrin didn't hesitate to cover his eyes tightly as he let his guard down to shield his eyes. The Draconian gazed at the object and laughed out. “Worm. This won't work on-!” As he spoke and approached near the grenade, not bothering to dodge it, he knew it was a big mistake.
For a couple of moments, sound could not be heard, as a white light as bright as a star engulfed the entire room, blinding the Draconian at point blank range, but also giving him the sensation of being burnt.
“GAHHA!” He screeched in agony as the light vanished. Avrin turned around, seeing the Draconian drop the hammer as it held its eyes in pain. “I CAN'T SEE!!! “ Walking over to the Draconian, Avrin tilted his head. “There's your mistake… You underestimated me… But that's fine...I'll forgive you...”
Avrin gazed at the hammer the Draconian dropped, before reaching down and picking it up. He felt it was indeed quite heavy. Only someone with inhuman strength could wield it, and even then they would need to have good balance, meaning it was perfect for him.
As the Draconian fell to its knees, slowly recovering, it peaked out from between its long scaled fingers, seeing that it's eyes were still not fully recovered. It saw Avrin’s blurred figure approach it. “Y...You...YOU!! HOW DARE YOU USE SUCH A MAGIC!!”
Avrin walked over to the Draconian, who was on his knees, gazing at him. “Magic? That was no magic.” With a swift motion, the hammer turned into a blur, before Avrin smashed it against the creature's side with great force.
The air trembled as the ground shattered somewhat. The Draconian bounced like a ragdoll across the ground, before smashing into a wall. Avrin showed no mercy or any signs of easing up, as he casually patted the hammer and began to walk over, towards the Draconian.
“That is technology...” Gazing for a moment, Avrin stopped in his tracks, as the doors he had sealed off blew open with a fiery mana bursting out into the chamber. The dark matter sealing it shattered like glass, and the door frames themselves came unhinged as they flew off.
Avrin looked over calmly, as his Divine Sense already discovered who it was. “Oh, you're all here?” Avrin uttered out towards the individuals at the door. As the dust settled, a fist emitting a fiery red mana pointed forward softly went down, revealing it's owner to be Clovis. “Oho! Finally caught up. You had me worried for a moment.”
Felia, who was behind him to avoid the attack, rushed in as she smiled outward towards Avrin. “A...Avrin! You're alive!” Gazing at Felia, who seemed to be overjoyed, he nodded. “Indeed I am. Why wouldn't I be?” He spoke as he resumed walking toward the Draconian, who was coughing out blood and slowly getting out of the hole that he had caused.
“Uhh...” Felia looked over, seeing the strange Draconian, but felt things were fine. “Kael...said...you were in danger...” Kael, who was being held by Wyni, was near tears as he rushed forward, out of her arms. He called out “Master!”
Avrin spoke out as he approached the Draconian. “Ah, yes. I'll be done soon, don't worry...” The Draconian, whose sight was damaged, looked at the faintly blurred Avrin carrying his hammer.
“M...My hammer!!...Give….GIVE IT BACK!” It rushed towards him, but it's movements were clumsy and hindered due to its sight, as well as its injuries. Avrin dashed forward, using his right palm to use a Shadow Splinter against the creature's stomach.
With the force causing the weakened Draconian to stumble and cough out blood, it held it's stomach and dropped to its knees, Clovis whistled and laughed. “That's quite an attack. I wouldn't want to get hit by-” 
This book was originally published on . Check it out there for the real experience.
Before he finished, Avrin mercilessly swung the hammer down onto the Draconians back with great strength, smashing it into the ground causing a small crater to form. The Draconian screeched in agony as it felt the strength of the blow crash down on it.
Avrin quietly looked at it. “You think I won't pay you back for that sneak attack before?” Using his right foot, he turned the creature over onto its stomach, as his eyes darkened slightly. He emitted a killing aura that made the Draconian, who was panting for breath, wince in terror.
“W...Wait...w...we can talk this thro-!!” Avrin threw the hammer to the side, before he emitted dark matter into his fist. He began to barrage the Draconian with heavy punches, causing the ground to shake rapidly with each punch.
Just like the Draconian did to him, he returned the favor. The Draconian didn’t use any technique, and neither did Avrin. Just his raw energy to pummel the creature. This lasted for several minutes, and the scene had already gotten the attention of the mercs, who were cautiously watching with fear on the side of the crater.
Kael looked at Avrin with worry. “Master...w...why?” The Draconian was a bloody pulp. Avrin had made sure to use a set amount of force, wanting the Draconian to feel the pain it caused him. Avrin soon stopped, as he raised his body, panting slightly.
His gauntlets were covered with the Draconian’s blood. It wheezed in agony, barely alive. “So….I guess I'll see you off then.” Avrin grabbed the Legion Hammer that was by his side and raised it up, ready to strike the finishing blow.
As he was about to bring it down, a hand grabbed onto his. “I'm not sure...what happened between you and this creature...but you defeated it… There is no honor in killing someone or something when it's down…”
Avrin glanced to his side, seeing Clovis gripping his fist firmly. “Hmmm...” Avrin turned to look at the Draconian, then up at the faces of the mercenaries, that showed signs of fear, some stepping back as he made eye contact. He then looked at the worried Kael and Felia, who seemed to show a look of caution.
“I'm done here... anyway” Avrin dropped the hammer to the side before stepping out of the crater that had formed on an angle, allowing him to walk up it. Making his way over to the side where his cloak was with the enchanted sac hidden under it for safety, he reached to pick it up but stumbled slightly, as he felt quite dizzy.
“Hmm!” His mind grew blurry as he fell to his knees and coughed out some coagulated blue blood. “-My body…took a beating. I lost a lot of blue blood… I guess I can recycle it-” Raising his hand, the dark matter contained in the bits of blue blood that stained the ground as well as his clothing began to separate from it.
A stream of purple mist began to make its way towards Avrin for a moment, before it entered his body. Although it had brought only a slight relief, it was better than nothing. Avrin continued over towards the wall of the chamber and leaned against it.
When he sat down, he looked over, seeing hundreds of eyes focused on him. Not one person could understand what had happened. He mercilessly beat his opponent to near death before walking off as if nothing had happened.
Avrin grumbled slightly, before he began to slowly draw the mana in the area to try and help replenish the dark matter he lost as he paid no more attention to them. He shut his eyes to try and rest, knowing regardless of how long he did the Draconian would still be unable to move before Avrin did.
As Avrin began to draw in the mana from the area, he decided to take the time to nap, feeling a strange urge to sleep. What welcomed him was no dream but a dark void with images flashing before his eyes.
Friends he made, friends he saw die, people he met, people that died, many images of those he killed and mercilessly tortured for information. His mind came across one memory that seemed as clear as day.
“General, why? Why would you kill so many? We could have quarantined the system…. We could have somehow found a way to save them!!” A blurry female image gazed over a young Avrin, who was sitting inside his cell, leaning against it with a calm look.
He looked at the blurry female image that soon began to clear up, revealing a young girl with shoulder length blonde hair. She had an innocent, childish look, but the tears staining her eyes and the anger mixed in made it hard to see her as a child.
She looked as if her dreams had been shattered, and something terrible had happened. As Avrin gazed at her, unable to control his actions, as if he were a silent puppet in his own body, he spoke the words he did on that day before his trial had started.
“It was an unavoidable sacrifice… Hate me as much as you want. I would do it again.” The young female wearing a similar uniform to him neared the glowing bars of the cell Avrin was in, but didn't touch them. She raised her fist as it shook with anger. Her body shaking. Causing her curves that were still clear under the uniform to shake slightly.
“HOW CAN YOU SAY THAT!?!” She called out in anger. “Y...You… You….always found a solution to every obstacle… Finding another way to handle a situation…. But you changed ever since this virus…. The only method you took was to kill anyone or anything that had it…” Avrin glanced at her and remained quiet.
The female whose tears ran down her cheek sighed quietly. “The outcome of your trial is obvious…. Goodbye…. I hope that if there is such a thing as reincarnation...you will find redemption. General… It was an honor serving as your Lieutenant…”
The female then vanished from sight, leaving Avrin feeling somewhat strange. But it was cut short as two guards appeared and neared his cell. One spoke out “Your trial is starting!” Avrin gazed at him as he didn't move.
The guard spoke but the tone was much different, causing Avrin to raise a brow. “Master? Master, are you ok?” Feeling confused, as Avrin was about to reply, everything turned black and another rush of images appeared in his head.
A deepened voice accompanied these strange images that he had never seen before, too fast for even him to properly analyze. Especially with his surprised state of mind. “Perish with your cursed Regalia!”
Avrin felt a strange sense of anger as he reached out and grabbed in front of him into the darkness, feeling something soft as he gripped onto it tightly “Argh!..” He felt a soft voice squeal, slightly in pain.
It was then that he was snapped out of his sleep, gazing with his eyes focused on the figure he was gripping the flesh of. He found his hand was clasping Kael’s neck tightly as he tried to free himself. “M...Master!!” He uttered out weakly.
Avrin immediately let go, as he stood up and placed his hand against the wall, panting slightly, as he faced the wall and raised his mask slightly as he pressed the cold metal of his gauntlet over his face.
“Kael...I...I apologize…” Kael, who rubbed his neck, looked around, seeing that no one had saw this as they had all seemed to set up a sort of place to rest with some tents blocking Kael and Avrin’s position.
“Master...are you ok?” Avrin lowered his mask, turning to look at him. “I'm fine.” Avrin looked around to see the scene that played out the chamber was now converted into a sort of base camp. But it didn't faze him significantly.
Kael nodded as he stood up. “Master, you must be hungry. Let's go eat. It's also weird here, and hard to breath….so I'm going back first.” With that said, Kael soon left, and Avrin soon felt that the mana around where he stood was nearly completely drained, and that mana from the area was flooding in to try and replenish it. But he also felt his body had healed, and he had nearly restored all the dark matter he had lost to healing.
He began to make his way towards the camp. “-Dreams… As a human, they were welcome, but as a Spectral they torment me… Those images... What could they have been? And who was that man and this ‘Regalia’ he spoke of...-”
As Avrin pondered this, he entered the campsite, which soon grew somewhat quiet as the mercenaries quickly got out of his way in fear. Clovis, who was eating a stew near the campfire, laughed as he saw Avrin. “Oh, you're awake? And you're looking as good as ever. It's going to be annoying to get those blood stains out I’d say.”
Avrin looked down at his attire seeing it was somewhat shredded and torn. But the blood had only a color of red, as the dark matter that turned it blue was long absorbed into him. With a simple thought, Nebula Mist surrounded him in a thin aura before it began to reform his attire.
As if it were now child’s play to him. Within moments, the stains and his clothing were gone and shown as brand new, as if he had never entered combat.
Avrin sat down opposite of Clovis, who was shaking his head while laughing at Avrin. “You have quite the handy magic. You should teach me some of that.” Avrin gave a soft laugh, and then looked to his side, seeing Kael offering him a bowl of meat stew.
Avrin took and thanked him, and soon Kael sat beside him and began to eat happily. “Master, that was incredible. How did you defeat the Draconian…?” Kael spoke curiously.
“Played to his weakness.” Avrin spoke with a sort of truth, as the lip area of the mask seemed to open up as the Nebula Mist slightly reshaped it, allowing Avrin to eat smoothly. Kael smiled and spoke again. “It must have been quite a weakness for you to get it in such a state.”
Avrin nodded. “Indeed. It's body was tougher than the other one. You should go take a look.” Kael frowned a little. “I would, but after you went to rest, it vanished in a portal of sorts.” Avrin blinked as he spoke “Oh? What about the hammer?”
Clovis grinned as he spoke out. “That hammer was something. It caused the beast girl to go into frenzy, as she snatched it before the portal could take the hammer too”
Avrin laughed quietly. “I see. Well, not much I can do then. I guess it's hers.” A soft voice spoke out in reply to Avrin’s words. “Oh, is that so? I'm sure it will ease Wyni’s worry than, knowing you don't want the hammer after defeating such a creature.”
Avrin turned to see Felia, who walked over, sitting beside Avrin as if expecting something from him. “The Draconian told me it's made from Unique metals. It gave me quite a problem. If anyone benefits from this dungeon so far, she is in the lead” Avrin uttered softly.
Felia grinned as she held a bowl of stew she had gotten before arriving here. “Indeed. Such a weapon would make people go crazy, but in her hands, I'm sure it will help us get through this dungeon.”
Avrin stopped eating for a moment, as he remembered the creature's words. ““-I was handpicked by the great one as the second greatest fighter next to Elder Brother!-”” Avrin frowned
“It's dangerous to venture further. Kael and I will be leaving once I recover completely…” He uttered out towards them, his worry was that he could not keep kael safe during a fight, where he would most likely need to go all out, placing kael as well as them in danger. he also had hoped this decision would influence felia to turn back as well.
---------------A.N
so regarding avrins blue blood. when writing an mc from scratch you need to know that the mc will have faults. no matter how perfect he is he will have faults. writing an mc and making him grow more intelligent is a good way to develop him and show the readers that they were there when he wasn't as good as he is currently giving the feeling that he has matured in there eyes.
to avrin when he bleeds significantly it is then that he will worry about his blood spilling he doesn't really show much worry in small amounts. on the transport vessel he felt that was a one off thing because that mage was intelligent he doesn't think much about people around him at this stage who don't seem so intelligent at most he considers they would think his blood is some sort of technique.
but as things progress he will have to be more cautious as people ask him about it as well as recycling it as you saw in the current chapter.
Moving on.
avrin fighting the draconian. yes he could augment himself and demolish it. yes he could use astaroth and demolish it. but he understands if he uses these to make up for his lack of skill with raw power or a weapon that surpasses a god then how would he grow stronger himself?. just as he taught kael a life and death situation makes one stronger he is practicing what he preaches.

Felia was the first to speak, as she had invested quite a bit into this dungeon. “What do you mean it's dangerous to venture further? Haven't you and Clovis dealt with all the threats so far?!” Avrin glanced at her through the eye sockets of the mask, gazing quietly.
“I'm sure he has his reasons. Right, Avrin?” Clovis spoke with a somewhat serious tone, while Kael dared not speak or interrupt anything. Avrin finished the last spoonful of the stew before placing the bowl down.
“That Draconian told me there is a stronger opponent here. Although I'm sure I can fight with it, I don't want to risk Kael’s safety. Half my reason for coming here, after all, is for his training.”
Felia grunted quietly. “Are you even listening to yourself, Avrin?! You come this far and you're backing out? Leave Kael with us and you do what you need. We can take care of him while you fight” Avrin listened to her. He had already considered this, but if by chance he dies, then he would be leaving Kael to die. He was certain that Draconian wouldn't let anyone get out alive after he is dealt with.
“We’ll continue ahead, and if I judge things to be too great a threat, you and your men are to take Kael outside the dungeon without waiting” Felia gave a sigh of relief. She knew that if Avrin where to leave, their battle potential would drastically decrease.
“Fine. Sounds good to me.” She let a soft smile out. “We’ll rest for a bit longer before we head off. Together, hopefully?” Avrin nodded. “It's probably for the best.” Avrin stood up and began walking off. “-If I’m to deal with another Draconian on that level, I need a way to conserve dark matter. There must be some way of achieving this-”
Making his way around the camp to his previous spot, he was met with a familiar voice. “Heya, Avrin!” Stopping to take a look, he saw Wyni with the large, menacing Legion Hammer behind her back. She had a look as if she had won the lottery. “Oh, it's you. Enjoying your new toy I see?”
Wyni couldn't help but giggle shamelessly. “This unique toy is really something. I'm sure I can do some real damage to the dragon things now. I can't wait to fight some more” She placed both her hands on her hips proudly, as her tail swayed around from behind.
“I’m sure you will get your chance.” Avrin quietly sat down cross legged, while leaning against the wall. His hands softly cupped together. Wyni rubbed her cheek and spoke. “I overheard what you and the others were talking about…. So, regarding Kael... You can leave his safety to me. As long as I’m around, not a hair on his head will be touched”
Avrin knew Wyni had feelings for Kael, but from the sound of her voice, it seemed to be deeper than just the usual love and care. “Does he really mean so much to you?” Avrin’s curiosity spoke out. Wyni immediately nodded. “Of course. He reminds me of my little brother back home.”
Tilting his head a little, Avrin felt it was something like this. “I see. Well, I leave his care in your hands than. “Wyni felt somewhat relieved. After nodding and thanking, Avrin she left, taking the hint that he needed his own time.
Meanwhile, within the depths of the dungeon, two large Draconians lay injured, while smaller draconians emitted mana around their bodies to try and heal their wounds. These two Draconians were none other than the 4 armed one as well as the agile one.
Although conscious, they decided to remain still. The 4 armed Draconian made slight grunting sounds and weird vocal sounds. The other Draconian near him, that Avrin had recently beaten, spoke. “I know! I'm going to tear that bastard to shreds… My eyes still burn from that weird magic tool he used… Big brother, are you really going to wait for him?!! Can't you go kill them all now!?... He stole my weapon!!”
A figure seemingly cloaked in some a sort of skin-like material remained seated, facing into a deep hole in the ground that was lined with crystals of all sorts of colors.
“They will enter my chamber next. When that happens, I will take responsibility for their judgment. You have shamed our kind by underestimating your opponent, and even lost such a treasured weapon. I knew the great one had spoiled you quite a bit. Reflect on your failure, Luzar”
Luzar, being the Draconian that Avrin had just defeated, stood up, shooing away some of the healers. “Brother! T...That's too far… He caught me by surprise, I had him!! That magic tool was a sneaky method… I would have defeated him!”
The figure in the distance stood up, as the skin material surrounding it shook slightly, before it began to move and extend, opening up to reveal a large bone-like structure, forming large wings. “Caught you by surprise? I was watching your fight using the control orb. You gloated so much, I’m glad he beat you silly.”
Turning around, he revealed himself to be wearing large, intricately detailed armor that radiated energy and showed his monstrous from. His face was more Draconic than the others, and gave off a powerful, ancient aura. “I'm leaving to prepare… Watch how I handle my opponent...” After speaking those words, he casually left through a dark tunnel similar to the one Avrin and the others had used.
Luzar bit his lips and slammed his fist into the ground, causing it to shake slightly. “Damn that dark magic user!! To let me lose so much face in front of big brother… I'll skin him, alive or not!!”
While the Draconians prepared for the third encounter, Avrin began to contemplate things, as he would occasionally emit a small sphere of dark matter and throw it a few meters away, only for it to light up for a moment, draw in some mana, and then vanish.
“-This is ridiculous. What am I doing wrong? Dark matter is limitless, there should be a way to use it to attack more conveniently-” Raising his gauntlet clad hand; he clenched it, causing the metal to make a quiet clanging sound.
“-My next fight won't be easy. I’ll have to be cautious. The last two opponents I could grasp an idea of their strength, but this next one, if he is indeed stronger, I will have to change my hand up a little-”
With time passing on, the mercenaries soon began to pack up their stuff. Avrin, who had continued to tinker around with his ability, stood up, somewhat satisfied with a few results. Making his way towards the door, he spoke to Clovis, who leaned against the frame.
“This next fight is going to be difficult, but the opponent is mine...” Clovis seemingly sighed. “Oh come on, you have already had two of them. Avrin blinked, before grinning under his mask. He had decided to agree and let Clovis be used to gauge the opponent's strength.
“Very well. But when you lose, I'm up next.” Clovis chuckled. “You gave in so easily? Hey, you're not using me to test him, are you?” Avrin remained silent. It seemed experts indeed thought a little alike.
As Avrin made his way to the door and pushed against it, Clovis grew a little nervous at Avrin being quiet at his question. The mercenaries under Felia and Wyni soon gathered up, with Kael in the middle section, where some elites were.
The completed group soon entered the tunnel that gave off a cold, heavy chill. Avrin gazed down, using his Divine Sense, but understood he couldn't see anything but the mana of the structure’s materials. “-And yet, this aura is so heavy. No doubt it will be interesting-”
Continuing on, the group ventured on with no trouble or Draconians appearing. Of course, this made them all feel nervous and afraid. “Why aren't they showing up anymore? Damn, this is nerve-wracking” Felia uttered while clenching the hilt of her blade.
“I bet they ran off with their tails between their legs when they found out Avrin beat two of the big ones, hah!” Wyni couldn't help but speak. Avrin and Clovis were extremely vigilant at the quiet situation. As they went on, the atmosphere grew heavier.
Avrin, having a bad feeling, spoke out. “Kael, come up here for a second.” With his voice echoing back, startling the mercenaries a little, Kael looked at Wyni, who smiled back at him, before walking off to the front where Avrin and Clovis were.
“Master, what's wrong?” Kael questioningly spoke. As they continued on, Avrin raised his hand and began to gather dark matter to form a Void Sword, taking the time to make it extremely durable and infusing it with enough energy to last at least a day.
Clovis gazed at the weapon and whistled quietly. “Conjuring weapons is a magic I heard only people on the Archmage’s level can do. No doubt you're a strange one, Avrin.” Avrin remained quiet and focused on the weapon, before he formed a short sword for Kael. The blade itself gave off a soft glow, with the surface a jet black and the edges giving off a purple glow.
The hilt itself was also the same, with the inner part jet black while the edges glowing purple. After finishing, he handed the weapon to Kael. “Keep this with you. In case something happens, use this. I'm sure even with your strength you can protect yourself better.”
Kael glanced at the Void Sword as if it were a priceless treasure. “M...Master, thank you!” A look of joy on his face as he took the weapon happily and attached it to his waist belt next to his main weapon. He then bowed to Avrin after stopping, and went off to his prior position.
Clovis smiled at Avrin. “You really are worrying about that boy so much. Don't you think it was a bad idea bringing him here?” Avrin didn't bother to lie, as his words held truth. “Indeed. It was a foolish idea, but the lesson learned will be greater with the more danger it holds”
Clovis nodded. Traversing for a full hour with no enemies, everyone was hoping a group of Draconians would appear to alleviate their nerves at least. But it wasn't until they came across a large door with glowing yellow runes on it that everyone’s breathes stopped for a few moments.
“Behind this door is no doubt a creature that is confident enough to handle us without even wearing us down with its minions.” Avrin uttered to Clovis, who in turn cracked his knuckles before walking over to the door, pressing his hands against it.
But with only a light touch, the door flung open, revealing a lit interior with a flat surface tiled with what seemed like marble. But the area itself resembled a mini arena, as large torches decorated around in a circle spanning several dozen meters.
In the far center was a Draconian seated cross legged, with a greatsword emitting a devastating aura on his back, which made Avrin feel a chill run down his spine. The pattern on the sword was of a dragon, but the blade of the sword was glowing red and yellow. Avrin had no doubt it could cut him in half if he wasn't careful.
Clovis gazed at Avrin, who seemed to be quiet. “What, you're scared of that Draconian? Ha, watch me beat the shit out of him” The Draconian who wore armor under the skin-like wing material did well to conceal his appearance as he sat down.
Soon, the mercenary group entered and surrounded their area, while Avrin and Clovis entered further in. Clovis jumped over the large torch and landed onto the torch ring as he began to stretch. “Evening lizard. It's a great day to feel my fist in your face, right?”
The Draconian quietly eyed Clovis, its face showing no change in expression. It then gazed at Avrin. “I don't want to fight you… Let me fight the other one.” Avrin remained quiet. He knew the Draconian wanted either revenge or a good challenge. Before he could reply, Clovis called out. “You think I'm not a good match for you? Try me. I guarantee I'll be more fun than Avrin over there.”
The Draconian eyed Avrin again. “So Avrin is your name? Very well, wait there for me. I'll be done quickly and you will be next.” Clovis snickered quietly, but his lips that curled into a smile soon reverted into a serious expression as he watched the draconians figure reveal.
Standing tall at nearly 4 meters, it's wings spanning at least 3 meters and it's armor radiating a powerful aura, it gave a dignified presence, both powerful and ancient in feeling. The Draconian eyed Clovis as if he were an insect.
“You still want to fight? It has been many years since I have experienced combat. Not one of my opponents has managed to leave alive…” Clovis gulped and then chuckled quietly.
A case of literary theft: this tale is not rightfully on Amazon; if you see it, report the violation.
“Then you will make a good opponent for me to grow stronger.” Clovis began to radiate flame affinity mana as he took a deep breath, his eyes glowing slightly, before the mana channeled into his fists.
The Draconian began to walk over to Clovis, not even bothering to take its weapon up. “Not going to use a weapon? Fine then. Fighting with fists is much BETTER!!” Speaking that last word, he turned into a red blur, causing the ground to shake and the flames of the torches to falter for a moment.
“First Strike!” His fist plummeted towards the Draconian’s stomach. “Hmph!” The Draconian uttered, before the fist collided with the armor, causing it to glow slightly, before Clovis’s attack was nullified completely, with only the air moving, showing the result.
“This…?... Fine then, how about this! Second Strike!” Kicking off the ground, his fist radiated a stronger fire mana, before he tried to uppercut the Draconian. “Using such weak attacks?” The Draconian moved its right hand over under its chin, catching Clovis’s fist in its own grip, completely stopping the attack.
The force of the attack shot upwards and hit the ceiling, causing some debris to fall down around them, despite much of the attack being nullified. “Hahaha… You're pretty good.” Clovis radiated fire mana around his body, causing the Draconian to cautiously let go.
Avrin watched carefully from the sidelines. “-Being able to stop Clovis’s attacks so effortlessly. Maybe that dragon is ranked at Grandmaster? No, that can't be. There has to be some trick to it. That armor, no doubt, has some boost effect, as it also nullified his attack. Hmm-” Avrin was soon snapped back to reality, as Kael spoke next to him.
“Master, that Draconian is pretty strong… Not even you could block Clovis’s attack. Is it stronger than you?” Avrin glanced at him for a moment. “Don't underestimate Clovis. I'm sure he will at least pull some miracle off.”
Kael nodded, before glancing at Clovis, whose body began to radiate mana. “I guess...my normal abilities won't work on you… The Flame Fist is something you seem to defeat easily. After fighting Avrin and seeing him take my best attack directly, I knew my fault was letting that energy spread… So I'll let you be the first to taste my revised ability”
Avrin raised a brow curiously. “Revised ability? When did he have time?” The Draconian didn't utter a word. Instead, its arms extended and its mouth opened to reveal it's fangs as it laughed. “HA HA HAHA! YOU THINK YOU CAN STILL INJURE ME?!!” The Draconian, unable to control itself, had a laughing fit.
Clovis knelt down, extending his left fist forward and drawing his right hand back, as the mana in his body circulated into a small plate-like shape in front of his right fist. The intensity and strength of the mana drew the energy from the torches, causing them to flicker around, and some going out due to having their energy taken.
Clovis continued to charge his attack for 20 seconds before he was satisfied, the plate shape condensed with flame mana radiating power that even made the Draconian narrow its eyes.
“Very well... Let's see what this attack of yours can do…”
Clovis snickered before dashing forward with movement 10 times as fast as he was during his first strike. He reached the Draconian, who gazed at Clovis with no interest.
“Fifth Strike...” He uttered quietly, before his voice picked up as his right hand plowed towards the creature's stomach again. “INFERNO SPIKE!” The mana plate shot out, before forming a large pressure that was intense enough to distort the shape and sharpen it like a constant spike.
The force of the attack caused the surroundings to blow away and heat up, but not enough to cause a full disturbance, as the attack was more focused than the Inferno Fist. The spike soon reached the Draconian’s armor, plowing against it. The Draconian snickered, before raising his right hand and radiating his own mana in it.
The increase in mana that it had gathered was intense enough to make Clovis falter for a moment, as well as Avrin narrow his eyes carefully and speak. “It’s over. Clovis has lost...” He spoke to anyone who could hear.
The Draconian’s right arm swatted the Inferno Spike, dispersing it the moment it touched it, as well as sending a shock wave from its swat towards them all. The force hit Clovis the hardest, who had depleted all his mana in the attack, hoping he could at least wear the creature down.
As the ground and area soon settled, Clovis tried to kneel, his breath heavy with sweat all over his face. “I didn't even...take a hit...and I lost?” The Draconian eyed Clovis and chuckled out. “Oh, I apologize… Let me make you feel better.”
The Draconian’s body turned into a green blur, before it appeared in front of Clovis. It then grabbed him by the neck as it began to squeeze. “Take a hit? I'm taking your life…” Clovis’s face turned pale, as he tried to free himself from its grip. There was a joyful look on its face, as if it enjoyed torturing someone before they died.
Before it got too far, a purple sphere shot between the Draconian and Clovis, which was easily dodged, as the Draconian jumped back, dropping Clovis on to the floor. The Draconian gazed at the sphere that hit a nearby torch and turned it to a dark ash, before gazing at Avrin, who had his hand extended out.
“Interfering in my fight? You dare?” Avrin began to remove his cloak as well as the enchanted sack on his side, handing them over to Kael. “Keep these with you. And don't lose that bag...” Avrin spoke to Kael carefully, who quickly nodded.
Avrin, using his Void Step, appeared next to Clovis, who was holding his throat and gasping for air. “I owe you. Thanks to your efforts, I can tell that this thing is probably a peak Grandmaster, or even an early Sage level opponent. To so easily defeat your attack... Of course, I could be wrong, and it's just really tough.”
Clovis gave a soft, weak laugh as he stood up “Y...You're welcome...” Walking away from the arena, he didn't dare get in Avrin’s way. The Draconian spoke out, as it walked until it was in front of Avrin by a full 20 meters. “You're quite perceptive… Indeed, a Grandmaster would still need to be cautious, and I have no doubt he would take damage from such an attack… But I’m a mid tier Grandmaster.”
Avrin’s eyes narrowed under the mask, fixing carefully onto the Draconian. “If you came 50 years ago… You may have had a chance. With this Dragonplate Armor, my defence is at the level of a Sage level warrior. It also comes with many more benefits.”
Avrin frowned somewhat, as he gazed carefully at the creature's armor. “That's quite nice. After I'm done with you, I think I'll take it. I know someone who would like to take it apart.” The Draconian chuckled softly, before its facial expression turned into anger in an instant.
“WORM!!!” Turning into a blur and rushing towards Avrin, it was as he expected, he couldn't take it easy. He grinned before he jumped back, revealing where his feet had just been that Nebula Mist had been siphoning down. With a quick motion, they formed a Shadow Wall that seemingly blocked him from the creature's view.
Taking the chance, he formed a Void Greatsword, before he saw the Shadow Wall shake several times. He knew the Draconian could go around, but it was as if it wanted to show Avrin its strength.
After the fifth strike, the Shadow Wall formed cracks, and then shattered, revealing the Draconian with a livid expression that soon turned to a serious manner.
“Fast!” The Draconian uttered out towards Avrin, who was a purple blur, stabbing the greatsword towards the Draconian, who sidestepped, narrowly avoiding it.
The Draconian reached up to grab the greatsword. Taking into account Luzar’s fight with Avrin, it engulfed its hand in mana only to find that the dark matter of Avrin’s greatsword was eating away at it.
“You…. How did you strengthen so quickly?” Avrin glared at the Draconian holding his Void Greatsword so easily. “It isn't nice to show all your tricks...” The Draconian’s pupils contracted, before its hand radiated earthen mana, its large claw crushing down on the greatsword, causing cracks to form.
“That's fine… You're only a little faster than Luzar...” Avrin decided he would use all he could to defeat this opponent while still only using what was needed. As the Draconian showed no signs of letting go of the greatsword, Avrin willed the hilt to detach from it.
While grasping it in his right hand, he spun around, all the while the hilt reformed into a void sphere. By the time he had spun to look at the Draconian, he pressed the void sphere towards its head.
The Draconian was, by all means, not slow, with its combat skills honed, it had already raised its left hand to grab the void sphere. “You dare use such foul magic on me?” The Draconian’s right leg turned into a blur before it kicked towards Avrin’s side.
No longer taking things slow, Avrin’s left hand gathered dark matter, before it moved down between his side and the Draconian’s leg, forming a dark matter shell-like shield. The force of the attack caused the shield to shatter and crush against Avrin’s arm, who was blown away several dozen meters.
Avrin winced in pain as he raised his left arm that was now broken. “-Is he toying with me?-” Avrin though while forcing his left arm to straighten, willing dark matter to flow in it, dulling out the pain while fixing it.
Kael looked up at the scene happening. “Something’s wrong…” Clovis, who was seated down and trying to recover, spoke. “I agree… It's toying with him, obviously.” Felia glanced at Avrin worryingly, before gazing at Kael, remembering Avrin’s words to escape if things got too bad.
The Draconian chuckled a little and glanced at Avrin. “Weak rodent… But I can see how you defeated Luzar. You’re about equal to him in speed, but he had the advantage in strength.” It began to walk towards Avrin.
As it did, a soft chuckle echoed around the room. “Ha...haha….hahahahahaha!” Gazing towards the source everyone looked at Avrin with confusion. “Master?” Kael asked in confusion.
The Draconian’s eyes focused on Avrin, as it stood a meter away from him. It felt something was wrong, as a strange aura emitted from him. “When I first used this ability, the effect was incomplete and unrefined. But as I grew stronger and used it in my free time while hidden away, I found that it's not so simple… In fact, it has quite a few benefits...”
Dark matter began to surge around Avrin, forming inch wide lines under his clothing, until it engulfed his entire body. The lines themselves were made from dark matter that glowed with a fierce energy.
Avrin’s mask began to distort slightly, before it turned to ash, revealing Avrin’s face with his blue pupils fixed onto the Draconian. The lines of dark matter were moving around his face as if alive. His skin began to darken a little, and his pupils began to turn a darker color. He reached up to lower the hood that was attached to his current top, revealing his long silvery hair as well as he's Elf-like ears.
The Draconian felt a little worry as it looked at Avrin, who seemed somewhat demonic. “Demon… I guess that explains your strength.” Felia gazed, only seeing Avrin’s pointed ears as well as he's long hair. She was deathly curious about Avrin’s appearance, but it was drowned out by the fact that she wondered what was going on and why a dark energy she couldn't sense emitted from him.
Clovis glanced and whistled with interest. “A trump card. Interesting…” Kael looked at Clovis and then at Avrin, who gave off that glow of energy. The surrounding mercs watched with curiosity and fascination.
“-This form should be easier to control than completely transforming-” The Draconian’s fists soon blurred as they punched towards Avrin’s face. Avrin could see the Draconian move more clearly, despite it still being incredibly fast. He moved his body a little, as the creature's shot passed where his head had been.
Avrin didn't waste a movement, raising both his hands. One against the wrist of the Draconian, the other along its arm, as he gazed at it with focus. “The good thing about this form is… I can gather what I need much faster.” The mana around the armor section of the Draconian’s wrist guards began to twist and shake, as it was soon covered by a thin layer of dark matter that began to spread quickly.
The Draconian, seeing that the mana infused within its armor was being devoured, quickly retracted its arm before slashing its right claw towards Avrin. Gazing at it, Avrin felt somewhat nervous, quickly bending his body back.
His body’s flexibility allowed him to avoid the claw that shook with incredible power, that made the air blast in the claws trajectory, causing blades of wind to smash against the wall.
Avrin looked up to see the Draconian recovering quicker than him. It punched downwards with its retracted hand trying to pummel him into ground. “-To think of attacking like this so quickly. I can see why he has beaten so many opponents...-” Avrin thought, before dark matter gathered much faster in his hands.
He purposely let himself fall against the floor, while the dark matter formed a thick shadow wall out of it, managing to block the attack of the Draconian.P.S Mancers grimoire will be released later today ----------P.S im expecting a bit of loopholes or lines that don't make sense that may have slipped through if you find any please pm me or post them here. also the pace of the dungeon is going to go a bit faster as to not get boring but il try my best to keep it as interesting and detailed as i can.

Despite blocking one blow, the force of the punch sent a small shock wave that was felt throughout the entire room, causing everyone watching to take a step back after. They were lucky enough to not be on the side that the wind blades had shot towards.
“Everyone, step back!” Felia called out as they retreated back several dozen meters. “-Avrin, can you really defeat that monster?-” Felia reluctantly thought in her head. Avrin didn't hesitate to act after blocking that fist. He knew that if it got him down like it's brother had, it would be devastating for him.
Emitting Nebula Mist into the area from his body, the Draconian was already preparing to strike again, pressing it's hands together and smashing towards Avrin. “Shadow Pillar!” He uttered out, using the Nebula Mist to form a Shadow Pillar in front of him that shot towards the Draconian.
With the two forces colliding, the Shadow Pillar cracked and shattered, but it negated the attack as the room shook again from the force of the attack of the Draconian. Avrin quickly gained his balance and jumped out, not hesitating to gather more Nebula Mist from the mana around him.
“-Not good. I can only barely hold off against him with this form-” The Draconian stood up and laughed. “I'm having a lot of fun, demon… Entertain me a little bit more..” Avrin’s face darkened a little. “-No choice… This is something I have no hand in-”
The space around Avrin distorted slightly, as strange glowing balls of light in all sorts of colors were seemingly ripped out of thin air. The Draconian’s eyes gazed with caution.
“-How is he utilizing mana in such a way?.. Is he a mage of sorts? What dark magic is he using?-” Unsure of what Avrin was doing, the Draconian dashed towards him, it's large, beast-like foot crushing the ground underneath it as it made a dash towards him.
“Grn!...” Avrin felt a slight change in his body, as his skin darkened even more while his body seemed to change and grow a little while his fingers grew claw-like nails, his hair turning from silver to a deep purple as dark matter coursed through it.
“-W..Why does it hurt… Haven't I used this before?..-” Avrin thought, coughing slightly. Unaware that the reason he was experiencing pain was due to his particles evolving, and changing his form had also changed and grew stronger than his past form, requiring his body to get used to it again.
“-Still...I can still go further, but..-” Gazing at the Draconian, who seemed to slow down enough for Avrin to see it clearly, he grinned before he dashed with frightening speed toward the Draconian, before his hand skimmed across the air as if he had tore into space. He grabbed a handful of darkened Nebula Mist before smashing towards the Draconian’s fist with his own.
The force of the attack caused Avrin to blow back several dozen meters, as his bones shook significantly. He felt his organs ripple somewhat. The Draconian, who was blown back 2 meters, felt it's fist was quite sore. It looked at Avrin with shock.
“-This power?...How did he get so strong?... What dangerous magic… I should finish him-” Clovis stood, up watching it all happen. “Incredible… Was… Was he holding back against me?…. Just how strong is he?...”
Kael watched with a wide smile on his face. “Master Avrin is incredible… I'm sure he can defeat the Draconian..” Felia, although happy that Avrin was putting up a better fight against the Draconian, was still worried inwardly. “-Could he have really been a demon?...-”
The Draconian gazed at it's sore fist and laughed quietly. “You're quite surprising…. Yet you are only worthy enough for me to show you my abilities..” The Draconian’s body soon radiated a yellow glow, before it punched its fist into the ground, causing a large chunk to churn towards Avrin at a rapid speed.
“Tsk..” Skimming his hands against the air, distorting space and pulling out another handful of the darkened Nebula Mist, he dropped it all onto the ground before a jet black Shadow Wall formed in an instant, blocking the attack. But only for several moments, before it shattered.
“-Still?... Still not enough?.. Just how powerful is it..?-” Avrin showed an expression of shock. He looked to see the Draconian had vanished from sight. “-It was there a mome--” Avrin felt an intense pain, as his body shook. He turned to his side and saw a large gauntlet engulfed fist crushing against his side.
Avrin was blown away, his body skimming against the floor, before he hit a torch, knocking it down and then stopping, as his body stopped not too far from the wall. He gasped for air as he wheezed in pain, coughing up a mouthful of purplish blood that began to eat away at the ground as soon as it landed on the surface.
“-How..did he get so fast?..-” Avrin raised his hand quickly, reabsorbing the dark matter, that was a significant portion of his blood, enough to cause it to turn purple, showing just how much dark matter was currently infused in him.
The Draconian stood where Avrin had just been, it's legs glowing a bright yellow. “This skill is called Earth Distortion. It allows me to travel much quicker when I'm on an earthen surface, using the mana that makes up the land as a boost”
Avrin forced himself up, feeling his wound had already started to heal. He wiped off the trail of blood that had turned red due to the dark matter being removed from it. “-Indeed. It would of been weird if he didn't have any skills and focused on just raw strength. I should be careful..-”
The Draconian soon turned into a blur, with only a streak of glowing yellow light shooting towards Avrin. Raising his hand to forcefully grab the mana in the air and convert it to dark matter, he  opened his palm as a purple light shot from it, forming several dozen Void Spheres that floated like droplets in the air.
He willed them to encircle him as a sort of defence, barely managing in time, as the Draconian appeared right on the outside of the sphere’s radius. Wasting no time, it swatted it's hand that had already been engulfed in mana, for safety, against Avrin’s dark matter.
The Void Sphere exploded, covering the hand of the Draconian in dark matter, stopping him in his tracks as he jumped back to fight it off. “You little…” Avrin snickered inwardly, before pointing his right hand towards the Draconian, all the Void Spheres firing towards it.
The Draconian grinned. Being a Grandmaster, it was not a fool, and had set Avrin up and played him. It's mana surged, easily removing the coating of dark matter, before it turned into a yellow blur again, appearing above Avrin.
“Shit.” Looking up, he grabbed 2 more handfuls of darkened Nebula Mist, causing the room to lower in temperature slightly. “Earth Vice.” The yellow mana from it's hands shot around Avrin, who quickly looked around, as he was trapped within it's glow.
The light didn't stop, as it caused the earth around Avrin to churn, before shooting upwards, forming a pillar made of air that soon hardened, capturing Avrin within. The Draconian landed beside the pillar and chuckled lightly.
“You were caught so easily?.. With only that earth magic?” Inside the pillar, Avrin sighed in relief. He had used the Nebula Mist he had already to engulf himself and eat away at the earth that tried to pierce upward and crush him, creating a small hole for him. “-He’s still toying with me?...-” Feeling a tinge of anger, a vein appeared on Avrin’s head, as dark matter began to gush out of him.
The earth pillar that spanned a 10x10 circular shape began to change in color, as dark matter began to devour it and siphon it's energy to Avrin. The Draconian’s instincts kicked in, as it quickly  used it's wings to blow forward, jumping back just in time as a purple light shot towards where it had just been, turning the area to ash and melting downwards.
The Draconian glared. “How dare you…. You even try to damage the inner sanctum!” The earth pillar soon crumbled to reveal a jet black humanoid figure with rough, alien-like skin. It's hands were large and claw-like, with the claws themselves glowing purple.
The creature's body began to glow purple as it turned towards the Draconian it's now full purple hair swaying slightly. “-S..Shit, I can barely...control my consciousness… I knew it was bad to push further...but….a field test is nice…-”
The Draconian suddenly grew somewhat nervous as it gazed at Avrin in his proper augmented form. “A demon indeed… Only your kind could use such vile magic on themselves…” Avrin felt a surge of pain in his body as he gazed at the Draconian.
“Please….die..” He spoke with no real hint of care in his words. He turned into a purple blur, before appearing near the Draconian, who gasped at the sudden change. “-Indeed. Just like before, much faster…. As much as me now..-” Raising his hand, the Draconian punched towards Avrin.
Avrin’s claw like hand swatted against the Draconian’s fist, changing its trajectory to smash downwards. “-WHAT!?-” Avrin gazed at the shocked creature, before his body spun in mid air, his right leg smashing against the creature's head.
“!!” The creature felt a blunt pain, as it was caught off guard by Avrin easily hitting it's fist away with his claw. The Draconian’s body spun in mid air, before it smashed against the ground a few meters away.
Avrin landed softly on the ground as he spoke out, his voice somewhat ghostly. “I...may look like a monster...but I...can still think...and use martial skills… Your reaction time is no different to mine...meaning when it comes to hand to hand combat...you're no match for me..”
The Draconian stood up, as it placed its large scaled hand on it's face, before moving it to see that it was covered in green blood. It began to laugh at the sight, as well as Avrin’s words. “Martial skills?... Lets see how far that gets you with this!!”
The creature's hands smashed into the ground as it channeled it's mana into it. A large section of the earth was easily pulled out, and then thrown towards Avrin as if the weight itself didn't matter.
“A primitive attack won't work on me..” Raising his hand, darkened Nebula Mist was forced out of the air, forming into a sphere in Avrin’s hands, before he fired off the jet black sphere towards the chunk of earth.
As soon as it touched the sphere, the entire chunk turned black and turned to ash in mid air, but the attack’s result wasn't what had just changed Avrin’s expression.
Behind the chunk that blocked the Draconian from view, it now revealed that the Draconian’s mouth was open as a yellow light formed in it's mouth. “Terror Burst?!” Avrin uttered out in surprise, since he experienced Luzar’s attack.
“-With enough strength to turn this room into rubble… Planning on taking us all in one go? I won't let you!-” Avrin knew that if he didn't find a way to stop the attack, even if he dodged it, the direction of the attack would be close enough to kill anyone within range of the explosion, and most likely injure Avrin.
Avrin quickly willed both his hands to grab darkened Nebula Mist from the air, as the room shuddered, some spaces distorting with the lack of mana, as if the fabric that made them had come undone. Some parts turned to ash without even coming into contact with dark matter.
“Terror Burst!” The Draconian shouted, before firing a blinding beam of light that roared and shook the dungeon itself, causing the earth to split and the wind to flee from it's path. Avrin pressed the two focused darkened spheres of Nebula Mist together, before he formed a dark purple shield that emitted dark matter.
“-Not enough time to complete it!-” He quickly thrust the shield forward, just in time for it to connect with the Terror Burst. The shield began to crack slowly. Avrin leaned forward, using his boots to press into the ground to gain leverage, while his shoulder pushed against the shield.
“-It can't be helped… Not enough time-” On the other side of the Terror Burst, the Draconian that channeled it started to feel somewhat exhausted, as the Terror Burst took an immense amount of mana. “-Argh.. I even have to tap into my armor’s storage reserve-”
Avrin moved his left hand outward as he began to gather darkened Nebula Mist to channel into the Void Shield he had formed to combat the Terror Burst. “-Perfect.. It's barely keeping up with the cracks that are forming-”
Looking past the light of the beam that was somewhat blinding, Avrin snickered. “Hey lizard!.. You won't get anywhere with this attack!” The Draconian knew something was off after Avrin had spoken those words, and soon stopped its attack, as it's mouth emitted a yellow smoke.
“Hmph… Strong indeed.. I should have killed you when I had the chance… But that form of yours surely will not be without rebound” Avrin’s eyes narrowed “-He’s right. I'll be lucky if I'm not crippled after this… I have to end it-”
The Draconian jumped into the air, before it landed back on the ground, inside the damaged arena. “Look what you made me do...destroy my chamber.. The great one will not be pleased..” He spoke while walking towards his greatsword.
“You are worthy enough for me to use my full power… Feel honored, demon.” Avrin glanced at the Draconian. He didn't bother to wait, as he charged towards it. “Honored? Go to hell!” Appearing next to it, the Draconian grinned before pulling the sword out of the ground. A flood of mana circulated around it and himself.
“This isn't good..” Avrin quickly felt his decision was bad, as he moved the Void Shield in front of him. The Draconian raised the greatsword that gave off an ominous aura, before slashing downwards towards Avrin’s shield.”
The earth under Avrin split apart, as a wave of yellow light soon cut his shield in half and slashed against his body, causing purple blood to gush out. “Ahh!..” He uttered in pain, barely able to keep his senses. He willed the dark matter in the blood towards him to help seal the deep wound.
Avrin immediately jumped back, while cautiously gazing at the Draconian, who looked at him in fascination. “Your blood, just now...it went from purple to red… Interesting.. Is this some sort of magic?... Is that how you heal yourself?.. It must be evil indeed… Your god, Zephioron, is truly vile… To bestow such things..”
Avrin placed his hand over his wound, feeling it sting, as the mana that remained was eaten by his own dark matter. “-That thing would have cut me in half if I didn't have that shield-” The Draconian raised the greatsword, as the wind seemingly howled at it's movement.
“As a token of appreciation for the great Fafnir, to the great one giving him materials to make the Dwarven works of architecture. Fafnir bestowed this blade formed from his and the Great One’s mana, as well as the unique earth metal Golemite, and the wind metal Arferium. Durability and magic amplification for earth magic… And this!”
Slashing the blade towards Avrin, another air wave infused with earth mana skimmed across the ground, splitting it and crashing against the wall, as Avrin dashed to the side, barely in the nick of time. “-It's fast?..-”
The Draconian gazed at Avrin. “I bet you are asking yourself… ‘How is such an attack so fast?’... It is unimpeded by earth, and the wind metal Arferium allows any melee attack with this greatsword to triple in speed. A perfect weapon..”
The Draconian dashed towards Avrin, who was already gathering dark Nebula Mist and firing off void spheres towards him rapidly. The Draconian laughed and began to cut the spheres in half, not worrying about them, as the mana in the sword destroyed any dark matter that tried to stick to it.
