With a thought, Phantom Pulse shot towards the ring of light, making it quiver and shatter. Avrin gazed carefully at the two of them. “-Thankfully, I’ve confirmed that he has Skymetal with him. Both of them are quite careful. That Abbadon is intelligent, to have set this up. Though it was unavoidable and not a loss. I think it's fine to have this resolved at this time-”
Gazing at Avrin with awe, Abbadon smirked. “Magic to do with weight, and undetectable no doubt. This is a concealment spell of Driadas, I will have to pay her another visit and question her carefully.. This is most likely her doing.”
Abbadon was not going to take this lightly. He quickly raised his right hand and the greatsword Sigil weapon Twilight appeared in them.
He vanished with speed even faster than Leo’s. By wielding the Sigil weapon, his base strength increased, so when he appeared behind Avrin and kicked towards him, the air rippled and trembled.
Of course, Avrin, who was no longer holding back, had already used a Void Step to reappear several dozen meters away. The kick continued and shot the force to where leo was standing.
Of course, with Aegis, the force of the kick was easily negated. Leo was still conflicted with the issue, though. Avrin’s speed was incredible, even Abbadon was astonished. It was as if he teleported, but they knew teleportation required a chant.
“Impossible…” Abbadon spoke and turned to Avrin. “Just who are you?” He was quite interested now. “Me?” Avrin snickered before his form began to distort and change. He reverted to his original appearance.
“-If they join forces, I'm going to be in big trouble. I have to end this quickly-” Around Avrin, Nebula Mist surged before forming into hundreds of void spheres that were much stronger than the ones he shot at Leo. The spheres were like flashes of lightning. Even Abbadon dared not touch one with his bare hands.
Both him and Leo quickly used their respective weapons to block. Avrin was not dumb though. He didn't want this fight to start, so he used the time they gave him by defending to appear before Leo. Avrin snickered a little.
“Demon! You're truly a demon!!” Leo roared as he brandished Aegis. “LION’S BREAK!” The shield emitted a heavy light before he bashed it at Avrin. Lion’s Break was a skill that used the protective shield as an offensive counter. The bubble would collect at the front of the shield and with all his might Leo would smash it towards his opponent.
“Leo, wait!!” Abbadon roared. He knew that this attack would be dangerous to use underground. But it was too late, as a radiant pillar of light shot towards Avrin. Of course, Avrin, who was prepared, already retrieved Astaroth before laughing menacingly.
“Stygian Slash!” Avrin called out before Astaroth screeched with excitement. It emitted a dark light before releasing a crescent slash that collided with the pillar of light from Aegis. The Lion’s Break trembled before it was split. The energy from it was absorbed by the Stygian Slash and it zoomed towards Aegis.
Leo clenched his teeth and quickly tried to hold his guard. With Aegis being a Sigil weapon, it contains immense power, meaning the Lion’s Break didn't use much of it, so when the Stygian Slash collided with it, it felt like a meteor had hit him. He was being pushed back and the slash itself grew stronger and stronger as it absorbed the mana from it's surroundings.
This was a weapon formed by the energy and bodies of two gods. It was immeasurable when compared to Sigil weapons. It smashed against Aegis before splitting the shield in half, and cutting off Leo’s left arm.
It happened very quickly and Abbadon was left with his mouth open in astonishment, while Leo was speechless. Avrin knew the result would be.
There was no comparison, so with this thought in mind, Avrin rushed towards the astonished Leo, who had never in his life been so injured before. Avrin grabbed Leo’s severed arm and snickered. He held it up and grabbed the ring on the finger before throwing the arm away.
Leo finally came to his senses as anger rose in his heart. He rushed towards Avrin with all his speed, causing Avrin to be surprised.
“DIE!” He roared at Avrin, before slashing with Caliburn using all the might. The slash cut across the ceiling and ground as a wave of energy shot towards Avrin, who slashed it casually with Astaroth, causing the energy slash created by Caliburn to shatter.
Abbadon vanished and appeared behind Avrin and attacked with Twilight. As the space distorted slightly, Avrin narrowed his eyes and used Phantom Pulse to push the weapon away. But with its strength, it only bought him a second. But it was enough for him to use his Void Step to appear at least fifty meters away. Avrin broke out in a cold sweat.
“-Just what in the hell is going on?! How is this possible? He actually split Aegis in half! This…. Is he a servant of Zephiron or an individual from beyond Seleria?!!-” Abbadon was trying to figure out what was going on. While he did, Leo knelt down in shock and didn't spare a glance at his arm, but at Aegis.
“Im...Impossible… It’s not easy to destroy Aegis…” Leo saw Aegis leaking mana and trembling. Avrin also noticed this and narrowed his eyes. “-These fools…. My circumstances are much more apparent than you think-” Avrin referred to his potential as well as the weapon he wielded.
“You're truly a monster…. I am not sure what spawned you and how you wield that weapon, but I know of one thing. It doesn't belong in this world, and neither do you.” Abbadon reached into his pocket and pulled out a small, glowing piece of round glass.
Avrin didn't want to wait while this happened, so as Abbadon was occupied with this, Avrin Void Stepped next to Leo before kicking at him. Leo grunted in anger and raised Caliburn to block it. Avrin’s physical strength was not stronger than Leo’s, so when Leo was hit he was only pushed back half a step.
But it was enough for Avrin to put away Astaroth and grab the two halves of Aegis before glancing at Leo, who looked at him. “You...bastard! How dare you try to steal Aegis!!”
Avrin snickered and spoke, “I will take good care of it.” Avrin smirked and used Void Step to escape from the underground. The moment Avrin vanished and turned into ash, Abbadon quickly threw the round glass towards the ash. When it hit where Avrin was, the glass seemingly absorbed some of the remaining dark matter.
Inside the sphere that fell to the ground was a swirling mist of dark matter. Leo glanced in anger as he looked up and roared with all his might in anger, “DAMN HIM!!!! MY AEGIS, MY STORAGE RING!!!”
Abbadon remained calm as he walked over and picked up the small glass sphere. He glanced at it with curiosity. “We both underestimated him. He got us before we could even begin… In the end, he reaped benefits… Where is the Skymetal anyway?” Abbadon spoke curiously.
Leo, who held the bleeding stump of his arm, spoke with annoyance. “In my ring… He has it now.” Hearing this, Abbadon’s expression dropped. “What a shame. That ore was truly strange. Though do not feel wronged.
Given enough time, once I analyze this strange magic, I am sure I can not only develop a spell to counter him, but to track him down. In the meantime, I'm sure you know how to handle the situation. Keep things quiet.”
Leo, whose face was pale with regret, nodded. Avrin’s physical strength was not a match for him, yet despite this, he was caught off guard by the weapon Avrin wielded. “That scythe he had… Just what was it?” Leo spoke softly.
Abbadon added, “Indeed. It's a serious matter. I felt that weapon was indeed weird. It gave me the same fee-” Abbadon suddenly went quiet as he thought to himself, “-That weapon, it gave off the feeling same feeling as Leo’s Skymetal did.
Could it be.. No, impossible. You can't forge it. But if he has a way to forge it and manages to acquire another weapon or some defensive object...just how powerful would he be!”
Abbadon clenched his teeth before light engulfed him. “I'm leaving. Tend to your wounds and speak of this to no one!” Abbadon ordered. This made Leo frown. Abbadon left and he was alone/ With his remaining arm, he madly punched the ground, causing it to shake and crack.
“I let my guard down and was defeated by someone weaker than me!!!!! RAGRRGH!!” He roared in anger, clearly not used to losing.
Meanwhile, Avrin was quite far away from the capital. He had a smirk on his face. He was currently within the eastern section of the central continent. He had plenty of time before he had to go meet Azrael. Though Abbadon probably felt he was a demon and would no doubt search that place.
He also didn't want to go to the elven continent again and possibly see Syrana or Myra. He also didn't want to go to the north and potentially put his people in danger, meaning his only option was to head to the eastern continent and train there for some time.
Avrin was disappearing and reappearing. It was as if he were skipping across the entirety of the central continent. He suddenly appeared over a vast ocean before disappearing again. This time, there was a small island near where he appeared, but he vanished again.
After continuing for a while longer, he appeared on the shore of the eastern continent Ji’Kunda. The area was quite desolate. It was like a miniature desert wasteland filled with mountains and the occasional oasis. Avrin teleported to the top of one of the large, rocky hills. He spotted a small indentation that was like a miniature cave. It was enough for him to sit in quietly, as no one was within several miles of him.
He quickly retrieved the two pieces of Aegis from his left hand and watched as they continuously leaked mana. He engulfed both pieces in nebula mist and snickered as he managed to contain the mana.
“These weapons, maybe it is possible to form a dark matter core from them. Since they are no longer useful and are just leaking mana, it's best to salvage what I can.”
Avrin shut his eyes and began to focus on the process at hand. From today onwards, he would do his best to improve his strength. The next time he meets Abbadon or Leo he would surely be able to suppress them without resorting to such low tactics.
The story has been stolen; if detected on Amazon, report the violation.
In the end, it was Astaroth that allowed him to obtain such a victory. Knowing this, Avrin was disappointed. He didn't want to rely on the weapon too much. He wanted to improve himself.
Thus, if he could absorb a dark matter core formed by this broken Sigil weapon, it would no doubt give him some great benefits, so he quietly focused on his the task at hand. He felt it would take at least a hour hour to process the Sigil weapon.
It was already broken and was basically a large mass of mana. He was quite careful and wanted to do this quickly. It previously leaked mana out from before and he felt maybe Abbadon could use it to track him, so after he was done here he would disappear again.
Avrin also had a regret. He wanted to investigate Ophelia’s uncle, but it seems that arranged appointment would not happen. “-Dark matter.. For him to be able to use it, he is no doubt someone suspicious.
For now, I'll bide my time. It doesn't seem like he intends to make a show of himself just yet-” Prior to his death, Avrin had read a few books regarding martial artists who isolated themselves in mountain caves for extended periods of time to seek some sort of enlightenment. Although he was different in this regard, what he sought was power he knew he could obtain.
Time passed and a full two hours had gone by. Avrin had an annoyed expression on his face, “-Two hours. This shield took longer to convert than I had thought, but it was unavoidable. I would have loved to have stolen it without cutting it in half-” Avrin grinned before a small yellow and purplish bead drifted down from the Nebula Mist and landed in his right hand.
Avrin gazed at it, able to tell that the dark matter contained within this bead was incredibly plentiful. He quickly opened his mouth and tossed it in.
As soon as the bead went down his throat and made its way to his stomach, it exploded with dark matter, causing Avrin to twitch and shake for a moment. But like a defense measure, his dark matter heart began sucking it in.
Like a black hole, not one bit of this new foreign dark matter escaped, it was all absorbed into Avrin’s heart. When this occurred, Avrin felt strange. His body began to tense up and shift.
His bones felt as if they were becoming harder, his skin more durable, his blood more condensed. Everything, inside and out, felt like it was evolving and strengthening. Avrin was a little surprised. He had no idea how to do this on a smaller scale. It seemed as if his dark matter heart was capable of achieving this once it absorbed a certain amount of dark matter to act as fuel for this advancement.
After few minutes passed, Avrin felt ecstatic with the results. With just that one bead, he had already doubled his strength. He considered his physical power to be on par with a mid level Sage, but with the absorption of a Sigil weapon’s power, he had skyrocketed and felt that his physical strength could easily equal that of a Legendary level being. Avrin had no doubt that he would be able to match Leo’s full strength.
Avrin knew that with the strengthening of his body, his skills would become stronger. The most useful one, of course, was Phantom Pulse. He was eager to try it. But he ignored it, as something else took precedence over testing Phantom Pulse.
Avrin quickly rummaged about in his enchanted sack before pulling out a gold and silver ring with several gems on it. This was the storage ring Avrin had stolen from Leo Zircus. He gazed at it with fascination, wondering how it worked.
Another four hours had passed and Avrin’s expression was livid as he gazed at the ring as if it had done him the worst harm in his life. “ Is it broken? I can't access it at all!“ Avrin was very annoyed.
Avrin took a deep breath and considered it. “This ring is different to the enchanted bag which remains constant. I will consider there is a method to open it, no doubt it has something to do with mana. I don't have any of that, nor am I able to replicate it.”
Standing up, Avrin stored the ring in his enchanted bag and extended his strengthened Divine Sense. When Avrin had first achieved it, it was only a maximum fifty miles, and that was when he was focusing on nothing but channeling it.
As time progressed and Avrin strengthened, including the current state he was in, if Avrin was to stay and focus on emitting his Divine Sense, his range was increased by seven-hundred miles, a total of three-hundred more before he had taken the dark matter core converted from Aegis.
His body quivered in excitement. He know he was steadily making progress. It was only a matter of time before he would achieve a point where not even the gods of Seleria could threaten him. Only then would he feel safe.
Avrin was scanning around. Several miles from him, he felt a few villages. The strange thing, though, was that these were not human villages, but belonged to the beastmen tribe. With a strengthened mind and Divine Sense, Avrin was able to view his surroundings in better detail.
It hadn't taken long before Avrin spotted what he was after, a large, city with high wooden and stone palisade walls. Inside this certain city were many people going and coming. Of course, only a handful seemed to be human and elvish. The rest were all beastmen.
Avrin was after something. He spotted the trade district. His best bet would be to find someone knowledgeable in storage rings or who had a general idea of how to open them. He assumed the ring was incredibly valuable, as he had never seen it before. He had to be careful and made sure no one caused trouble for him.
When it came to movement, with Avrin’s Divine Step, he had confidence that unless someone was at the level of a god they couldn't even dream of matching his speed. Avrin truly wished to progress the Divine Step.
It wasn't something he could use in battle as he pleased just yet. It required him to remain still for a moment and let his guard down to break down his body and reform it. Avrin had guessed this was its restriction.
With his body turning into a purplish ash, Avrin vanished before reappearing inside a narrow alley where several empty crates and barrels were stored. Avrin placed his hood over his face as he exited the alley and entered the busy street. He looked around with curiosity.
He could see many beastmen tending to their own matters, some with rabbit ears and with visible differences on their faces, others who seemed more beast than man, like large, bulky bear-looking people with fur all over their bodies as they hulked around with large construction beams.
Avrin felt Asura would love it here, as he would fit right in. The beastmen tribe could be considered humanity's hated enemy by word. The war before Tiamat destroyed the first Great Empire’s capital, humanity had invaded the eastern continent in an attempt to destroy and enslave the beastmen out of fear.
Avrin felt this was stupid in all regards. You would enslave and destroy a race because you fear they would enslave and destroy you. The very thought of this was hypocritical. Avrin assumed the previous emperor wasn't that dumb, and most likely had a hidden agenda.
Regardless of this, Avrin made his way over. He was inside the trade district, and as one would expect, there were many different varieties of shops. Mainly blacksmiths that sold large weapons. It was rare to see a fragile small weapon.
Avrin assumed with the beastmen's innate physical strength they would take advantage and use only heavy weapons to defeat their enemies. Avrin remembered Wyni. Although she looked fragile, she could wield a heavy weapon with ease.
Spending just over a minute getting used to the surroundings. The time of day seemed to be nearing evening, so Avrin didn't waste any more time and headed towards what seemed like the only magic shop around.
Entering it, Avrin felt the mana in the air was a bit more dense due to his body’s innate ability to absorb some mana to feed and sustain it for good. Looking around, Avrin spotted a variety of magical items, from strange looking tomes to long, twin staves and wands.
Avrin had even noticed an alchemical pill furnace inscribed with strange markings and an elixir pot with similar markings. Although Avrin knew these were useless to him, he had his own alchemical chalice he wanted to tinker with when he had less things to do.
The reason why Avrin hadn't bothered with alchemy as of late was because with the dark matter cores he could constantly strengthen himself. He also knew that alchemy required time and patience, and right now, with Avrin wanting to grow stronger and protect his people, it wasn't time that he was willing to waste just yet.
“Hm? How can I help you?” A short man called out. Surprisingly, the man looked like a fat komodo dragon. It made Avrin cringe inwardly at the ugly creature. Avrin smiled and spoke. “I wanted to inquire if you happen to have information about this item I found within a dungeon.”
Avrin reached into his enchanted sac and pulled out the ring before placing it onto the counter. He didn't know the proper name of the ring and didn't want to arouse suspicion. The lizard man put on a sort of monocle as he picked up the ring and glanced at it carefully.
Only after several minutes did the lizard's eyes widen and his body begin to shake. “S..Spacial Ring! H..How did you get this!?!” He hissed as if he wanted to roar, but it seemed his vocal cords were unable to do so.
“I obtained it from the lair of a dangerous creature.” Avrin gave a simple answer. The lizard man gulped and cleared his throat as he replied. “This is a Spacial Ring. Compared to items such as the enchanted back, enchanted chest and enchanted quiver, these Spacial Rings are specially made by an ancient Enigma ability user who had an ability to bend and distort space.
This individual was famous and was known as the Craftsman Lupin. Not only were his Spacial Rings crafted for people of the highest ranks in society, but enchanted storage items are modeled after these.
Only a handful of these rings were made before Lupin disappeared and was never heard from again. Rumors say he somehow managed to reach an understanding even beyond creating Spacial Rings and was able to travel to a different world! Though rumors are as I said, rumors.”
Avrin glanced at the ring with even more interest. He didn't think it would hold such a history. First an alchemist Enigma ability wielder and then one capable of using a spacial control to create such objects. Enigma users were truly remarkable.
“That is fine and all, but how do I open it?” Avrin curiously spoke. The lizard man chuckled and replied, “Give me a second.” The lizard placed the ring on the counter and walked into the back of the shop before coming back with a heavy book that he was skimming through.
“According to this item codex, to access a spacial ring, one must have a mana level equal to that of a grandmaster. This is to stop lowly thieves from stealing it, as well as to show of social standing that only high leveled individuals could obtain this.”
Avrin reached over with a frown as he picked up the spacial ring. “-Perfect,...well it can't be helped, when i go to the demon continent i'll have Azrael open it for me.-”
Avrin thought for a moment before gazing at the lizard and waving his hand, the nebula mist grabbed a few gold coins from his enchanted sack before placing it onto the counter.
“Thank you, i will be leaving now, i prefer if you keep this matter quiet.” Knowing that he had such a rare object, many people would be interested in coming after him. And if rumors got out far enough there was a chance that Abbadon or even leo would find out and chase him here.
“Esteemed customer please hold your steps for a moment!.” the lizard man called out to avrin before he had truly left the store.-----------------

chapters.title: V4: Chapter 113 Miserable Kirin.
chapters.content:
Firstly i wanted to thank all the people who pmed me, offering to become Temporary pr's and i apologize that i wasnt able to respond to all of you, i was quite overwhelmed by the responses but im honored to have such dedicated fans of my story.This chapter was pred by Dragonofsomesort & pwninator, Im unable to enter their profiles and link it to their names so please consider going through a bit of effort and giving them some rep for helping to  pr this chapter. Special thanks to SR's DonatorsTobias Klauke for sponsoring this release ! sorry about the bit of a late release, i had to arrange and organize the prs and go through a few pms to figure out some things, im expecting 114 to be pred later today or early tomorrow, regardless i will release it ASAP for you guys.
----------------
Hearing the creature's voice call out to him Avrin had an itching feeling that this would lead to an annoying situation, “Hm? What is it?” he spoke in a slight disgruntled voice.
The lizardman hearing the tone Avrin gave, became a little bit more nervous as it soon laughed with a hissing back vocal. “Esteemed customer, I was inquiring as to whether you would be willing to sell that spacial ring, I know an individual who would pay very very handsomely for one.”
Avrin considered some things, in the end all he needed was the skymetal, the ring itself held no value, he wasn't dumb, most likely if he declined it would lead to some greedy trouble, he began to consider things. “This individual, if they are capable of opening it than I would like to choose one item from the spacial ring, that will be my cost.”
Quickly severing any future issues, this was a path Avrin planned to set early, there are many times where being to much of a statue in one's stance would lead to trouble, and this trouble would also possibly be found out by an individual he would not like to meet.
It also brought the possibility of obtaining the sky metal earlier, it was a win win for Avrin, what use would he have for a spacial ring that required mana, with his ability in dark matter a spacial storage space would eventually become an easy reality.
The lizardman was elated as he rubbed his scaly hands together before his lips curled into a smile revealing his serrated teeth. “Excellent esteemed customer! I am sure you have business to attend to, please accept this.”
The creature reached into a pocket inside its vest before pulling out a small stone emblem with the symbol of a great axe being held by the silhouette of a bulky humanoid, it handed the symbol to Avrin and spoke.
“The potential buyer, to my knowledge, will return in a few hours. I will head over to their estate beforehand to explain the situation, please when the time reaches 9:00pm make your way to the fortress home built into the mountain in the middle of this capital, show the symbol to the guards and say you have been summoned by Chieftain Giron.
Avrin simply nodded before he gazed at the symbol he had taken and soon left, “-Giron?, where have I heard that name before.-” He contemplated some things before gazing at a time dial on the wall of a small monument, “-5:00pm I still have quite a bit of time-” With that said Avrin made his way around to take in the sights.
He had been walking for 5 minutes before a sound he had been hearing often grew louder, this was the sound of people cheering with a frenzied feeling in their voices. Avrin extended his divine sense and soon discovered the source, he of course was not surprised.
A large circular arena with thousands of people seated about watching combatants fight each other on a dirt floor, gladiatorial combat at its most primitive form, although it seemed to minus the killing. It just goes to show that regardless of these creature's beastial nature the romans held a bit less care and craved blood even more so.
It would be a shame for Avrin not to admire the sights personally and see what the beastmen were capable of, so he made his way over and soon payed the toll of one gold coin to enter.
The price seemed a bit steep, then again when fighting with potentially one's life on the line the combatants had to be compensated fairly, one could tell all those viewing were of some status.
Taking a seat on the third level of benches, the arena was quite large spanning nearly 150 meters.
On each side in a circle were benches where one could barely find any free seats, the crowd began to roar with excitement as they watched a large bear humanoid fighting against a much smaller yet much more agile individual who resembled a skinny leopard.
As much as the bear was powerful, with his fists causing the ground to tremble, the leopard creature seemed to be easily able to dodge and backflip away.
It seemed like a perfect stalemate, even as the leopard creature was slashing away at the bear man’s back, its claws barely seemed to do anything other than shave away at some hair. “You slippery bastard, see if I don't crush you to dust!!” The bear man roared with anger as his eyes turned somewhat bloodshot.
The leopard’s expression twisted but before it could reply, weapons were thrown into the arena with an assortment of designs. It quickly rushed over and gripped onto a set of serrated daggers, the leopard man snickered as it soon spoke, “crush me?... I'm gonna gut you before that happens hahaha”
It soon charged the bear creature whose eyes narrowed, it quickly smashed the ground with all its might causing it to tremble, of course the leopard creature who was close had two options: One was to stumble due to the attack causing the ground to shake which would make it lose balance. The other option was to jump up and attack, of course this meant it would sacrifice agility for a moment.
The leopard chose the latter as it jumped up, its legs acting like a spring as it came crashing down towards the bear with the serrated daggers set forward to stab it.
Of course the bear creature snickered, it had expected as much from the leopard, this was a sacrifice it was willing to make. It raised its large paw-like hand and as the daggers stabbed into its large arm, causing blood to splurt out, it tightened its muscles causing the metal weapons to be stuck.
The leopard's eyes widened and attempted to pull, of course this was a mistake on its behalf, if it had let go it may have escaped unharmed. The bear creature's free paw came smashing towards the leopard who seemed to be stuck trying to pull the daggers out of the bear man's muscle fibres.
The sound of bones cracking and breaking echoed as a figure smashed across the ground like a soccer ball as it rolled for a few meters before remaining still, the bloody figure twitched every now and then.
This was of course the leopard who had been blindsided by the bearman, the crowd roared with enthusiasm to this fight, as long as blood was drawn how could it not be exciting.
As two other beastmen who seemed to be medics came and took the leopard away on a wooden stretcher, the bearman grabbed the daggers stuck in his arm by the hilts before pulling them out, his expression flickering for a moment, he than raised both his arms into the air and gave a heavy roar.
An announcer soon spoke out. “And again!!! The bear brute Tutan remains on an undefeated streak of 8 now!! It seems at this rate only the current champion will be able to potentially put an end to his reign!!!”
With the prospect of seeing the current unknown champion and the bear Tutan fight the crowd shrieked with excitement, of course Avrin didn't seem to think this was all that much, only a battle between expert individuals. Thankfully he could leave as he pleased, if this fight were to continue on he would rather engross himself in his inner workings rather than watch the fight.
“Is anyone willing to fight the current undefeated Tutan and advance to the finals to defeat the champion to win one of three prizes!!! Bring them in!!” The announcer spoke out before three large curtain covered cages were brought in.
The excited crowd was even more frenzied before going quiet to listen in as to what the prizes were. “The first prize a chest which contains a large amount of riches equalling up to 10,000 gold worth of items!!” The crowd was awed, even for the high tiered nobles of the beastmen tribe that much gold was at least a decade's worth of expenses.
The crowd yet again roared and whispered to each other to goad others into fighting. The next curtain was drawn down and the announcer again spoke. “The next prize is a large chunk of, ladies and gentlemen you know it, a unique level ore!!! This was found by Chieftan Giron himself!!! And decided to put it into the prize pool!! It is large enough to forge a powerful weapon!!”
How could the crowd who was filled with beastmen who craved fighting not go crazy over the prospect of potentially having a weapon of such strength, there were many who considered rushing down to steal it, of course after hearing the Chieftain found it and donated it, no one would dare do so.
“The next prize although the least valuable is still a unique undocumented creature!!!,“ The curtain was pulled down to reveal a dirty and very skinny horse looking creature with a dirty and dusty white mane around its neck and skinny boney hooves.
It was currently laid down as if it had no energy and cared not for anyone there, of course it had barely noticeable blue lines from under the mane on its neck down to its seemingly damaged tail, it had several wounds showing that it hadn't received much care.
Although the crowd was excited those who were excited seemed to be all children, having such a potential pet would truly be a show to brag about to their friends, of course someone noticed something strange about this miserable creature.
Avrin gazed at it strangely, the creature was unlike anything he had ever seen on seleria, in fact gazing at it carefully a delighted feeling appeared in Avrins heart. This creature no doubt resembles a mythical creature in ancient east asian mythology, “-Is that a kirin?-”
Of course Avrin looked carefully at the miserable creature, his divine sense soon extended out towards it, but the moment it touched the kirins body, the kirins eyes flickered as it lifted its head and gazed over towards Avrins direction. It opened its mouth and gave a miserable cry. One could tell it barely had any energy as it tried to shout and shriek to none other than Avrin.
Avrin’s brow twitched a little. The creature seemed to notice his divine sense, it made him curious, of course looking at how it seemed to shriek towards him, the announcer kicked the cage as he tried to shut it up. “Damnit you ugly thing be quiet!!..” He then cleared his throat and shouted out.
“Who is willing to take on the undefeated Tutan for a chance to take his position and fight the champ!! This would save the trouble of working one's way up again!!!.” Avrin thought curiously before he gave a half hearted smile. “-Well not like I have a choice, this is obviously a sign of sorts.-”
Avrin stood up before he jumped up and soon landed on the dusty arenas ground, his body still robed, he gazed over towards the announcer and Tutan, “ooo!! We have a challenger and what name do you have courageous challenger!?”
“Cut the crap and just get the fight started.” Avrin spoke clearly having no intention to reveal anything about himself. Tutan hearing this gave a hearty laugh as he stepped towards Avrin, “haha this insect is funny I like him, I don't need to have my wound healed to take care of this rodent…Let’s fight.”
The announcer who found Avrin’s attitude irritating heard Tutan and then chuckled and nodded. “Well then ladies and gentlemen the match shall begin!! Both contestants are ready!! In 3….2…..1….begin!” The announcer roared out as he ran off to not get caught in the fight.
Tutan came charging towards Avrin as his hands emitted a fierce green aura showing he augmented himself a little with his nature affinity mana, he seemed to want to end this fight quickly. 
If you spot this tale on Amazon, know that it has been stolen. Report the violation.
Avrin pulled his left fist back before giving a casual punch towards Tutan, he also didn't want to drag this fight out. The punch he sent seemed to crack and split the air as a powerful force shot out towards Tutan who seemed to freeze in shock.
The force smashed against his body blowing him away and smashing him against the end of the arena's walls, of course the crowd at that section had already fled in fear, the portion of the arena was now ruined with a twitchy Tutan laying unconscious.
Everything remained quiet for a moment, no one knew what had just happened, they saw Avrin give a casual punch towards Tutan and then Tutan went flying, only one thing came to their mind.
“A hidden expert” the crowd grew crazy at the show of strength. The announcer who was irritated before by Avrin was now fearful and thanking his lucky stars that he didn't aggravate Avrin, he made his way over nervously and shouted.
“W...Well!! Tutan has been defeated by this mysterious contestant who uh...is supposedly a hidden powerful expert!!! This astonishing simple victory has given him Tutan’s position to fight the current champion!!”
Avrin gazed at a large dial as he looked at the time, barely an hour had passed since he had left the store, it gave him time to put this to an end and win. “Next fight I got things to do…” Avrin spoke with annoyance.
The announcer looked at Avrin and nodded. “It seems like our mysterious contestant wants to quickly fight the champion!!! Let's abide by his wish, Lord luzar please come out!!”
The moment the announcer stopped talking, a large metal gate lifted up and large creature made its way towards Avrin, it seemed to look annoyed, but Avrin’s eyes widened as he truly wanted to laugh at this creature's misfortune, this was because his opponent was the draconian Luzar who had disappeared after Avrin defeated the dragon Wruen.
Luzar held a sort of flagon of some sort of wine in his right hand as he drank it while glaring fiercely at Avrin, clearly he didn’t know he was anything other than a contestant, “You want to fight me? The great Luzar?!!! You truly seek to die…”
Luzar boasted out and emitted a large pressure which even caused the crowd to be afraid, Avrin could see Luzar grew quite stronger, he almost pitied the creature, Avrin looked to the announcer. “Start the fight.” The announcer was shocked at how confident Avrin seemed, He couldn't help but feel the moment he started the fight that a massacre would befall.
“O..Ok!! It seems both our current champion the great Luzar who appeared suddenly several months back and dominated the arena as well as the mysterious expert who defeated the expert rank Tutan in one blow are ready to fight.!!”
Luzar walked over to Avrin as he seemed to tower over him, Luzar glanced down before taking a drink of the flagon of wine as he sniffed the air, he had a strange feeling. “Hmm this smell…” he looked at Avrin strangely. “Hey...Why can't I feel you're mana?...”
Avrin truly wasn't sure whether to torment the poor creature or just end it and leave, of course he wasn't one to purposely torment a creature without good reason so he decided he would just end it easily.
“3….2…” While the announcer spoke Avrin raised his head up to look at Luzar, and Luzar gazed back as he saw Avrin’s face, Avrin’s nebula mist twisted a little as he changed his appearance back to the original appearance of his spectral from, the moment Luzar saw this face, he wanted to truly piss himself.
“1…..begi-” Before the announcer spoke Luzar howled in fear. “I FORFEIT!!! I FORFEIT I DON'T WANT TO FIGHT THIS MAN!!” With that said Luzar turned tail and fled with his tail between his legs as he even dropped his flagon with fright.
If Avrin was capable of killing his master, a powerful dragon created by a god, then what chance did he have. Avrin although expected as much as he smirked before his face reverted back to his human appearance, the crowd of course was shocked, and even the announcer was left speechless.. “Ladies...And gentlemen the winner is the mysterious expert, our champion has forfeited?....Uhh!! This means we have a new champion!!!”
The crowd though looked disappointed as they began to boo, they hadn't seen any battle as they expected this fight to be top notch, but were let down. “What sort of bullshit is this!!” One buffalo looking creature blurted out. “Rigged!! I'm sure this match was rigged!!!” Another creature that resembled an armadillo spoke out.
And soon the entire crowd began to throw things towards the arena hitting the announcer on the head as well as Avrin. Of course Avrin looked at them all, he didn't hesitate as he emitted his phantom pulse engulfing the entire crowd as a pressure pulled down on them. He then spoke. “Next person to throw something at me….will find their family won't even find their corpse to bury…”
The phantom pulse made them all look in fear and agony, this sort of fear that they hadn't even felt during Luzars matches, they could see why he surrendered. Immediately Avrin removed the phantom pulse and the crowd remained deathly quiet in fear for a few moments before they began to speak to each other wondering how powerful Avrin was exactly.
Avrin looked to the announcer for a moment before walking over towards the three cages that were guarded at the very right side, the guards of the cages didn't dare block Avrin, of course the announcer nervously rushed over.
“New champion!! Since you have won, you can pick your prize of the three! I'm sure you are after the second prize, the unique level ore that Chieftan Giron had managed to find.”
Avrin ignored him as he walked over to the third cage and looked over at the kirin that began to howl in misery as if calling out to its parent. Avrin grinned a little, he suddenly contemplated something, if he could find creatures that held great potential and mystery and showed loyalty to him, wouldn't his race of spectrals eventually become unstoppable over time?
With his ability to convert creatures to his race and unlock limitless potential for as long as they worked hard, just where could this end, and with him at the helm many possibilities came across his mind.
A strange surge of anger appeared in his mind. “-I'll surely find a way back to my universe and slaughter those that set me up…-” Avrin truly wanted revenge on certain individuals. He felt at first it may have been impossible to travel back, but with his future capabilities, if he played his cards right and was careful, just how many beings of power could combat him?
“Give me this creature….” Avrin spoke softly, the announcer was shocked as he looked over at the miserable kirin. “Uhh...Mister champion, are you sure?...To be honest this creature we aren't sure about...We had another creature to put here but it was purchased by a private buyer for a great price, we had no choice but to put this creature here because it looked good but it looks pretty useless to me…”
The announcer kicked the cage again as he looked at the kirin with disdain, as he kicked the cage the kirin shrieked in misery. This made Avrin angry as he saw him torment it, a dangerous aura engulfed him, “Kick that cage again, I will cut that leg off…” Looking at the announcer who was now shaking with fear he quickly bowed in apology, before reaching over with a key and nervously opening the cage.
After the cage door opened, the weak looking kirin seemed excited as he stood up despite looking malnourished it seemed to have some strength. It looked up at Avrin seemingly as obedient as a dog, Avrin looked at it strangely, he hadn't met this thing before yet it seemed determined to follow him for some reason.
“Very well, I will take you, you better prove useful to me…” He spoke towards it as if he felt it was supposed to understand him. The kirin with its tongue hanging out a little quickly nodded its head as it seemed a little dumb suddenly.
Avrin twitched before speaking, “Let’s go.” Looking at the kirin he began to walk off and soon the kirin followed, its legs began to shake as it could barely take a step or two, it saw Avrin get further and further away and it suddenly shrieked feeling he would leave it behind.
“Are you joking?...” Avrin turned to look at the creature and saw it truly was weakened. He felt his face turn pale as he walked over to it and sighed, He reached down and grabbed the creature carrying it in his arms, he then turned and walked off, of course the kirin seemed ecstatic as it looked around before gazing at the announcer, it seemingly hissed and growled towards him as if he were its nemesis.
The announcer could do nothing but force a smile as Avrin began to walk off, “Mister champion your next match should be-..” As the announcer spoke up Avrin interrupted. “I'm not coming back nor am I your champion.. Don't bother me.” Avrin soon vanished using a void step to quickly cover the distance out of the arena and away from the whispering crowd.
Avrin made his way over towards a tavern inn and as he entered he saw that many adventurers were laughing and drinking, though when he entered with the kirin in his hands everyone stopped talking and strangely looked at him.
Soon laughter rung out as they pointed and laughed at him as if he were a saint carrying an injured animal, of course Avrin ignored them and walked to the counter. “I’d like to rent a room for the night. “ He spoke, looking at the innkeeper who looked at Avrin than at the kirin he cleared his throat. “Sir we don't accept injured animals or pets in our rooms…”
Avrin of course knew how to play the game set here, he reached over and placed 4 gold coins on the counter. The innkeepers heart was beating crazily as he nearly drooled. “Of course sir!! Would you like the vip suite or one of the larger rooms?” His expression changed as he saw Avrin as important suddenly.
“Just give me a room where I won't be bothered.” After speaking the innkeeper nodded and gave him a key with a room and then smiled. “breakfast will be served at 7:00am lunch at 2:00pm and dinner at 6:00pm of course for you sir customer you can eat free since you have paid quite a sum so ignore those times and eat as you please.”
Avrin nodded and began to walk off towards the staircase, the inn itself seemed quite large and there were several staircases leading to different stories of the inn, though as Avrin approached the one that led to his room a hand reached over and touched his shoulder. “Hey you….I'm allergic to...fur...how are you going to compensate me…” A seemingly fake sneeze sounded out, Avrin turned around to look at a tiger-like creature who was no doubt drunk as he held a mug of alcohol in his hands.
Of course, after he spoke laughter sounded out from a nearby table no doubt from his friends. Avrin gave the creature a strange look, if he walked off it would cause trouble, if he paid it, it would irritate him, so he decided to simply handle the situation. He raised his free left hand as the kirin looked at the tiger creature and growled at it before seeing Avrin’s hand nearing the tigers face.
“Huh?...You got money in that hand? Heheh..*burp!*“ The creature gazed at Avrin’s hand with interest hoping to get paid, but what met it was a flick to its forehead. The flick was quite powerful and soon the tiger creature was blown away several meters and smashed onto the table of its friends.
The entire inn remained quiet as they looked at the tiger than at Avrin, they all had pale looks, with just a flick he had caused all this, just how powerful was he. Of course the tiger’s friends felt disdain in their hearts and pulled out their weapons but the innkeeper roared out.
“If you fight in this inn I will ban you!” The innkeeper shouted towards the group, they looked at the innkeeper then at Avrin before twitching, they were going to ignore him but gazing around they saw the other looks of the adventurers, they all loved this inn because of the cheap prices and good food, if anyone caused trouble no doubt they would step in.

chapters.title: V4: Chapter 114 Giron Vs Avrin.
chapters.content:
Note: please read chapter 113 for those who have just seen this post and missed the other release, i have also contemplated some things and decided to temporarily remove the romance tag from SR as there is currently no romance but later on i truly intend for there to be, i only ask that you all be patient with me and my pacing of the story. This chapter was pred by Dragonofsomesort & pwninator, Im unable to enter their profiles and link it to their names so please consider going through a bit of effort and giving them some rep for helping to  pr this chapter. second/final sponsored chapter of the day, yay for me i cleared my first queue :o i still owe you guys a regular release so i will get to writing 115 asap. Special thanks to SR's DonatorTobias Klauke, for sponsoring this release! ----------------------
The group preparing to attack Avrin could only watch as he turned and walked away, they then helped their wounded drunk friend and swallowed their pride with only mumbled curses. Avrin gazed at the innkeeper who smiled graciously back.
Soon after Avrin made his way up and entered his own room, he still had a bit of time left, he placed the kirin on the ground and knelt down beside it carefully inspecting it.
“So, I'm not sure what I can feed you, but you belong to me now.” Avrin raised his index finger up as dark matter and nebula mist surged around it slightly, this was a feeling all but familiar to him.
The kirin gazed strangely at him as it tried to crawl back a little. “This will hurt a little….” Avrin took its front right hoof as he carefully stabbed into it. The kirin gave a soft shriek as it wanted to pull away but didn't.
Avrin began to channel the purest form of dark matter he could muster into the creature, thankfully he didn't need to stab into its heart due to Erebus’s discovery. The creature should be thanking him, although the process would be a bit slower it would still lead to the same result.
The kirins body began to shift a little as the mana that made its body began to surge and change slightly. It felt tired as its eyes seemingly shut, Avrin pulled his finger out from the fresh wound that started sealing up. The kirin weakly curled up on the ground as the nebula mist Avrin injected into its hoof surged around it engulfing it like a cocoon.
The process of converting to a spectral took awhile so he now had time to himself. Avrin lowered his hood and removed the cloak before throwing it onto the bed, as well as his enchanted sack that he placed beside it, he then sat in an empty corner and entered a meditative position to check on his inner workings.
It hadn't taken long before he entered. Gazing over it seemed all the type 4 c.particles were now all converted to type 5 c.particles and have even made progress. His body had now been 48% converted to type 5 particles, a look of excitement and achievement appeared in his mind.
After they were converted to type 5 particles he would be able to baptize them within his dark space and make significant progress,
Gazing over the floating book that god had given him that contained all the information he had gone over the first 5 stages were considered the infant stage. After the infant stage was completed one would enter the beginner stage which was focused seemingly on baptizing particles. Particles would be coated and infused with dark matter, just like how a caterpillar feeds before becoming a butterfly.
“-According to this, there are three stages for the beginner stage as opposed to the 5 of the infant. The first stage is to baptize all my particles and infuse them with dark matter, this process takes a bit of time, after that I will enter the second stage which is the cocoon stage. This stage puts my particles in a sub dormant state meaning I will be greatly weakened and in a vulnerable position as a sort of hibernation, I will have to be careful at this point.
The third stage is breaking from this cocoon, the new particles will be reborn and greatly strengthened unable to be compared to the one's before, just how a caterpillar cannot be compared to a butterfly, I suppose these particles will be known as butterfly particles, to put it simply.
The third stage itself is to feed these particles even more pure dark matter, the purer the better, once they have been fed and are full I will be able to enter the dark stage, though the dark stage doesn't have much information I am also unaware of what lies beyond, all that is stated for the dark stage is “” The wings of darkness ignites the void.” “Riddles, why does my advancement have to be set in some riddle.-”
Thinking carefully Avrin had plenty of time to contemplate it, though at this current stage his progress was acceptable for him, he also wondered if Kael had reached the north and they had all begun their regime of training, he truly wanted to see results.
An hour had passed since Avrin entered meditation, the curtain of dark matter across the kirin had now vanished to reveal the creature. It seemed to look the same except not only did it look much healthier it seemed to emit a radiance and no longer looked weak and malnourished.
It stood up and stretched before yawning. Though it looked around as its stomach rumbled a little, its eyes were now emitting a purple and blue radiant glow. It gazed at avrin and saw that he seemed to be busy in meditation, it didn't want to bother him so it glanced around. It spotted his cloak on the bed and saw that it emitted dark matter.
It rushed over and quickly opened its mouth as a sort of vacuum appeared, the dark matter particles that made Avrin’s cloak began to rip apart as if it were deconstructing, within moments it devoured the entire cloak, giving a soft burp, despite this it still didn't feel satisfied as he glanced over, it spotted Avrin’s enchanted sack.
It approached it and sniffed curiously, the sack was open somewhat, allowing it to stick its head inside, from there one could guess the events that would occur next.
Avrin of course had already felt the kirin had awoken but didn't bother with it yet, as he assisted his particles somewhat more, he also examined his dark space to see it emit a more powerful stability, “-No doubt converting aegis was a great idea, a shame I couldn't receive the other half of the sigil.”
Finally happy with his progress there was not much Avrin could do but allow his body to progress at its own rate, as he left the meditation he opened his eyes and gazed only to see the kirin standing up with its head inside the enchanted sack, the sight would make anyone laugh as it looked as if the kirin had a shrunken head hidden by the sack, but to Avrin a horrified pained look appeared.
“y...you damned thing!!” Avrin quickly rushed over and removed the sack from its head before he looked inside of it quickly, he reached around trying to see if anything was missing, but gazing around his heart dropped and skipped a few beats.
He had never felt so wronged in his entire life, the sack was completely empty, a look of misery appeared on Avrin’s face. “No…..the ores I had stored….the ring...the ring!!! MY SKYMETAL!!”. Avrin truly wanted to cry tears of misfortune, but the emotion of sadness wasn't very strong due to his dark matter heart, that being said he still felt wronged.
He turned to gaze at the kirin which seemed to emit a more radiant glow, it glanced at Avrin before giving what appeared to be a thankful smile. Avrin glared at the creature, he would consider gutting it had it not been for the fact that it devoured objects by using nebula mist.
“Perfect...this is just perfect…” Avrin sighed as he sat on the side of the bed and rubbed his forehead, of course the kirin jumped onto the bed and curled up beside him, he glanced at the creature before narrowing his eyes. “Amazing to think it could so easily absorb all those things…”
Avrin thought for a moment before sighing, he glanced at the creature which then looked up  at him and was about to give a soft comfortable neigh before Avrin bonked it on the head, the kirin quickly gave a look of being wronged as it gave a confused growl. “You damned glutton...you ate something incredibly valuable to me! Don't you act as if you're wronged.”
The kirin remained quiet, it had been converted by Avrin and had a basic understanding of the language of this world, though it was still newly converted and didn't understand everything, it frowned a little and gave a stupid look not sure what he meant.
Avrin stood up and extended his divine sense out, he shut his eyes before feeling around the area, he was looking for any traces of angels that may be linked to Abbadon, but thankfully not one appeared. “Regardless let's go, I have no need for staying here anymore.”
Avrin placed his hand over the kirins head, it felt that he was going to pat him so it gladly obliged, but it was wrong, both Avrin and the kirin seemingly turned to ash as he had used his divine sense to transport them both many miles away from the city within a mountainous desolate region, it was also quite far away from where he had originally arrived, the kirin felt its body tighten up, it was its first time experiencing the divine step and it's mind was disoriented.
Avrin glanced over at a small hidden cliff face, nebula mist shot towards it like a blow torch as it effortlessly devoured away at it, the kirin watched with awe as it looked over at a nearby rock before trying to emit its own nebula mist but all that came out was a small unsatisfactory burp, Avrin glanced at the creature before sighing with regret, he began to walk and appeared inside the cave he had created that extended in about 15 meters.
He raised his hand as nebula mist created a large sitting cushion that he sat on cross legged, he then raised his right hand and began to form a large spherical object that appeared somewhat transparent with floating nebula mist inside of it. This was a sphere identical to the one he had given Erebus and Kael, it was used to transfer information.
Avrin rolled the sphere over to the kirin and glanced ruthlessly at it, “The current dumb you will no doubt cause problems, absorb this.” Avrin then shut his eyes as he reentered his inner workings. The kirin walked over to the sphere as it pressed its hoof over it before rolling it around as if it were a toy, after sniffing it, it began to absorb it, a flood of information surged into its mind.
The first was a better understanding of language and the next was the technique to develop and train its body as a spectral, followed by an understanding of Avrin and his people, as well as the situation of wanting to be hidden, lastly was Avrin’s disdain for it eating something very valuable to him, and an order from Avrin to it to begin training itself.
Avrin had a spare sack but it had eaten everything from the ring that contained the skymetal to the dark matter cores, he needed it to use it all to develop its body otherwise it may find a backlash.
The kirin felt fear well up, even now it felt its body was hurting somewhat, it quickly curled up as it began to use the methods Avrin had given it to help itself advance.
Several hours had passed and the time set to meet the chieftain had soon arrived, currently within a large room carved from previous rock and marble, two individuals were seated, one was a large towering humanoid creature half man half wolf, he was tapping his finger onto the sturdy marble seat he was on, beside him was the lizardman merchant who had a nervous look on his face as he sweated bullets.
“Your so called spatial ring customer doesn't seem to be coming….” the large bulk individual spoke. The lizardman gulped as he uttered. “C..Chieftain Giron...m..maybe he tricked me...and said all this to avoid trouble and allow him to flee?...” the lizardman of course was not dumb as it tried to cover its scaly hide.
“Humph…very well, you are sure he has the tribe symbol?” Giron spoke, the lizardman nodded, “Of course my lord!”
Giron raised his hand and pulled out a large square piece of wood that had several magical dots on it, glancing over he noticed all these dots, each one had a numeric value to them, he glanced at one dot with the number 114 he narrowed his eyes. “Very well. Stay here, I will go see our guest personally…” Giron stood up before his body flickered from the room leaving behind a slight lift in the wind.
If you spot this story on Amazon, know that it has been stolen. Report the violation.
Back within the cave the kirin raised its head as it felt its stomach rumble a little, it looked down confused, of course the reason for this was because it had eaten everything within the sack it truly was unable to quickly absorb it all, and a lot of it remained in its stomach slowly being devoured by its limited nebula mist.
The ring was currently engulfed in nebula mist as it was slowly being eaten away, the dark matter cores were untouched, and the wooden symbol given to Avrin was slowly radiating a faint mana signal, most of which was devoured by the nebula mist but enough got through it to alert Giron.
The kirins actions quickly alerted Avrin, it tried to speak but the knowledge given to it by Avrin was not enough, it also didn't have the proper vocal cords, so it spoke trying to use the telepathy stated inside the sphere. “muaster...mwaster..” it tried to speak telepathically to Avrin.
Avrin who was helping the progress of his body had managed to help it reach 53% which was significant for just a few hours. He suddenly opened his eyes and gazed at the kirin a little confused, of course with his sense he spotted the faint mana coming from within its body, emitting his divine sense around it, his eyes widened greatly as his lips curled into a smile, he stood up and walked over to the kirin.
“You, hairy horse, just remain still… and open your mouth.”  The kirin didn't dare disobey Avrin as it knew just how he could be now that it learnt a bit from the sphere he had given it.
With its mouth wide open Avrin navigated nebula mist down the creature's throat, a look of disgust appeared on Avrin’s face but when he knew the reward he would no doubt be eager to get his treasures back.
The nebula mist soon arrived inside the kirins large stomach, Avrin using it was able to engulf everything within the mist before he soon shut his eyes and concentrated, within moments everything that it had eaten turned to ash and then reappeared on the ground beside Avrin who of course quickly left the disgruntled kirin who seemed to look hungry again.
He gazed over at everything on the ground, some of the dark matter cores had been digested and there were now at least 50 instead of 83, the ring had been somewhat digested and now leaked mana which made Avrin nervous.
He also spotted the mask which was chewed on, the mask itself symbolized the time when he learnt blacksmithing despite being able to form it from dark matter he had made sure to keep the entire structure perfectly intact when absorbing it so it would forever remain the same.
“You stubborn vile creature…” Avrin sighed before emitting nebula mist over it all to disintegrate the saliva covering it all, he than used it to repair the half eaten mask, and then after storing everything back in the enchanted sack other than the spacal ring which was now being held by Avrin, who looked at it curiously with a strange expression.
“Interesting…” the more Avrin looked at it, he could see the mana wasn't leaking from the ring itself but from a slight tear that was leaking out. Avrin wasn't sure what would happen once the mana contained within the ring vanished, but his guess was that it would collapse in on itself and everything inside would be lost for good.
A string of nebula mist surged over towards the faint stream of mana that leaked out before it tied around it and slowly began to use it as a sort of rope to climb, soon the nebula mist approached the distorted space.
Of course Avrin didn't have time to take this to Giron who may cause some trouble at this point due to the rings damage, he could only pray that this worked.
The nebula mist slipped against the distorted space before seemingly vanishing, of course Avrin could feel where it had went.
His eyes shut he soon used the nebula mist this time as a rope for his divine sense, extending out he was able to see the space, it was 2x2 meters in diameter and slowly closing in, the ring contained many seemingly precious items from ores to trinkets and the like, of course the space was shrinking and anything it shrunk to and touched would warp slightly and vanish into nothingness.
Avrin quickly extending more nebula mist and his divine sense around until he discovered what he was after, a look of greed appeared on his face as he quickly engulfed that large chunk of skymetal that had been sealed up.
It had taken a minute with his current handicap to gather enough nebula mist to do so. The space was only a few inches away from touching the skymetal which caused Avrin to be a little nervous.
He quickly used his divine step on the object causing it to turn to ash before a large stream of nebula mist shot towards the small tear that the mana leaked out of, another minute soon passed and a cloud of nebula mist hung over Avrin, by now the spacial ring was only a couple feet in diameter, but Avrin had no more use for it as he focused on the cloudy nebula mist that soon reformed perfectly into the skymetal.
Reforming it was quite easy because it had never been absorbed heavily, its structure was perfectly preserved and putting it together was much easier to do.
The sealed chunk of skymetal soon fell down from the air and landed within Avrin’s hands. Avrin tossed the broken spacial ring to the side as he held the skymetal as if it were his own child, he gazed over at the kirin which was sniffing away at the spacial ring.
“”mwaster...eweat it?..” it spoke to Avrin who only looked at it as if he was looking at Asura. “Yes yes… you can eat it you clueless glutton...” he then turned to look again at the skymetal with a wide grin on his face, he was wondering just what would it form into after his dark heart refined it. Would it cause trouble for him just like Astaroth did?
A gust of wind suddenly appeared outside the cave, Avrin of course felt it, his eyes widened as he turned to look at the half devoured symbol on the ground that he hadn't bothered storing, it was emitting a mana burst which seemed to trigger every few seconds like a signal.
“-perfect…-” Avrin spoke dejectedly before gazing over his divine sense emitting out as he spotted a figure casually walking inside the cave. his face twisted a little. as he realised just who it was.
“-That's right...Giron, Chieftain Giron, the beastmen tribes leader, and sigil wielder, unlike Leo, Zircus, Syrana, and Myra who decided to split their sigil weapons in half, Giron uses a full sigil weapon like Abbadon…-”
A look of interest appeared on Avrin’s face, if this was before he would be nervous but after his advancement he was now much stronger than when he fought and tricked Abbadon and Leo.
The large bulky figure entered the caves depths to see Avrin holding a large round object which was covered by some seals, the figure then glanced at the kirin which was chewing on something as it glanced over at him, the kirin then hissed at him as if feeling he had no good intentions.
“You know. when a promise of a deal is made, it's common courtesy to keep that promise…” The figure who indeed was the sigil wielder Giron spoke over towards Avrin whose expression didn't seem to glance back.
“Indeed, and I apologize, the ring received damage and doesn't work anymore, in the end I obtained what I wanted from it…”
Hearing Avrin’s words Giron carefully analysed the situation, he listened to Avrin’s words and gazed at what he was holding, he carefully put two and two together. A spacial ring was a very very precious object, if this person was willing to part with it for the item he was after, wouldn't the item he coveted be worth much more than the ring itself?
A hint of greed appeared on Girons face as he smiled before laughing heartily of course the laugh contained a trace amount of his beastial aura, this was the aura of a being who had just reached the legendary rank. “That is fine, it’s all fine, well for making the beastmen tribes leader and sigil wielder wait, compensation must be given…”
Avrin glanced over at Giron with a straight expression. “Compensation?...I don't have anything for you, what do you want?” Even Avrin was quite curious as to what Giron may want.
Giron smiled as he glanced at the skymetal Avrin held, “Well what your holding now looks to be quite important and expensive, you should know the value of a spacial ring and its history, how about you give me whatever you are holding and I will be on my way.
A spacial ring created by an ancient enigma level ability user is priceless not many were made. I am sure you can understand the situation, that is why if you give me that object you are holding we can call it eve…”
While Giron was talking, outside of the cave things seemed to be peaceful, some birds would fly about and the cliff face seemed to give a good view of the suroundings, suddenly the air shook as the cave entrance was blown apart, a figure was sent flying crashing down the cliff face like a meteor before smashing into the ground.
The figures legs maintained balance as he landed feet first, his arms were crossed in front of him and they seemed a bit bloodied, a look of shock appeared on his face.
This was the Chieftain Giron. As the dust settled from his crash downwards another figure appeared from the ruined cave entrance, Avrin looked down with a annoyed expression towards Giron before uttering a setence. “Compensation?....my skymetal you want it?...you delusional animal...are you crazy?...do you know the trouble I went through for this?…” Avrin was clearly irritated that this creature, sigil wielder or not, wanted his skymetal.
Avrin’s aura pulsed out as his phantom pulse extended over Giron who felt an immense pressure, he immediately roared out with a trace amount of fear. “-Just who is this man….I’ve never felt this sort of power from those other than sigil wielders and dragons…-”  Giron clenched his teeth before he roared out.
“URSA!!” suddenly a tyrannical aura engulfed Giron as it was violently orange with a red hue, the phantom pulse Avrin emitted over him was easily dispatched to be replaced by the violent berserk aura. Giron was left standing with a large great axe in his right hand, the axe itself seemed to be the source of Giron’s berserk aura. He looked at Avrin with anger in his eyes.
“Not many individuals are capable of landing a hit on me...I feel if I don't take you seriously it will be my undoing…” Giron raised Ursa in the air before he roared out “DRAGON SLAYER”. Everything seemed to stop for a moment as Ursa came down like a mountain.
Avrin’s eyes flickered with caution as Ursa cleaved downwards, the pressure and energy released from the attack caused the cliff face to split in two.
Avrin had already used his short distance void step to quickly flee the attacks trajectory, though the attack didn't stop there as the mountain behind it was also cleaved in two. Any creatures or individuals caught in the attack were instantly killed with no hope of fighting back.
Avrin knew that this was bad, no doubt a fight like this would attract abaddon who seemed to have eyes everywhere. “Astaroth!…”
Avrin called out before he dashed over towards Giron, the best way to defeat a sigil wielder was to quickly catch them off guard. Using his void step Avrin’s body flickered towards Giron who roared out, before slashing towards Avrin causing the air to split and the space to slightly distort.-------------
regarding why avrin didn't retrieve the items earlier from the kirins stomach this was brought up to me by a pr so i wanted to share my answer for readers who may seem confused.
""" The reason why he didn't do so in the beginning was because he had thought the kirin absorbed everything with nebula mist and not a scrap was left, but as it turned out it didn't do so and just ate them using its mouth.
Of course its body is still newly converted and its absorbing ability's isn't strong enough yet and only a few of the items were digested by the nebula mist inside of it.

chapters.content:
This chapter was pred by Dragonofsomesort & pwninator, Im unable to enter their profiles and link it to their names so please consider going through a bit of effort and giving them some rep for helping to  pr this chapter. :)
